products.name: dependency
products.description: Master record defining parent-child and peer relationships between service instances — modeling bundle compositions (triple-play: broadband + VoIP + IPTV), technology dependencies (VoLTE depends on data bearer), 5G network slice compositions (slice instance depends on underlying connectivity service), wholesale/MVNO virtual service layers (host service → virtual service mapping), and service groupings (multi-SIM family plans). Captures dependency type (composition, prerequisite, peer, slice-component, wholesale-virtual), parent service instance, child service instance, dependency direction, activation sequencing constraint, and impact propagation rule (e.g., if parent suspends, children auto-suspend). Essential for bundle lifecycle management, 5G slice orchestration, MVNO service modeling, impact analysis during service modifications, and correct provisioning sequencing. Does NOT own the commercial bundle definition (product domain) or the network slice template (network domain) — owns only the instantiated runtime dependency graph.

attributes.name: dependency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service dependency relationship record. Primary key for the service dependency entity.

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Service dependencies may require a specific addon to be active (e.g., VoLTE requires IMS addon, international roaming requires roaming addon). Telecom provisioning orchestration and eligibility valida

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bundle. Business justification: Service dependencies defined at the bundle level (e.g., bundle requires broadband + voice components) must reference the product bundle. Telecom provisioning orchestration uses bundle-level dependency

attributes.name: child_service_instance_svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the child or dependent service instance in the dependency relationship. For bundle compositions, this is a component service (e.g., broadband, VoIP, or IPTV within triple-play). For technology dependencies, this is the dependent service (e.g., VoLTE service depending on data bearer). For 5G network slices, this is the underlying connectivity service. For wholesale/MVNO scenarios, this is the virtual service layer.

attributes.name: dependency_svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent service instance in the dependency relationship. For bundle compositions, this is the container service (e.g., triple-play bundle). For technology dependencies, this is the prerequisite service (e.g., data bearer for VoLTE). For 5G network slices, this is the slice instance. For wholesale/MVNO scenarios, this is the host carrier service.

attributes.name: mvno_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.mvno_profile. Business justification: Service dependencies in MVNO wholesale bundles (signaled by mvno_wholesale_flag) must reference the MVNO profile to enforce MVNO-specific dependency rules, bundle composition constraints, and QoS/SLA

attributes.name: parent_dependency_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on dependency (parent_dependency_id)

attributes.name: product_offering_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial product offering that defines this dependency relationship. Links the runtime dependency instance back to the catalog definition. Used to trace dependencies to their product catalog source and understand which commercial bundles drive which service dependencies.

attributes.name: provisioning_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provisioning order that established this service dependency. Used for traceability and audit purposes. Enables linking dependency creation back to the originating order for troubleshooting and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns or is associated with the service dependency relationship. Denormalized for reporting and analytics. Enables quick identification of all service dependencies for a given subscriber without complex joins.

attributes.name: activation_sequence_order
attributes.description: Numeric order indicating the sequence in which dependent services must be activated. Lower numbers activate first. Used by orchestration systems to ensure correct provisioning sequencing. For example, in a triple-play bundle, broadband (order 1) must activate before VoIP (order 2) and IPTV (order 3).

attributes.name: billing_impact_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the dependency relationship affects billing. Bundle_discount means the dependency enables bundle pricing or discounts. Separate_billing means each service is billed independently despite the dependency. Consolidated_billing means services are billed together as a single line item. No_impact means the dependency has no billing implications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Billing and Revenue Management

attributes.name: bundle_composition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency represents a commercial bundle composition (e.g., triple-play, quad-play, family plan). True means this is a bundle relationship where parent is the bundle container and children are component services. False means this is a technical or operational dependency.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product and Service Catalog

attributes.name: child_service_type
attributes.description: Denormalized service type of the child service instance for faster querying and reporting without joining to service instance table. Examples: voip, iptv, data_bearer, volte, connectivity_service.

attributes.name: created_by_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or orchestration engine that created this dependency record. Examples: Oracle OSM, Netcracker OSS, manual entry via CRM. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this service dependency record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deactivation_sequence_order
attributes.description: Numeric order indicating the sequence in which dependent services must be deactivated or suspended. Typically reverse of activation order. Used to ensure graceful shutdown without breaking dependencies. For example, IPTV (order 1) deactivates before VoIP (order 2) and broadband (order 3).

attributes.name: dependency_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the dependency purpose. Commercial indicates bundle or pricing-driven relationships. Technical indicates technology stack or protocol dependencies. Regulatory indicates compliance-mandated relationships. Operational indicates process or workflow dependencies.

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dependency relationship. Active indicates the dependency is currently in effect. Inactive indicates the dependency exists but is not currently enforced. Suspended indicates temporary hold. Pending indicates the dependency is being established. Terminated indicates the dependency has been permanently removed.

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dependency relationship between service instances. Composition indicates bundle/package relationships where parent contains children. Prerequisite indicates one service must exist before another can be activated. Peer indicates services that work together at the same level. Slice_component indicates 5G network slice composition. Wholesale_virtual indicates MVNO host-to-virtual service mapping. Technology_stack indicates layered technology dependencies.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates the directionality of the dependency relationship. Parent_to_child means parent controls or contains child. Child_to_parent means child requires parent to function. Bidirectional means mutual dependency where both services depend on each other.

attributes.name: effective_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service dependency relationship ended or was terminated. Null indicates the dependency is currently active. Used for historical analysis and audit trails of service relationship changes.

attributes.name: effective_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service dependency relationship became active and enforceable. Used for temporal tracking of dependency lifecycle and historical analysis of service compositions.

attributes.name: external_dependency_code
attributes.description: External system identifier for this dependency relationship in the source OSS/BSS system. Used for reconciliation and integration with upstream systems. Enables bidirectional traceability between lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: failure_handling_policy
attributes.description: Defines how provisioning or lifecycle failures should be handled when they occur in the dependency chain. Rollback_all means any failure triggers rollback of all related services. Continue_partial means successful services remain active. Manual_intervention means failures require human review. Retry_automatic means system automatically retries failed operations.

attributes.name: impact_propagation_rule
attributes.description: Defines how lifecycle changes to the parent service propagate to child services. Cascade_suspend means if parent suspends, children auto-suspend. Cascade_terminate means if parent terminates, children auto-terminate. Notify_only means changes generate alerts but do not auto-propagate. Block_parent_change means parent cannot change state if children are active. Isolate means no propagation occurs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this service dependency record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes. Updated whenever any attribute of the dependency relationship changes.

attributes.name: mandatory_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dependency is mandatory for service operation. True means the child service cannot function without the parent, or the parent cannot exist without the child. False means the dependency is optional or advisory. Used by provisioning systems to enforce hard constraints.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this dependency record. Used for audit trails and accountability. May be a human user ID or a system service account name.

attributes.name: mvno_wholesale_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) Wholesale Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency represents a wholesale or MVNO virtual service layer relationship. True means the parent is a host carrier service and the child is a virtual service provided by an MVNO or wholesale partner. False means this is not a wholesale/MVNO relationship.

attributes.name: network_slice_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency represents a 5G network slice composition. True means the parent is a network slice instance and the child is an underlying connectivity or transport service. False means this is not a slice-related dependency. Essential for 5G slice orchestration and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this service dependency. Used by operations teams to document exceptions, workarounds, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: orchestration_constraint
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special orchestration constraints or rules that apply to this dependency. For example, 'Parent must be fully activated before child provisioning begins' or 'Child suspension requires 24-hour notice to parent subscriber'. Used by OSS orchestration engines.

attributes.name: parent_service_type
attributes.description: Denormalized service type of the parent service instance for faster querying and reporting without joining to service instance table. Examples: broadband, mobile, bundle, network_slice, wholesale_service.

attributes.name: qos_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child service inherits QoS profile settings from the parent service. True means child uses parent QoS parameters. False means child has independent QoS configuration. Important for network slice scenarios where slice QoS applies to all component services.

attributes.name: sla_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child service inherits SLA parameters from the parent service. True means child adopts parent SLA targets and commitments. False means child has independent SLA. Relevant for bundle compositions where all components share a single SLA tier.

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Indicates the strength or enforcement level of the dependency. Hard means the dependency is strictly enforced by provisioning systems and cannot be violated. Soft means the dependency is recommended but can be overridden with approval. Advisory means the dependency is informational only and not enforced.

domains.name: product
domains.description: SSOT for the commercial product and service catalog defining all offerings including mobile plans, broadband packages, IPTV/OTT bundles, VoIP offerings, enterprise SD-WAN/MPLS products, devices, and promotional offers. Manages product specifications, pricing models, bundles, eligibility, and product lifecycle via Netcracker Product Catalog.
domains.references: TM Forum SID Product Domain, TM Forum TMF620 Product Catalog API

products.name: catalog_item
products.description: Master record for every commercial offering in the Netcracker Product Catalog — mobile plans, broadband packages, IPTV/OTT bundles, VoIP offerings, enterprise SD-WAN/MPLS products, and devices. Captures canonical product definition including product code, category, sub-category, technology type, market segment (B2C, B2B, wholesale, MVNO), product family, launch date, end-of-sale date, and lifecycle status. Includes catalog versioning metadata (version number, approval status, effective date) and lifecycle event audit trail. SSOT for all product definitions.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Product Specification (TMF620)

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the catalog item in the Netcracker Product Catalog. Primary key for all commercial offerings including mobile plans, broadband packages, IPTV/OTT bundles, VoIP offerings, enterprise SD-WAN/MPLS products, and devices.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Wholesale and MVNO operations require tracking which partner provides or co-brands catalog items (e.g., roaming packages from partner networks, content services from media partners). Supports partner

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Telecom products must comply with specific regulatory obligations (spectrum rules, service quality mandates, consumer protection). Regulatory filings reference which products are covered; compliance o

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow state for catalog item changes requiring governance approval. Only 'approved' items are published to active catalog and available for ordering.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the current catalog version was approved for publication. Null for unapproved items. Used for audit trail and effective dating.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the product manager or governance authority who approved the current catalog version. Null for unapproved items.

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: Standard list price for the catalog item before discounts, promotions, or customer-specific adjustments. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in enterprise configuration.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which recurring charges are generated for this catalog item. Drives invoice generation schedule in Amdocs billing system. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: monthly|quarterly|annually|one_time|daily|per_usage|na — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: catalog_version
attributes.description: Version number of the catalog item definition in Netcracker Product Catalog. Incremented with each approved change to product specifications, pricing, or terms. Format: major.minor.

attributes.name: channel_count
attributes.description: Number of live TV channels included in IPTV and OTT packages. Null for non-content products. Used for content licensing cost allocation and package differentiation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Standard contract commitment period in months for this catalog item. Null for no-contract or prepaid offerings. Used for early termination fee calculations and churn analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this catalog item record was first created in the Netcracker Product Catalog system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the base price. Supports multi-currency pricing for international operations and wholesale agreements.

attributes.name: data_allowance_gb
attributes.description: Monthly data usage quota in gigabytes for mobile and broadband products. Null for unlimited plans or non-data products. Used for usage threshold monitoring and overage billing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: download_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum or typical download throughput in Mbps for broadband and mobile data products. Key QoS parameter for customer expectations and SLA commitments.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current catalog version becomes active and available for new orders. Supports future-dated product launches and pricing changes.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining customer qualification requirements for this catalog item. Examples: credit score thresholds, geographic availability, existing customer status, business registration requirements.

attributes.name: end_of_life_date
attributes.description: Date when all support and service for this catalog item ceases. All customer subscriptions must be migrated or terminated by this date. Null if not yet scheduled.

attributes.name: end_of_sale_date
attributes.description: Date after which new orders for this catalog item are no longer accepted. Existing subscriptions may continue. Null if product is still available for sale.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current catalog version is superseded by a newer version or withdrawn from the catalog. Null for current active versions without planned replacement.

attributes.name: geographic_availability
attributes.description: Regions, states, or service areas where this catalog item can be provisioned. Constrained by network infrastructure coverage (RAN, fiber footprint, DSLAM reach). Pipe-separated list of region codes or 'national' for full coverage.

attributes.name: is_bundled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog item is a composite bundle containing multiple sub-products or services. True for triple-play, quad-play, and enterprise solution bundles.

attributes.name: is_standalone
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog item can be purchased independently or requires a base product. False for add-ons, value-added services, and device accessories.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the catalog item was first made available for sale to customers. Used for product performance analysis and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment for the catalog item. Determines pricing strategy, sales channel eligibility, contract terms, and SLA commitments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: b2c|b2b|wholesale|mvno|government|enterprise_sme|enterprise_large — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent update to this catalog item record. Updated with every change to product specifications, pricing, or lifecycle status.

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Revenue model and charging structure for the catalog item. Determines how billing events are generated and rated in Amdocs Revenue Management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recurring|one_time|usage_based|tiered|hybrid|freemium|prepaid|postpaid — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the catalog item. Used across all BSS/OSS systems for product identification and ordering. Follows enterprise SKU format.

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the catalog item including features, benefits, and technical specifications. Used for customer-facing documentation and sales enablement.

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: Logical grouping of related catalog items that share common characteristics, pricing models, or go-to-market strategy. Example: 'Unlimited Plans', 'Fiber Home', 'Business Connect Suite'.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the catalog item as presented to customers and used in marketing materials. Example: 'Unlimited 5G Premium Plan', 'Fiber 1Gbps Home Broadband', 'Enterprise SD-WAN Plus'.

attributes.name: promotion_end_date
attributes.description: Date when promotional pricing or terms expire. After this date, standard pricing applies to new orders. Null for non-promotional products.

attributes.name: promotional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog item is a limited-time promotional offer with special pricing or terms. Used for campaign tracking and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: requires_device
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog item requires customer premises equipment (CPE), SIM card, or device to function. True for mobile plans, IPTV services, and broadband requiring ONT/modem.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channels authorized to sell this catalog item. Pipe-separated list: 'retail_store', 'online', 'telesales', 'partner', 'enterprise_direct', 'wholesale'. Controls product visibility in Salesforce CRM and order capture systems.

attributes.name: sla_mttr_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) Hours
attributes.description: Maximum time in hours to restore service after a fault for enterprise products with SLA commitments. Null for consumer products. Drives NOC escalation procedures.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement

attributes.name: sla_uptime_percentage
attributes.description: Contractually guaranteed network availability percentage for enterprise and wholesale products. Null for consumer products without formal SLA. Used for penalty calculations and service credits.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement

attributes.name: sms_allowance
attributes.description: Monthly SMS message quota included in mobile products. Null for unlimited messaging or non-mobile products. Used for usage tracking and overage billing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: supports_esim
attributes.description: Indicates whether mobile product supports eSIM provisioning for compatible devices. Enables remote SIM activation and multi-profile management.

attributes.name: supports_mnp

attributes.name: qos_tier
attributes.description: The Quality of Service tier associated with this price plan defining network priority, bandwidth guarantees, latency targets, and service level commitments. Premium offers highest priority and guarantees, best effort offers no guarantees.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement

attributes.name: rating_group
attributes.description: Classification group used by the rating engine to apply appropriate charging rules and tariffs. Used in real-time charging systems for CDR (Call Detail Record) processing and usage rating.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of telecommunications service this price plan applies to (e.g., mobile voice, mobile data, broadband internet, FTTH (Fiber to the Home), IPTV (Internet Protocol Television), VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network), MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching), 5G NR (5G New Radio)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile_voice|mobile_data|broadband|ftth|iptv|voip|sd_wan|mpls|5g_nr|lte|ott|device — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sla_uptime_percentage
attributes.description: The guaranteed service availability percentage defined in the SLA (Service Level Agreement) for this price plan. For example, 99.9% uptime guarantee. Null if no SLA uptime commitment applies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax classification category for this price plan determining applicable tax rates and treatment. Telecom-specific category applies to services subject to special telecommunications taxes or regulatory fees.

attributes.name: tax_inclusive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the base price amount includes taxes (true) or taxes are added on top (false). Critical for pricing display and billing calculation.

attributes.name: tiered_pricing_structure
attributes.description: JSON or structured text defining the tier breakpoints and rates for tiered pricing models. Specifies quantity ranges and corresponding unit prices for each tier. Null for non-tiered plans.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Pricing Logic Algorithm

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for usage-based or volume-based pricing (e.g., GB for data, minutes for voice, SMS for messaging, Mbps for bandwidth, each for devices). Null for non-usage-based plans.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this price plan definition. Incremented when pricing terms, rates, or structure are modified. Supports price plan change tracking and historical analysis.

products.name: promo_offer
products.description: Defines time-limited promotional offers applied to catalog items or bundles — including introductory pricing, free trial periods, bonus data allowances, device subsidies, and retention offers. Captures promo code, promo type (acquisition, retention, win-back, seasonal), discount structure, eligibility criteria (new/existing customer, segment, channel), promo start/end dates, maximum redemption count, and campaign association. Supports both B2C and B2B promotional strategies.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Promotion (TMF671)

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotional offer. Primary key for the promo_offer product.

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bundle. Business justification: Promotional offers frequently target composite bundles (e.g., 'Save 30% on the Family Broadband + Mobile Bundle'). promo_offer.eligibility_product_category is a free-text string that currently capture

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific product catalog item to which this promotional offer applies. Null if offer applies to multiple products or product categories.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.offering. Business justification: A promotional offer can be applied directly to a specific offering (e.g., '3 months free on the Unlimited Plus plan'). promo_offer currently only has catalog_item_id; adding offering_id allows promos

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Partner-funded promotions and dealer incentive campaigns are standard in telecommunications distribution. Tracks which partner sponsors or funds a promotion, supporting cost allocation, partner market

attributes.name: price_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_plan. Business justification: A promotional offer modifies or overrides a specific price plan (e.g., a 50% discount applied to the Standard MRC price plan for 6 months). Linking promo_offer to price_plan establishes which base pri

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Promotional offers in telecom are subject to advertising standards, mandatory disclosure rules, and consumer protection regulations. Regulators require promos to reference applicable obligations for c

attributes.name: revenue_share_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.revenue_share_plan. Business justification: Promotional offers distributed through partner channels affect revenue share calculations — promo discounts must be factored into partner settlement. Linking promo_offer to revenue_share_plan enables

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.segment. Business justification: Promotional offers target specific enterprise segments. promo_offer.eligibility_customer_segment is a denormalized text field; replacing with segment_id FK enables segment-targeted promotion managemen

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the promotional offer. Indicates whether the offer has been reviewed and approved by authorized personnel before activation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this promotional offer was approved. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who approved this promotional offer for activation. Null if not yet approved or approval not required.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Product Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: auto_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional offer is automatically applied to eligible customers without requiring a promo code entry. True if auto-applied, False if customer must enter promo code.

attributes.name: bonus_data_amount
attributes.description: Additional data allowance provided as part of the promotional offer, measured in the unit specified by bonus_data_unit. Applicable for mobile and broadband promotions.

attributes.name: bonus_data_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for bonus data amount: GB (gigabytes), MB (megabytes), or TB (terabytes).

attributes.name: budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this promotional offer in the currency specified by discount_currency_code. Used to track promotional spending and prevent budget overruns.

attributes.name: budget_consumed
attributes.description: Amount of promotional budget consumed to date through customer redemptions. Updated as offers are redeemed. Used for budget tracking and offer performance monitoring.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this promotional offer record was first created in the product catalog system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: discount_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for fixed amount discounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for percentage-based discounts.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount structure applied: percentage (percent off regular price), fixed_amount (dollar/currency amount off), tiered (discount varies by quantity or commitment), or bogo (buy one get one).

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount. For percentage discounts, represents the percentage (e.g., 25.00 for 25% off). For fixed amount discounts, represents the currency amount. Interpretation depends on discount_type.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotional offer expires and is no longer available for new redemptions. Null for open-ended offers without expiration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this promotional offer becomes active and available for customer redemption. Promotional offers cannot be redeemed before this date.

attributes.name: eligibility_channel
attributes.description: Sales or service channel(s) through which this offer can be redeemed (e.g., online, retail_store, telesales, partner, mobile_app). Comma-separated list if multiple channels are eligible. Null if no channel restriction.

attributes.name: eligibility_customer_type
attributes.description: Customer type eligible for this promotional offer: new (new customers only), existing (current customers only), churned (win-back for former customers), or all (no customer type restriction).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Customer Relationship Management

attributes.name: eligibility_geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic region(s) where this promotional offer is valid. Can be country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3), state/province codes, or region identifiers. Comma-separated list if multiple regions. Null if no geographic restriction.

attributes.name: eligibility_product_category
attributes.description: Product category or categories to which this promotional offer applies (e.g., mobile_postpaid, fiber_broadband, iptv, voip, sd_wan). Comma-separated list if applicable to multiple categories. Null if offer applies to all products.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier used to reference this promotional offer in external systems or partner platforms. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: free_trial_duration
attributes.description: Length of the free trial period measured in the unit specified by free_trial_unit. Applicable for free trial promotional offers.

attributes.name: free_trial_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for free trial duration: days, months, or billing_cycles.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who last modified this promotional offer record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this promotional offer record was last modified.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: marketing_message
attributes.description: Short marketing message or tagline used to promote this offer in customer-facing materials, advertisements, and digital channels.

attributes.name: maximum_redemption_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this promotional offer can be redeemed across all customers. Used to cap total offer usage for budget control. Null if unlimited redemptions allowed.

attributes.name: minimum_commitment_period
attributes.description: Minimum contract commitment period required to qualify for this promotional offer, measured in months. Null if no commitment required.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Priority ranking used to determine which promotional offer to apply when multiple offers are eligible and stackable_flag is False. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: promo_category
attributes.description: Category of promotional benefit provided: discount (percentage or fixed amount off), free_trial (service at no charge for period), bonus_data (additional data allowance), device_subsidy (reduced device cost), bundle (package deal), or waived_fee (activation/installation fee waived).

attributes.name: promo_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code that customers use to redeem the promotional offer. Used in order entry, self-service portals, and customer service systems.

attributes.name: promo_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the promotional offer including terms, benefits, and conditions. Used in marketing materials and customer communications.

attributes.name: promo_name
attributes.description: Marketing name of the promotional offer displayed to customers and used in campaign materials.

attributes.name: promo_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional offer based on its strategic purpose: acquisition (new customer), retention (existing customer), win-back (churned customer), seasonal (holiday/event-based), loyalty (reward program), or referral (customer referral incentive).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Customer Relationship Management

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this promotional offer. Typically 1 for most offers. Null if no per-customer limit.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this promotional offer record originated (e.g., Netcracker Product Catalog, Salesforce CRM, custom promotion management system).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotional offer can be combined (stacked) with other promotional offers. True if stackable, False if mutually exclusive with other offers.

attributes.name: target_arpu_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) Impact
attributes.description: Projected impact on Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) from this promotional offer, expressed as a currency amount. Negative values indicate expected ARPU reduction during promo period. Used for financial planning and offer ROI analysis.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions
attributes.description: Full legal terms and conditions governing the promotional offer including restrictions, disclaimers, and fine print. Used for regulatory compliance and customer disclosure.
attributes.references: FCC - Truth in Billing, TM Forum SID

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who created this promotional offer record in the product catalog system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

products.name: spec
products.description: Technical specification record for a catalog item defining detailed service characteristics, network requirements, and capability parameters as extensible name-value pairs. Covers all product types: mobile (data allowance, voice minutes, SMS, roaming entitlements, QoS), broadband (speed tiers, technology, latency SLA), IPTV (channels, streams, DVR), SD-WAN/MPLS (bandwidth, SLA tier), and roaming profiles (zone configurations, fair-use limits). Includes usage allowance definitions (allowance type, quantity, reset frequency, overage policy, throttle speed). Aligned with TM Forum SID specification pattern. SSOT for all technical product characteristics.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Product Specification (TMF620)

attributes.name: spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key for technical specification records defining detailed service characteristics, network requirements, and capability parameters.

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product catalog item that this specification defines. Links technical specifications to the commercial product offering.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.offering. Business justification: Technical specifications can be defined at the offering level in addition to the catalog item level. An offering may have offering-specific SLA tiers, QoS classes, or bandwidth specs that differ from

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.sla_definition. Business justification: Product specs define SLA parameters (sla_tier, sla_uptime_percent, mttr_hours). Linking to partner.sla_definition enables SLA compliance reporting and partner dispute resolution by tracing which contr

attributes.name: allowance_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the usage allowance. Defines the included amount (e.g., 50 GB data, 1000 voice minutes, unlimited). Use -1 or special value for unlimited allowances.

attributes.name: allowance_type
attributes.description: Type of usage allowance for mobile and roaming products. Specifies the consumption category: data, voice minutes, SMS, roaming data, roaming voice, or international minutes. Applicable only to usage allowance specifications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Usage Allowance Type

attributes.name: bandwidth_mbps
attributes.description: Committed bandwidth in megabits per second for enterprise SD-WAN and MPLS circuits. Defines the guaranteed throughput for business connectivity products (e.g., 10 Mbps, 100 Mbps, 1 Gbps).

attributes.name: burst_bandwidth_mbps
attributes.description: Burstable bandwidth in megabits per second for enterprise circuits. Defines the maximum temporary throughput allowed above committed rate (e.g., 100 Mbps committed, 200 Mbps burst).

attributes.name: channel_count
attributes.description: Number of IPTV channels included in the package. Defines the content entitlement scope for television service offerings (e.g., 100 channels, 300 channels).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - IPTV Channel Count

attributes.name: characteristic_name
attributes.description: Name of the technical characteristic being specified. Extensible name-value pair key for product capabilities (e.g., data_allowance_gb, download_speed_mbps, channel_count, sla_uptime_percent).

attributes.name: characteristic_value
attributes.description: Value of the technical characteristic. Stores the specification parameter value as string to support numeric, boolean, and enumerated values (e.g., 50, unlimited, true, gold_tier).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Characteristic Value

attributes.name: concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous video streams allowed for IPTV and OTT services. Defines the multi-device viewing limit (e.g., 2 streams, 4 streams, unlimited).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Concurrent Stream Limit

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the product specification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for specification lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: download_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum download speed in megabits per second for broadband and mobile data products. Defines the advertised or guaranteed downstream bandwidth tier (e.g., 100 Mbps, 1 Gbps).

attributes.name: dvr_hours
attributes.description: Cloud DVR storage capacity in hours of recording for IPTV services. Defines the network-based recording allowance (e.g., 50 hours, 200 hours, unlimited).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this product specification becomes active and available for provisioning. Supports product lifecycle management and version control for specification changes.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this product specification is retired and no longer available for new provisioning. Null for active specifications. Supports product catalog lifecycle management.

attributes.name: fair_use_limit_gb
attributes.description: Fair use policy limit in gigabytes for unlimited plans. Defines the threshold beyond which network management policies may apply (e.g., deprioritization, throttling). Regulatory compliance for unlimited offerings.

attributes.name: is_rollover_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether unused allowance rolls over to the next billing cycle. True for rollover data plans. False for use-it-or-lose-it allowances.

attributes.name: is_shared
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the allowance is shared across multiple subscribers or devices. True for family plans and multi-device data pools. False for individual allowances.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Shared Allowance Flag

attributes.name: is_unlimited
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the allowance is unlimited. True for unlimited data, voice, or SMS plans. False for metered allowances. Drives billing and network management policies.

attributes.name: latency_ms
attributes.description: Maximum network latency in milliseconds guaranteed by the service. Defines the round-trip time SLA for latency-sensitive applications (e.g., 10ms for 5G URLLC, 50ms for broadband).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that last modified the product specification record. Audit trail for specification change accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the product specification record was last modified. Audit trail for specification change management and version control.

attributes.name: mttr_hours
attributes.description: Guaranteed mean time to repair in hours per SLA. Defines the maximum average time to restore service after a fault (e.g., 4 hours, 8 hours, 24 hours). Applicable to enterprise and premium consumer products.

attributes.name: overage_policy
attributes.description: Policy applied when usage exceeds allowance. Defines the enforcement action: block (hard cap), throttle (reduce speed), charge (pay-per-use), rollover (carry forward unused), or unlimited (no cap).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Network traffic priority level for QoS enforcement. Numeric value where lower numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1=highest, 10=lowest). Maps to 3GPP QCI or 5G 5QI values.

attributes.name: qos_class
attributes.description: Quality of Service tier assigned to the product. Defines the traffic prioritization and performance guarantees: best effort (no guarantee), guaranteed (SLA-backed), premium (high priority), or mission critical (highest priority).

attributes.name: reset_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which usage allowances reset. Defines the billing cycle for allowance renewal: monthly (standard), daily (roaming fair-use), weekly, annual, one-time (non-recurring), or never (lifetime).

attributes.name: roaming_data_allowance_gb
attributes.description: Data allowance in gigabytes available for roaming usage. Defines the fair-use limit for international data consumption. May differ from domestic allowance.

attributes.name: roaming_zone
attributes.description: Geographic roaming zone configuration for mobile products. Defines the international roaming coverage area (e.g., Zone 1 Europe, Zone 2 Americas, Global). Maps to carrier roaming agreements.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier for enterprise products. Defines the support and performance commitment level: bronze (basic), silver (standard), gold (premium), platinum (mission-critical). Determines MTTR and uptime guarantees.

attributes.name: sla_uptime_percent
attributes.description: Guaranteed service availability percentage per SLA. Defines the contractual uptime commitment (e.g., 99.9%, 99.99%, 99.999% for carrier-grade). Applicable to enterprise SD-WAN, MPLS, and premium broadband.

attributes.name: spec_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the specification parameter. Groups specifications by purpose: usage allowance, network capability, service feature, QoS parameter, device capability, or pricing rule.

attributes.name: spec_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the product specification. Provides business context and technical details for the characteristic definition. Used for product catalog documentation and customer communication.

attributes.name: spec_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the product specification. Identifies the technical characteristic being defined (e.g., Data Allowance, Speed Tier, Channel Package).

attributes.name: spec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product specification. Defines availability for provisioning: draft (under development), active (available), deprecated (phasing out), retired (no longer available).

attributes.name: spec_type
attributes.description: Category of product specification defining the service domain. Determines which technical parameters are applicable (mobile, broadband, IPTV, VoIP, SD-WAN, MPLS, device, roaming, add-on). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|broadband|iptv|voip|sdwan|mpls|device|roaming|addon — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Type

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Network access technology used to deliver the service. Specifies the physical layer technology: fiber (FTTH), DSL, cable, LTE, 5G NR, GPON, VDSL, or DOCSIS. Determines capability boundaries. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fiber|dsl|cable|lte|5g|gpon|vdsl|docsis — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: throttle_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Reduced data speed in megabits per second applied after allowance exhaustion. Applicable when overage_policy is throttle. Defines the post-allowance QoS degradation (e.g., 128 Kbps, 1 Mbps).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for numeric characteristic values. Defines the quantity unit (GB, Mbps, minutes, channels, percent, ms latency, concurrent streams). Null for non-numeric characteristics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Unit of Measure

attributes.name: upload_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum upload speed in megabits per second for broadband and mobile data products. Defines the advertised or guaranteed upstream bandwidth tier (e.g., 20 Mbps, 500 Mbps).

attributes.name: value_type
attributes.description: Data type of the characteristic value. Indicates how to interpret the characteristic_value field: numeric (quantities), boolean (flags), string (text), enumeration (predefined list), or range (min-max).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Characteristic Value Type

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the product specification. Supports specification change tracking and backward compatibility management (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created the product specification record. Audit trail for specification authorship and accountability.

products.name: eligibility_rule
products.description: Defines the eligibility conditions that govern which customers or segments can purchase a specific offering or promotional offer. Captures rule type (customer segment, account type, geographic area, existing product, credit class, contract tenure), rule operator (equals, in, greater_than), rule value, and logical combination (AND/OR). Supports complex eligibility logic for B2C, B2B, MVNO, and wholesale segments. Used by BSS/CRM systems during order capture to validate product eligibility.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Product Offering Qualification (TMF679)

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the eligibility rule. Primary key for the eligibility rule entity.

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Eligibility rules also govern addon purchases (e.g., 'International Roaming addon only available to postpaid customers with 6+ months tenure'). Adding addon_id to eligibility_rule completes the eligib

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.agreement. Business justification: Eligibility rules for partner-distributed products are often defined within or constrained by the governing partner agreement (e.g., credit class eligibility per MVNO agreement, geographic scope per r

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bundle. Business justification: Eligibility rules govern which customer segments can purchase specific bundles (e.g., 'Triple Play bundle only available in fiber-enabled geographic zones'). eligibility_rule currently references offe

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Eligibility rules can govern which customers can purchase a specific catalog item (e.g., 'IoT tariff only available to business segment customers'). eligibility_rule currently has product_offering_id

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Channel partners and MVNOs have specific eligibility rules (e.g., MVNO subscribers only, authorized dealer channels). Tracks partner-specific eligibility constraints for product offerings, supporting

attributes.name: product_offering_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product offering or promotional offer to which this eligibility rule applies. Links to the product catalog entry in Netcracker Product Catalog.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Eligibility rules in telecom are frequently mandated by regulation (universal service obligations, age verification for adult content, geographic availability mandates). Compliance teams must trace ea

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.segment. Business justification: Eligibility rules are defined per enterprise segment (e.g., rules applying only to large enterprise or government segments). Linking segment_id enables segment-specific rule evaluation during product

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who approved this eligibility rule for activation. Supports governance workflows and approval chains for product catalog changes. Nullable for rules that do not require formal approval.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this eligibility rule was formally approved for activation. Used for governance audit trail and compliance reporting. Nullable for rules that do not require formal approval. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sales and service channels where this eligibility rule applies. Examples include retail stores, online web portal, mobile app, telesales, partner channels, enterprise direct sales, Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) channels. Enables channel-specific eligibility logic for omnichannel product offerings.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory or compliance frameworks that this eligibility rule supports or enforces. Examples include Federal Communications Commission (FCC) regulations, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), age verification requirements, Know Your Customer (KYC) rules, or industry-specific mandates from International Telecommunication Union (ITU), 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), or GSM Association (GSMA).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this eligibility rule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this eligibility rule is no longer enforced. Nullable for rules with indefinite validity. Used to automatically expire promotional eligibility conditions, sunset legacy product offerings, and manage regulatory compliance windows. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this eligibility rule becomes active and is enforced in order management and service provisioning systems. Supports time-bound promotional offers, seasonal campaigns, and regulatory compliance effective dates. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: The user-facing error or informational message displayed when a customer or order fails to meet this eligibility condition. Provides clear guidance to Customer Relationship Management (CRM) agents and self-service portals on why a product cannot be purchased and what actions are required to become eligible.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Business Rule Message

attributes.name: evaluation_frequency
attributes.description: Defines how often or under what conditions this eligibility rule is evaluated. Real-time evaluation occurs during order capture; periodic evaluation supports batch eligibility checks for existing customers; event-triggered evaluation responds to specific business events such as contract renewal, credit score update, or network upgrade.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Business Rule Execution

attributes.name: external_rule_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this eligibility rule in external or upstream systems such as Netcracker Product Catalog, Salesforce CRM, or Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM). Used for cross-system reconciliation, data integration, and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic areas (countries, regions, states, postal codes, network coverage zones) where this eligibility rule applies. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes and internal geographic identifiers. Supports location-based eligibility for Fiber to the Home (FTTH), 5G New Radio (5G NR), and regional promotional offers.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, TM Forum SID - Geographic Address

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this eligibility rule must be satisfied (true) or is optional/advisory (false). Mandatory rules block order submission if not met; optional rules may generate warnings but allow order progression. Supports flexible eligibility frameworks for complex product bundles and promotional offers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Business Rule Constraint

attributes.name: is_overridable
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized users (e.g., sales managers, retention specialists) can manually override this eligibility rule during order capture. Supports exception handling for high-value customers, retention scenarios, and special business cases while maintaining audit trail of overrides.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Business Rule Override

attributes.name: logical_operator
attributes.description: Defines how this rule combines with other rules in the same eligibility rule set. AND requires all rules to be satisfied; OR requires at least one rule to be satisfied. Used to construct complex multi-condition eligibility expressions for bundled offerings, promotional campaigns, and segment-specific products.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Business Rule Logic

attributes.name: market_segment

products.name: bundle_component
products.description: This association product represents the Component role between bundle and offering in the telecommunications product catalog. It captures the explicit business act of including a specific offering as a component within a bundle, with terms governing that inclusion (mandatory vs. optional, quantity, component-level discount, display sequence, and effective dates). Each record links one bundle to one offering and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific bundle-offering composition. Product catalog managers create, modify, and retire these records as part of bundle lifecycle management in BSS/product catalog systems such as Netcracker.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications product catalog management, bundles are explicitly composed of multiple offerings (e.g., a Triple Play bundle contains broadband offering + IPTV offering + VoIP offering), and a single offering (e.g., 'Fiber 100Mbps') can be included in multiple different bundles simultaneously (e.g., both a 'Double Play' and a 'Triple Play' bundle). This is a first-class operational business concept — product catalog managers actively create, modify, and retire bundle component records as part of product lifecycle management. The relationship carries its own attributes (mandatory/optional flag, component quantity, component-level discount, sequence, effective dates) that belong neither to the bundle nor the offering alone.

attributes.name: component_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to this specific offering when included in this bundle, distinct from the bundle-level discount. Enables per-component pricing adjustments in bundle pricing models.

attributes.name: component_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of this offering included in the bundle. Typically 1 for most components but may be greater for multi-line or multi-device bundles.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: is_mandatory_component
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offering is a required (mandatory) component of the bundle or an optional component that customers may substitute or remove. Directly governs flexible bundle composition rules.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Display and processing order of this offering component within the bundle. Used for rendering bundle composition in customer-facing channels and BSS order management.

attributes.name: substitution_allowed
attributes.description: Component-level override indicating whether this specific offering within the bundle may be substituted by the customer with an alternative offering. Overrides or refines the bundle-level component_substitution_allowed flag.

domains.name: order
domains.description: SSOT for end-to-end order management and fulfillment — new activations, upgrades, downgrades, disconnections, MNP port-in/port-out, and change-of-service requests. Orchestrates order decomposition, workflow coordination, and fulfillment across OSS/BSS systems via Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
domains.references: TM Forum SID Customer Order, TM Forum TMF622 Product Ordering API, eTOM Order Handling

products.name: fulfillment_order
products.description: Core master record for every end-to-end order in the telecommunications lifecycle — new activations, upgrades, downgrades, disconnections, MNP port-in/port-out, and change-of-service requests. Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM). Captures order type, order channel, priority, customer reference, account reference, submitted timestamp, promised completion date, current order state, fallout reason, orchestration workflow instance ID, workflow template, decomposition strategy, SLA type (regulatory, commercial, enterprise), SLA target completion hours, warning threshold hours, breach threshold hours, SLA measurement start/end events, current SLA status (ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, BREACHED), and breach timestamp. This is the SSOT for order identity, lifecycle state, orchestration context, and SLA commitment within the order domain. All SLA monitoring, jeopardy detection, and regulatory compliance measurement derives from this master record's SLA attributes.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Order (eTOM 1.4.x) / OSM Order

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id

Used to calculate actual fulfillment duration, SLA adherence, and MTTR reporting. Null until order reaches COMPLETED status. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
