attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fulfillment order was cancelled. Null for non-cancelled orders. Used for cancellation rate analytics, churn analysis, and order fallout reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order record was first created in the order management system. Serves as the audit trail anchor for record lineage. Distinct from submitted_timestamp which captures the business event time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: credit_check_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the credit assessment performed during order processing. APPROVED: customer passed credit check. DECLINED: order blocked due to credit failure. WAIVED: credit check bypassed (e.g., existing premium customer). Drives order workflow progression in Oracle Communications OSM.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party Credit Profile; Oracle Communications OSM Order Validation

attributes.name: decomposition_strategy
attributes.description: The strategy used by Oracle Communications OSM to decompose the fulfillment order into sub-orders and tasks for downstream OSS/BSS systems. Drives orchestration efficiency and parallel provisioning capabilities.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: external_order_reference
attributes.description: The order reference number from an external or upstream system (e.g., Salesforce CRM opportunity ID, dealer portal order number, B2B customer's purchase order number). Enables cross-system order tracing and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Salesforce CRM Opportunity Management

attributes.name: fallout_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the order fallout reason, enabling structured reporting and trend analysis on order failure types. Complements fallout_reason with a standardized taxonomy for operational dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: fallout_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason code or message explaining why the fulfillment order failed or was placed on hold during orchestration. Populated by Oracle Communications OSM when order_status transitions to FAILED or ON_HOLD. Critical for fallout management, root cause analysis, and process improvement.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications OSM Fallout Management

attributes.name: field_work_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order requires a field technician dispatch for physical installation or maintenance (e.g., FTTH CPE installation, ONT provisioning). Drives integration with Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management for scheduling and dispatch.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: is_regulatory_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order is subject to specific regulatory mandates (e.g., FCC MNP porting deadlines, emergency service provisioning, Ofcom consumer protection rules). Regulatory orders receive elevated priority and mandatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Consumer Protection Rules; BEREC Regulatory Framework; NTIA

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order record was last updated in the order management system. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: mnp_recipient_operator_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Recipient Operator Code
attributes.description: For MNP_PORT_OUT orders: the network operator code of the recipient (gaining) operator to whom the mobile number is being ported. Used for inter-operator coordination and MNP regulatory reporting. Null for non-MNP order types.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA MNP Guidelines; BEREC MNP Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the fulfillment order, entered by agents, customers, or automated systems. May include customer preferences, access instructions for field technicians, or escalation context. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: The sales or service channel through which the fulfillment order was submitted. Used for channel performance analytics, cost-to-serve analysis, and omnichannel reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ONLINE|RETAIL_STORE|CALL_CENTER|DEALER|SELF_SERVICE|B2B_PORTAL|FIELD_SALES — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Channel Management; Salesforce CRM Lead Management

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the fulfillment order. Communicated to customers, field technicians, and partner systems. Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) as the canonical order reference number.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: order_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the fulfillment order, influencing queue position in orchestration workflows and resource allocation. CRITICAL is reserved for regulatory-mandated orders (e.g., emergency services, MNP regulatory deadlines).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; FCC Emergency Communications Regulations

attributes.name: order_source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or application from which the fulfillment order was submitted. Used for channel attribution, integration troubleshooting, and data lineage tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSM|SALESFORCE_CRM|SELF_SERVICE_PORTAL|B2B_PORTAL|DEALER_PORTAL|IVR|RETAIL_POS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; Oracle Communications OSM; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fulfillment order within the OSS/BSS orchestration workflow. Drives jeopardy management, SLA monitoring, and customer communication triggers. Sourced from Oracle Communications OSM order state machine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM Order Lifecycle

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment order by the nature of the service change being requested. Drives orchestration workflow selection, SLA type assignment, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NEW_ACTIVATION|UPGRADE|DOWNGRADE|DISCONNECTION|MNP_PORT_IN|MNP_PORT_OUT|CHANGE_OF_SERVICE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; 3GPP TS 22.011 MNP; Oracle Communications OSM Order Types

attributes.name: porting_authorization_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Porting Authorization Code (PAC)
attributes.description: The Porting Authorization Code provided by the donor operator to authorize the number port. Required for MNP_PORT_IN orders to validate the customer's right to port. Null for non-MNP order types.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom MNP Code of Practice; GSMA MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_number
attributes.description: The MSISDN (mobile phone number) being ported in MNP_PORT_IN or MNP_PORT_OUT orders. Classified as confidential PII as it directly identifies a subscriber. Null for non-MNP order types. Required for NRTRDE and TAP regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA NRTRDE; GDPR Article 4; GSMA MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: promised_completion_date
attributes.description: The date committed to the customer for order fulfillment completion. Used for SLA breach detection, customer communication, and regulatory compliance reporting. Distinct from SLA target hours — this is the customer-facing commitment date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Service Provisioning Rules; BEREC Quality of Service Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_code
attributes.description: The specific regulatory rule, mandate, or case reference code applicable to this fulfillment order when is_regulatory_order is True. Examples: FCC MNP case number, Ofcom compliance reference. Used for regulatory audit trails and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines; BEREC Regulatory Framework

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of telecommunications service being provisioned or modified by this fulfillment order. Drives workflow template selection, resource inventory allocation, and regulatory reporting categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIBER|IPTV|VOIP|FIXED_LINE|IOT|ENTERPRISE_WAN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Service Catalog; ITU-T Service Classification; Netcracker OSS/BSS Service Catalog

attributes.name: sla_breach_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed from SLA measurement start at which the SLA is formally classified as BREACHED. Typically equals sla_target_hours but may differ for grace-period configurations. Triggers regulatory reporting obligations and penalty calculations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fulfillment order SLA was formally breached. Null for orders that have not breached. Used for regulatory reporting, penalty calculation, and SLA performance analytics. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_measurement_end_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement End Event
attributes.description: The business event that stops the SLA measurement clock for this fulfillment order. Defines what constitutes successful completion for SLA purposes — e.g., SERVICE_ACTIVATED for mobile activations, CPE_INSTALLED for FTTH orders.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Service Provisioning Rules; BEREC Quality of Service Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_measurement_start_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Event
attributes.description: The business event that triggers the start of SLA measurement clock for this fulfillment order. Varies by order type and SLA type — regulatory MNP orders typically start at ORDER_ACCEPTED, while commercial orders may start at PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC MNP Porting Rules; GSMA MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the SLA measurement clock started for this fulfillment order, corresponding to the sla_measurement_start_event. Used as the reference point for all SLA elapsed-time calculations and regulatory compliance measurement. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC MNP Porting Rules

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current SLA compliance status of the fulfillment order based on elapsed time versus SLA thresholds. ON_TRACK: within warning threshold. AT_RISK: between warning and breach thresholds. BREACHED: exceeded breach threshold. Primary field for jeopardy detection and regulatory compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; TM Forum eTOM Jeopardy Management; FCC Telecommunications Regulations

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which the fulfillment order must be completed to meet the SLA commitment. Measured from the SLA measurement start event. Used for jeopardy detection and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Service Provisioning Rules; BEREC Quality of Service Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA commitment governing this fulfillment order. REGULATORY: mandated by FCC/Ofcom/BEREC regulations (e.g., MNP porting windows). COMMERCIAL: standard commercial SLA per product tier. ENTERPRISE: premium SLA for enterprise/B2B customers.
attributes.references: FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines; BEREC Quality of Service; TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management

attributes.name: sla_warning_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed from SLA measurement start at which an AT_RISK warning is triggered for proactive jeopardy management. Must be less than sla_target_hours. Drives automated alerting in NOC and order management dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; TM Forum eTOM Jeopardy Management

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fulfillment order was submitted by the customer or agent into the order management system. This is the principal business event timestamp and the anchor point for SLA measurement start calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: workflow_template_name
attributes.description: The name of the OSM workflow template (order specification) used to orchestrate this fulfillment order. Determines the decomposition strategy, task sequence, and system interactions. Examples: 'MOBILE_NEW_ACTIVATION_V3', 'FTTH_PROVISIONING_V2'.

attributes.name: contract_term_months

attributes.name: cpe_serial_number

attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: decomposition_state

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: early_termination_fee
attributes.description: The early termination fee amount applicable if the customer cancels this order line before the end of the contract_term_months. Calculated at order capture based on the rate plan and contract term. Used by Amdocs Revenue Management for billing upon disconnection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: fallout_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the order line fallout or failure, supplementing the fallout_reason_code. Captured by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management workflow engine for manual intervention and customer communication.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3.4

attributes.name: fallout_reason_code

attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3.4

attributes.name: iccid

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity assigned to the SIM for this order line. Used for subscriber provisioning in HSS (Home Subscriber Server) and UDM (Unified Data Management) systems. Restricted PII as it uniquely identifies a mobile subscriber globally.

attributes.name: is_esim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line involves an eSIM (Embedded SIM) provisioning rather than a physical SIM card. When TRUE, triggers eSIM profile download orchestration via GSMA SGP.22 RSP (Remote SIM Provisioning) instead of physical SIM dispatch.

attributes.name: is_mnp_line

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: line_number

attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle state of this individual order line. Tracks granular progress independently from the parent order header status, enabling partial fulfillment scenarios where some lines complete while others are held. Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management workflow engine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework 1.4.3

attributes.name: mnp_reference_number

attributes.name: net_price

attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: priority

HIGH and CRITICAL priorities are used for enterprise SLA orders, regulatory-mandated activations, and emergency service restorations. Drives scheduling in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the product or service being ordered on this line (e.g., '5G Unlimited Plan', 'FTTH 1Gbps Broadband', 'VoLTE Add-On'). Denormalized from the product catalog for operational reporting and customer-facing order confirmations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog

attributes.name: product_type

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIXED_LINE|IPTV|VOIP|IOT|ENTERPRISE|ADD_ON — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: requested_start_date

attributes.name: requires_field_visit

attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog; Amdocs Revenue Management

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of every state transition and post-submission amendment for a fulfillment order throughout its lifecycle — from SUBMITTED through VALIDATED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_PROVISIONING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, or FALLOUT. For state transitions: records previous state, new state, transition timestamp, triggering actor (system or user), and reason code. For amendments: records amendment type (appointment change, product selection change, address change, service configuration change), original value, new value, amendment request timestamp, amendment status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPLIED), approving agent reference, impact assessment (SLA reset flag, cost delta), and override justification. This is the SSOT for all order change history — both system-driven state transitions and customer/agent-initiated amendments. Essential for SLA measurement, fallout root-cause analysis, dispute resolution, and regulatory audit trails required by FCC and BEREC.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderStateChange

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order status history record. Primary key of the order_status_history data product. Immutable once assigned.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.amendment. Business justification: The status_history table explicitly tracks post-submission amendments — it has amendment_type, amendment_status, amended_field_name, amendment_request_timestamp, cost_delta, original_value, and new_va

attributes.name: appointment_id

Linking to the govern

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to a ServiceNow ITSM trouble ticket or incident raised in association with this state transition or amendment (e.g., a FALLOUT event that triggered an incident). Null when no ticket is associated. Supports cross-system traceability for fault management.

attributes.name: workflow_task_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific workflow task or orchestration step within Oracle Communications Order and Service Management that generated this history record. Enables traceability from the history record back to the originating workflow execution for technical root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: actor_system
attributes.description: Name of the OSS/BSS system that originated the transition or amendment event (e.g., Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow ITSM). Enables source-system traceability for fallout root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Resource Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: actor_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of actor that triggered the state transition or amendment. SYSTEM indicates an automated OSS/BSS process; AGENT indicates a human CSR or field technician; CUSTOMER indicates a self-service action; SUPERVISOR indicates a management override; AUTOMATED_RULE indicates a policy engine or workflow rule.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party Interaction; eTOM Process Framework; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: amended_field_name
attributes.description: For amendment records, the logical name of the order attribute that was changed (e.g., installation_address, appointment_date, selected_product_id, service_configuration_value). Provides context for interpreting original_value and new_value. Null for state transition records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the amendment was formally requested by the customer or agent. Distinct from transition_timestamp (which records when the event was processed). Used to measure amendment processing lead time and SLA compliance. Null for state transition records. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the amendment request. PENDING: awaiting review; APPROVED: authorized but not yet applied to the order; REJECTED: denied by agent or system rule; APPLIED: successfully incorporated into the active order. Null for state transition records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: For amendment records, classifies the type of post-submission change requested. Null for state transition records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: APPOINTMENT_CHANGE|PRODUCT_SELECTION_CHANGE|ADDRESS_CHANGE|SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE|CONTACT_CHANGE|PAYMENT_METHOD_CHANGE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: cost_delta
attributes.description: For amendment records, the incremental cost impact (positive or negative, in the account currency) resulting from the amendment — e.g., a product selection change that increases or decreases the order value. Null for state transition records and zero-cost amendments. Used for revenue assurance and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO 4217

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this history record was first written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from transition_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data pipeline monitoring, late-arrival detection, and audit trail completeness verification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the cost_delta amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null when cost_delta is null. Supports multi-currency operations across international markets.

attributes.name: duration_in_state_seconds
attributes.description: Number of seconds the order spent in the previous_state before transitioning to new_state. Calculated at ingestion time as the difference between this record's transition_timestamp and the prior record's transition_timestamp for the same order. Used for SLA bottleneck analysis and process mining.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; eTOM Process Framework; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: fallout_category
attributes.description: When new_state is FALLOUT, classifies the root-cause category of the fallout event (e.g., PROVISIONING_FAILURE, CREDIT_REJECTION, ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAILURE, MNP_REJECTION, NETWORK_CAPACITY, SYSTEM_ERROR). Null for non-FALLOUT transitions. Essential for fallout root-cause analysis and NOC/OSS remediation workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: fallout_resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating how a FALLOUT condition was resolved (e.g., AUTO_RETRY_SUCCESS, MANUAL_INTERVENTION, ORDER_CANCELLED, REROUTED_TO_ALTERNATE_RESOURCE). Populated when transitioning out of FALLOUT state. Null for non-FALLOUT records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this history record is subject to regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., FCC order completion reporting, BEREC quality-of-service metrics, OFCOM service provisioning KPIs). True flags records that must be included in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Reporting Requirements; BEREC Guidelines; Ofcom Reporting Requirements; NTIA

attributes.name: mnp_reference_number
attributes.description: For MNP port-in or port-out order types, the inter-operator MNP reference number assigned by the number portability clearinghouse. Null for non-MNP orders. Required for GSMA MNP compliance reporting and inter-carrier dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA MNP Guidelines; 3GPP TS 22.011; FCC Number Portability Rules; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: new_state
attributes.description: The order lifecycle state entered as a result of this transition. For amendment records, reflects the order state at the time the amendment was recorded. Valid states include SUBMITTED, VALIDATED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_PROVISIONING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FALLOUT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SUBMITTED|VALIDATED|IN_PROGRESS|PENDING_PROVISIONING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|FALLOUT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: For amendment records, the proposed or applied new value for the amended field (serialized as string for flexibility across amendment types). Null for state transition records. Paired with original_value to provide a complete before/after audit record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: For amendment records, the value of the amended field before the change was applied (serialized as string for flexibility across amendment types). Null for state transition records. Supports dispute resolution and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a standard business rule, credit policy, or SLA policy was overridden to process this transition or amendment. When True, override_justification must be populated. Supports compliance monitoring and exception reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: override_justification
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by a supervisor or authorized agent when a standard business rule or SLA policy is overridden to approve an amendment or force a state transition. Required for compliance audit trails when override_flag is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: previous_state
attributes.description: The order lifecycle state immediately before this transition occurred. Null for the initial SUBMITTED state entry. Valid states include SUBMITTED, VALIDATED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_PROVISIONING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FALLOUT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SUBMITTED|VALIDATED|IN_PROGRESS|PENDING_PROVISIONING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|FALLOUT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the state transition or amendment (e.g., CREDIT_CHECK_FAILED, PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT, CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_CANCEL, MNP_PORT_DELAY, NETWORK_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE). Used for fallout root-cause analysis and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the state transition or amendment reason, supplementing the structured reason_code. May include agent notes, system error messages, or customer-provided explanations captured at the time of the event.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this history record captures a state transition (order lifecycle state change) or a post-submission amendment (customer or agent-initiated change to order attributes). Drives downstream processing logic and reporting segmentation.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing integer representing the chronological order of history records for a given order_id. Sequence 1 is the initial SUBMITTED state entry. attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: sla_reset_flag

True when the SLA measurement window is restarted (e.g., due to a customer-requested amendment or a FALLOUT recovery). Critical for accurate SLA compliance reporting to FCC and BEREC.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: sla_target_timestamp
attributes.description: The committed SLA completion deadline applicable at the time of this history record. If sla_reset_flag is True, this reflects the recalculated SLA target post-reset. Enables point-in-time SLA compliance measurement and regulatory reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or event identifier of this record in the originating source system (e.g., the Oracle Communications Order and Service Management order history event ID). Enables reverse traceability from the Silver Layer back to the operational system for reconciliation and reprocessing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this history record was sourced (e.g., Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite, Salesforce CRM). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the state transition or amendment event occurred. This is the principal business event timestamp used for SLA measurement, fallout root-cause analysis, and regulatory audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this history record was last modified in the Silver Layer (e.g., due to a late-arriving amendment status update or correction). For a fully immutable audit trail, updates should be rare and logged. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; ISO/IEC 27001

products.name: task
products.description: Granular decomposed work task generated by OSM order orchestration engine from a specific order line during order decomposition. Represents both the decomposition mapping (tracing commercial order line to lower-level service/resource/network orders) and the atomic fulfillment execution step (HLR/HSS provisioning, IP address assignment, CPE dispatch, GPON ONT activation, number portability submission). Captures parent order line reference, decomposition rule applied, child system target, child order type (service_order, resource_order, network_order), task type, execution sequence, dependency chain, start time, completion time, retry count, task-level status, synchronisation status with downstream systems, creation timestamp, and fallout detail. Provides full decomposition traceability from commercial order line through orchestration logic to network provisioning action — serving as the SSOT for both order decomposition mapping and task execution within this domain.

attributes.name: resubmission_timestamp

attributes.name: retry_count

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis

attributes.name: sla_breach_timestamp

attributes.name: sla_breached

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: sub_category

attributes.description: Human-readable description of the failure reason as returned by the target OSS system or populated by the OSM orchestration layer. Provides operational context for NOC engineers and support teams investigating provisioning failures.

attributes.description: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier (ICCID) — the unique serial number of the SIM or eSIM card — associated with this provisioning request. Used to link the provisioning action to the physical or embedded SIM being activated.

attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) — a unique 15-digit identifier stored on the SIM/eSIM — being provisioned in the HLR/HSS/UDM. Applicable for mobile service activations and MNP port-in operations. Classified as restricted PII as it uniquely identifies a subscriber.

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of retry attempts configured for this provisioning request before it is escalated or marked as permanently failed. Derived from the service type SLA policy at the time of request creation.

attributes.name: mnp_port_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which the Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in or port-out is to be executed. Applicable only when provisioning_action is PORT_IN or PORT_OUT. Governed by national MNP regulatory timelines.

attributes.name: ont_serial_number

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this provisioning request, determining queue position and resource allocation in the OSM orchestration engine. CRITICAL: emergency/regulatory-mandated; HIGH: premium customer or SLA-sensitive; MEDIUM: standard commercial; LOW: batch/bulk provisioning.

attributes.name: provisioning_action
attributes.description: The type of provisioning operation to be performed on the target OSS system. ACTIVATE: new service activation; MODIFY: change of service parameters; DEACTIVATE: service disconnection; SUSPEND: temporary service suspension; RESUME: reinstatement after suspension; PORT_IN: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) inbound port; PORT_OUT: MNP outbound port. attributes.name: provisioning_outcome
attributes.description: Final result of the provisioning execution as reported by the target OSS system. SUCCESS: service fully activated/modified/deactivated as requested; FAILURE: provisioning could not be completed; TIMEOUT: target system did not respond within the configured timeout window; PARTIAL: some but not all service components were provisioned (e.g., multi-component service). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category for non-monetary transactions.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the provisioning request as generated by Oracle Communications OSM (e.g., PROV-2024-0001234). Used for cross-system traceability across OSS/BSS platforms. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.

attributes.description: Reference to the parent order or pre-order request that triggered this service qualification check in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Null if the qualification was initiated as a standalone eligibility check outside of a formal order.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; Oracle OSM

attributes.name: managed_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Re-qualification or upgrade of an existing managed service requires linking the qualification record to the managed service being assessed. Enables managed service upgrade eligibility reporting and te

attributes.name: mvno_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.mvno_profile. Business justification: MVNO service qualifications must check MVNO-specific constraints: subscriber capacity limits, IMSI/MSISDN range availability, spectrum access rights, and technical capabilities - required for MVNO sub

attributes.name: olt_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.olt_asset. Business justification: Fiber service qualification checks OLT port capacity and operational status before committing to a fiber service offer. Direct reference to the serving OLT asset is required for capacity management, q

attributes.name: product_offering_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product offering in the Netcracker Product Catalog for which eligibility is being assessed. Drives which product offers are surfaced to the sales agent or digital channel upon a positive qualification outcome.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Product Catalog; TMF620 Product Catalog Management API

attributes.name: ran_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.ran_cell. Business justification: Mobile service qualification identifies serving cell, measures signal strength, and validates capacity availability. Critical pre-sale process for determining mobile service eligibility and setting cu

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: service_qualification.broadband_subsidy_eligible and regulatory_zone_code indicate qualifications governed by regulatory obligations (universal service, broadband subsidy programs). Linking to the gov

attributes.name: sdwan_topology_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.sdwan_topology. Business justification: Network infrastructure readiness qualification for SD-WAN topology deployment (bandwidth availability, latency assessment, underlay transport options) must reference the SD-WAN topology. Enables topol

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.enterprise_site. Business justification: Service qualification for enterprise customers is performed against a specific physical site. Site-level qualification drives field survey scheduling, infrastructure readiness assessment, and installa

attributes.name: slice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.slice. Business justification: Service qualification for 5G slice services checks whether a specific slice type and configuration is available in the coverage area. Pre-sales qualification for enterprise slice offerings must refere

attributes.name: survey_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: When field_survey_required=true on a service qualification, a technician is dispatched for a pre-sales site survey. Telecom pre-sales operations track which technician conducted the survey to link sur

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Fixed broadband and leased-line service qualification checks capacity and availability on a specific transmission link. Pre-sales and order entry teams query transmission link status and utilization t

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the customer premises being qualified for service. Captured at qualification time as a point-in-time snapshot to avoid dependency on address master changes post-qualification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; TM Forum TMF673 Geographic Address Management API

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (apartment, suite, floor, unit number) of the customer premises being qualified. Nullable for single-dwelling units.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; TM Forum TMF673 Geographic Address Management API

attributes.name: available_technology_options
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of all access technologies technically available at the qualified address (e.g., 'FTTH|LTE|5G_NR'). Enables the sales system to present all eligible product offers, not just the primary requested technology. Sourced from Netcracker Resource Inventory network coverage data.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: broadband_subsidy_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service address qualifies for government broadband subsidy programs (e.g., FCC Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP), NTIA BEAD, UK Gigabit Voucher Scheme). Determined based on regulatory_zone_code and address-level coverage data. Relevant for compliance reporting to FCC, NTIA, and Ofcom.
attributes.references: FCC Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP); NTIA BEAD Program; Ofcom Gigabit Voucher Scheme; BEREC

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the service installation address. Used for geographic coverage reporting and network rollout planning analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF673 Geographic Address Management API; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: constraint_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any technical or operational constraints identified during the qualification check when the outcome is ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS. Examples: 'Maximum speed limited to 100 Mbps due to copper loop length', 'CPE upgrade required', 'Shared GPON port — peak-hour congestion possible'. Null when outcome is ELIGIBLE or NOT_ELIGIBLE.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the service installation address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Required for multi-country operators and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: cpe_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) installation or upgrade is required to deliver the requested service at the qualified address. True: CPE installation/upgrade is mandatory; False: existing CPE is compatible or no CPE is needed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Oracle OSM Service Fulfillment

attributes.name: cpe_type
attributes.description: Type of CPE required for service delivery at the qualified address. ONT (Optical Network Terminal) for FTTH/GPON; ROUTER for broadband; MODEM for DSL; GATEWAY for combined modem/router; OUTDOOR_UNIT/INDOOR_UNIT for fixed wireless. Null when cpe_required is False.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.984.2 (ONT/GPON); TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this service qualification record was first persisted in the Silver layer data product. Populated by the ingestion pipeline from Oracle OSM source system.

attributes.name: estimated_installation_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days from order confirmation to service activation at the qualified address. Derived from field workforce availability (Granite WFM), infrastructure readiness, and network node capacity. Displayed to customers during the ordering flow to set delivery expectations.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — Service Fulfillment; Oracle OSM Order Orchestration; Granite WFM

attributes.name: estimated_latency_ms
attributes.description: Estimated round-trip network latency in milliseconds at the qualified address for the requested service type. Relevant for QoS-sensitive product offers (VoLTE, gaming, enterprise SD-WAN) and SLA eligibility determination.
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1541 (QoS); 3GPP TS 22.261; TM Forum SLA Management

attributes.name: field_survey_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical field survey by a Telecommunication technician is required before service can be provisioned at this address. True when infrastructure readiness is PARTIAL or NOT_READY, or when the qualification engine cannot determine feasibility remotely. Triggers a field dispatch work order in Granite WFM.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — Service Fulfillment; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: ineligibility_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the address is NOT_ELIGIBLE for the requested service. NO_COVERAGE: outside network footprint; CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED: node at full capacity; INFRASTRUCTURE_NOT_BUILT: planned but not yet deployed; ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND: address could not be geocoded or matched; TECHNICAL_BARRIER: physical impediment; REGULATORY_RESTRICTION: regulatory constraint. Null when outcome is ELIGIBLE or ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; FCC Broadband Data Collection

attributes.name: infrastructure_readiness
attributes.description: Indicates the physical network infrastructure readiness at or near the service address. READY: full infrastructure in place; PARTIAL: partial build-out, service possible with constraints; NOT_READY: no infrastructure present; UNDER_CONSTRUCTION: active network build in progress with a planned completion date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent update to this service qualification record in the Silver layer. Updated on any status change, outcome determination, or data correction.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the service installation point. Used for precise network coverage mapping, field dispatch routing via Granite WFM, and FCC broadband location fabric matching.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection — Location Fabric; WGS84; NTIA BroadbandUSA

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the service installation point. Used in conjunction with latitude for geospatial coverage analysis and network node proximity calculations.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection — Location Fabric; WGS84; NTIA BroadbandUSA

attributes.name: max_download_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum technically achievable downstream bandwidth in Megabits per second (Mbps) at the qualified address, as determined by the network qualification engine based on distance to node, line quality, and technology capability. Drives product tier eligibility in the sales flow.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection; ITU-T G.9700 (G.fast); 3GPP TS 38.306 (5G NR); ETSI TS 101 388 (ADSL)

attributes.name: max_upload_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum technically achievable upstream bandwidth in Megabits per second (Mbps) at the qualified address. Critical for symmetric service offerings (FTTH/GPON) and business-grade SLA commitments.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection; ITU-T G.984 (GPON); 3GPP TS 38.306 (5G NR)

attributes.name: mnp_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Mobile Number Portability (MNP) is applicable to this service qualification, relevant for mobile service types (LTE, 5G NR) where the customer intends to port an existing number. True triggers MNP eligibility checks in the downstream order flow.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — Mobile Number Portability; FCC MNP Rules 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or remarks added by the sales agent, network engineer, or automated qualification engine to provide additional context about the qualification result. May include special instructions for the field team, customer-specific considerations, or escalation notes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle OSM

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the service installation address. Key dimension for network coverage gap analysis, FCC broadband availability reporting, and NTIA compliance.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC); NTIA BroadbandUSA; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: qualification_channel
attributes.description: The sales or service channel through which the qualification request was initiated. ONLINE: digital self-service portal; RETAIL_STORE: in-store agent; CALL_CENTER: inbound/outbound agent via Salesforce CRM; PARTNER_API: wholesale or MVNO partner API; FIELD_AGENT: mobile field sales; SELF_SERVICE: automated IVR or chatbot.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — Customer Relationship Management; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: qualification_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the qualification check was fully resolved and an outcome was determined. Null if the qualification is still IN_PROGRESS or was CANCELLED before completion.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; ISO 8601

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the qualification result is considered stale and must be re-evaluated before an order can be placed. Network conditions, capacity, and infrastructure status can change; this date enforces re-qualification for orders placed after a defined validity window (typically 30–90 days).
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; Oracle OSM Order Orchestration

attributes.name: qualification_outcome
attributes.description: Business result of the pre-order service qualification check. ELIGIBLE: the address/location can receive the requested service without restriction; NOT_ELIGIBLE: service cannot be delivered to this location; ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS: service is technically feasible but subject to limitations (e.g., reduced bandwidth, extended lead time, CPE upgrade required).
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; ETSI TS 103 221

attributes.name: qualification_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the qualification request by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM). Used by sales agents and customers to track the qualification check.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TMF645 Service Qualification API

attributes.name: qualification_request_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the qualification request was submitted by the sales or ordering system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; ISO 8601

attributes.name: qualification_source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system that submitted the qualification request. OSM: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; SALESFORCE: Salesforce CRM; NETCRACKER: Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite; PARTNER_PORTAL: wholesale/MVNO partner portal; SELF_SERVICE_PORTAL: customer-facing digital portal. Used for data lineage and system-of-record traceability.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Data Lineage; Oracle OSM; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the qualification request workflow within Oracle OSM. IN_PROGRESS: check is being executed; COMPLETED: outcome determined; FAILED: system error prevented completion; CANCELLED: request withdrawn before completion.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: regulatory_zone_code
attributes.description: Regulatory or geographic zone code assigned to the service address, used to determine applicable regulatory obligations (e.g., FCC Universal Service Fund (USF) eligible area, NTIA BEAD-eligible zone, Ofcom Universal Service Obligation (USO) area, BEREC regulated zone). Drives compliance reporting and subsidy eligibility.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund (USF); NTIA BEAD Program; Ofcom USO; BEREC; ITU-T D.50

attributes.name: requalification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification result has been flagged as requiring re-execution before an order can proceed. Set to True when the qualification_expiry_date has passed, when network topology changes have occurred in the serving area, or when the customer requests a different service type.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; Oracle OSM

attributes.name: requested_service_type
attributes.description: The access technology or service type for which eligibility is being assessed. Values align with the network technologies offered by Telecommunication: FTTH (Fiber to the Home), GPON (Gigabit Passive Optical Network), LTE (Long-Term Evolution), 5G NR (5G New Radio), ADSL, VDSL, FTTB (Fiber to the Building), FTTC (Fiber to the Cabinet), FIXED_WIRELESS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTTH|GPON|LTE|5G_NR|ADSL|VDSL|FTTB|FTTC|FIXED_WIRELESS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.261; ITU-T G.984 (GPON); ETSI TS 136 300 (LTE); 3GPP TS 38.300 (5G NR); ITU-T G.992 (ADSL/VDSL)

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Measured or predicted radio signal strength in dBm at the qualified address for wireless service types (LTE, 5G NR, Fixed Wireless). Null for wireline technologies. Sourced from Ericsson Network Manager RAN coverage data or Nokia NetAct RF planning tools.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 36.214 (LTE RSRP); 3GPP TS 38.215 (5G NR RSRP); ITU-R M.2135

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the service installation address. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping (FCC, NTIA) and regional network coverage analytics.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection; NTIA BroadbandUSA; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: survey_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the field survey is scheduled to be conducted at the customer premises, when field_survey_required is True. Populated by Granite WFM upon technician dispatch scheduling. Null when no survey is required.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM

products.name: appointment
products.description: Field technician installation or service appointment record associated with a fulfillment order requiring on-site work — FTTH/GPON installation, CPE swap, ONT replacement, or enterprise circuit commissioning. Captures appointment type, scheduled date and time window, customer address, assigned technician reference (linked to workforce domain), appointment status (SCHEDULED, CONFIRMED, COMPLETED, MISSED, RESCHEDULED), customer confirmation flag, and completion notes. Integrates with Granite Telecommunications WFM for dispatch.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Appointment (TMF646) / Granite WFM

attributes.name: appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the field technician appointment record within the order fulfillment domain. Primary key for the appointment data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order & Fulfillment Domain

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom the on-site appointment is being conducted. Enables customer-centric reporting and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Domain; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_contact. Business justification: Field appointments require a specific authorized contact at the premises for access and sign-off. The denormalized customer_contact_name and customer_contact_phone fields should be replaced by a prope

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.depot. Business justification: Appointments are scheduled from depots managing technician territories and service zones. Essential for capacity planning, technician assignment optimization, and tracking which facility supports cust

attributes.name: device_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.device_model. Business justification: Field technician appointment preparation: technicians need the specific device model to bring correct equipment, firmware, and installation tools. cpe_model is a denormalized device model reference; r

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that triggered this appointment. Links the appointment to the end-to-end order lifecycle managed in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: inventory_cpe_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cpe_asset. Business justification: Field appointments install or swap specific CPE devices at customer premises. Real business need: technician dispatch with correct device, installation verification, asset tracking, warranty activatio

attributes.name: managed_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Field appointments for managed service installations, maintenance windows, and fault resolution must be linked to the managed service for SLA measurement, change window compliance, and managed service

attributes.name: network_equipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.network_equipment. Business justification: Appointments for network equipment installation, maintenance, or replacement at enterprise sites or exchange locations reference the specific inventory asset. Required for maintenance scheduling, asse

attributes.name: noc_incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to a ServiceNow ITSM incident record associated with this appointment, if the appointment was triggered by or resulted in a fault management incident. Enables cross-domain traceability between order fulfillment and fault management.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6 — Fault Management

attributes.name: ont_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.ont_asset. Business justification: Fiber installation appointments reference the specific ONT asset to be installed at the customer premises. Technicians need direct ONT asset reference for pre-staging, configuration preparation, and p

attributes.name: ran_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.ran_cell. Business justification: Field appointments for RAN cell installation, antenna alignment, or cell site maintenance reference the specific cell. Workforce scheduling and dispatch for cell site visits require cell-level appoint

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: Field appointments for enterprise customers target specific sites. Critical for technician dispatch, site access coordination, site contact management, and tracking installation history per location.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.svc_instance. Business justification: A field appointment is scheduled to install, repair, or upgrade a specific service instance. Linking appointment to svc_instance enables field operations to track which service a technician visit addr

attributes.name: team_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.team. Business justification: Complex telecom installations (fiber, enterprise) require crew-based appointments assigned to a team rather than a single technician. Field operations scheduling and team capacity planning require lin

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned field technician from the workforce domain. Populated by Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management (WFM) during dispatch scheduling.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Field appointments for transmission link installation, fiber splicing, or leased-line commissioning reference the specific link. Technician dispatch and appointment scheduling for fixed-line work requ

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.trouble_ticket. Business justification: Field appointments are frequently scheduled to resolve trouble tickets — technician dispatched to fix reported service fault. Telecom field operations require linking appointments to originating troub

attributes.name: access_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for the field technician to gain access to the customer premises (e.g., gate codes, building manager contact, parking instructions, safety requirements). Critical for enterprise and multi-dwelling unit installations.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum SID GB922 — Geographic Address

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the field technician arrived at the customer premises. Compared against scheduled_start_time to measure on-time arrival performance and SLA adherence.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM; FCC Broadband Performance Standards

attributes.name: actual_completion_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the field technician completed the on-site work and closed the appointment. Used to calculate job duration, MTTR (Mean Time to Repair), and workforce productivity metrics.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM; KPI: MTTR

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes taken to complete the on-site work, calculated from actual_arrival_time to actual_completion_time. Used for workforce productivity analysis and future duration estimation model training.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM; KPI: MTTR

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable appointment reference number communicated to the customer and field technician. Follows the format APT-NNNNNNNNNN. Used in customer notifications, WFM dispatch sheets, and trouble ticket references.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the appointment. Drives downstream workflow actions: SCHEDULED (created, not yet confirmed), CONFIRMED (customer acknowledged), COMPLETED (work done), MISSED (technician or customer no-show), RESCHEDULED (new slot assigned), CANCELLED (appointment voided).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment Entity; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the on-site work to be performed. Drives technician skill matching, equipment pre-staging, and estimated duration in WFM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTTH_INSTALLATION|GPON_INSTALLATION|CPE_SWAP|ONT_REPLACEMENT|ENTERPRISE_CIRCUIT_COMMISSIONING|FAULT_REPAIR|UPGRADE|DOWNGRADE|DISCONNECTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6 — Service Problem Management; FTTH Council; ITU-T G.984 GPON

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the field technician upon appointment completion. Captures work performed, issues encountered, materials used, and any follow-up actions required. Populated when appointment_status is COMPLETED.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management

attributes.name: confirmation_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer confirmed the appointment. Supports omnichannel analytics and confirmation effectiveness reporting. Populated only when customer_confirmed is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Interaction; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer confirmed the appointment. Populated only when customer_confirmed is True. Used for lead-time analysis and confirmation workflow SLA measurement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: cpe_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the specific CPE or ONT unit assigned for installation or replacement. Enables asset tracking, warranty management, and post-installation inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appointment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with data governance and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: customer_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has explicitly confirmed the scheduled appointment. True = confirmed by customer; False = not yet confirmed. Drives automated reminder workflows and no-show risk scoring.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: dispatch_work_order_number
attributes.description: External work order reference number generated by Granite Telecommunications WFM upon technician dispatch. Used to cross-reference appointment records with WFM dispatch sheets and field activity logs.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to complete the on-site work. Derived from appointment type and technology type during WFM scheduling. Used for route optimization and technician capacity planning.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Route Optimization; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: follow_up_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why a follow-up appointment or action is required. Populated only when follow_up_required is True. Used for work order creation and technician briefing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up appointment or action is required after this appointment. True = follow-up needed (e.g., incomplete installation, pending network provisioning). Triggers creation of a new appointment or trouble ticket.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; ServiceNow ITSM — Problem Management; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appointment record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: missed_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the appointment was missed. Populated only when appointment_status is MISSED. Used for SLA breach analysis, customer compensation workflows, and workforce accountability reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; FCC Broadband Service Standards; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the appointment, influencing scheduling queue position and technician dispatch urgency. CRITICAL is reserved for enterprise SLA-bound circuits and regulatory commitments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment Priority; FCC Broadband Service Standards; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: reschedule_count
attributes.description: Number of times this appointment has been rescheduled. Tracks appointment instability, customer experience impact, and operational efficiency. High reschedule counts may trigger escalation workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM; KPI: FCR (First Call Resolution)

attributes.name: reschedule_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the most recent reschedule of this appointment. Populated when appointment_status is RESCHEDULED. Used for root cause analysis and operational improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_REQUEST|TECHNICIAN_UNAVAILABLE|WEATHER|EQUIPMENT_NOT_READY|ACCESS_ISSUE|NETWORK_DEPENDENCY|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the field technician appointment is scheduled to occur. Used for day-level planning, route optimization, and customer communication.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the appointment window is scheduled to end. Defines the committed service window communicated to the customer and used for SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Broadband Service Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the appointment window is scheduled to begin. Used for technician dispatch, customer notification, and SLA (Service Level Agreement) measurement.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Dispatch; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Broadband Service Standards

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer service segment for which the appointment is being conducted. Drives SLA tier assignment, technician skill requirements, and regulatory reporting categorization.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Service Classification; FCC Broadband Data Collection

Enables real-time SLA monitoring and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.noc_incident. Business justification: SLA clocks are suspended during NOC-declared network incidents in telecom. order.sla has clock_suspended and suspension_reason fields indicating this scenario. Linking to the noc_incident enables accu

Telcos must link SLA definitions to their regulatory source for
