attributes.name: sla_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.sla_profile. Business justification: An order SLA commitment is governed by the service SLA profile tier (e.g., Gold, Platinum) associated with the ordered service. Linking order.sla to service.sla_profile enables SLA compliance reportin

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Order-level SLAs for leased-line and fixed broadband services are tied to the specific transmission link. SLA measurement, breach detection, and regulatory reporting for fixed-line services require kn

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.work_order. Business justification: SLA breach root-cause analysis in telecom requires direct linkage between an SLA record and the work order responsible for field execution delays. SLA compliance reporting and penalty calculation depe

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Actual Completion Timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the measurement_end_event occurred, marking fulfillment of the order. Null if the order has not yet been completed. Used to compute final SLA outcome (met or breached) for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: breach_notification_sent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Notification Sent Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal breach notification has been dispatched to the customer and/or regulatory authority (True) following a BREACHED status. Required for compliance with FCC, Ofcom, and BEREC breach reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: breach_notification_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Notification Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the breach notification was sent to the customer and/or regulatory authority. Null if no notification has been sent. Used to verify compliance with mandatory notification timeframes.
attributes.references: FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: breach_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of elapsed hours from the measurement start event at which the SLA is formally classified as BREACHED. May equal target_completion_hours or include a grace period defined in the contract or regulatory instrument.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the SLA was formally classified as BREACHED (i.e., elapsed hours exceeded breach_threshold_hours). Null if the SLA has not been breached. Critical for regulatory penalty calculations and breach notification obligations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: Defines how elapsed time is measured for this SLA: CALENDAR_HOURS (24x7 clock), BUSINESS_HOURS (measured only during defined business operating hours), or BUSINESS_DAYS (measured in working days). Determines how target_completion_timestamp is calculated.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: clock_suspended
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Clock Suspended Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA measurement clock is currently paused (True) due to a customer hold, third-party dependency, or regulatory exclusion event. When True, elapsed_hours accumulation is halted until the clock is resumed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this SLA record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty_credit_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures multi-currency support for international operations.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The customer segment to which the order and SLA apply: CONSUMER (residential), SMB (Small and Medium Business), ENTERPRISE (large corporate), WHOLESALE (carrier/partner), or MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator). Determines SLA tier and applicable contractual terms.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective From Date
attributes.description: The date from which this SLA definition version became effective. Used for SLA versioning and to ensure the correct SLA terms are applied to orders placed within a given period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective Until Date
attributes.description: The date until which this SLA definition version remains effective. Null for open-ended SLA definitions. Used for SLA versioning and regulatory compliance period tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: elapsed_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed since the measurement start event as of the last status evaluation. Used for real-time SLA monitoring dashboards and regulatory compliance reporting. Excludes any suspended clock periods.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation tier for this SLA record (e.g., 0 = no escalation, 1 = team lead, 2 = manager, 3 = executive). Incremented automatically by the SLA monitoring engine as thresholds are crossed. Used for NOC and operations reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; ServiceNow ITSM; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: measurement_end_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement End Event
attributes.description: The business event that stops the SLA clock and marks fulfillment completion. Used to calculate actual elapsed time against the SLA target. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SERVICE_ACTIVATED|ORDER_COMPLETED|PORT_COMPLETED|FAULT_RESOLVED|CPE_INSTALLED|CUSTOMER_CONFIRMED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: measurement_start_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Event
attributes.description: The business event that triggers the start of SLA clock measurement. Defines the precise moment from which target completion hours are counted, per regulatory or contractual terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_SUBMITTED|ORDER_ACCEPTED|PAYMENT_CONFIRMED|SITE_SURVEY_COMPLETE|PORT_REQUEST_SUBMITTED|TECHNICIAN_DISPATCHED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the SLA clock started, corresponding to the occurrence of the measurement_start_event. This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for SLA clock initiation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO 8601; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments associated with this SLA record, such as escalation context, customer communication history, or regulatory exception justifications. Intended for NOC and operations team use.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: penalty_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial penalty or service credit is contractually or regulatorily applicable upon breach of this SLA (True). Drives downstream penalty calculation and credit note generation in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions; FCC Order 22-58; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: penalty_credit_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Credit Amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the service credit or penalty payable to the customer upon SLA breach, expressed in the billing currency. Null if penalty_applicable is False or if the breach has not yet been assessed. Feeds into Amdocs Revenue Management credit note generation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Ofcom General Conditions; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The operational priority assigned to this SLA record, used to drive escalation routing and resource allocation in ServiceNow ITSM and Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. CRITICAL typically applies to regulatory MNP or enterprise SLAs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this SLA commitment record, used in regulatory submissions, customer communications, and cross-system reconciliation (e.g., SLA-2024-00123456). Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The regulatory authority whose rules govern this SLA commitment: FCC (Federal Communications Commission, USA), OFCOM (Office of Communications, UK), BEREC (Body of European Regulators for Electronic Communications), ITU (International Telecommunication Union), ETSI, NTIA, GSMA, or NONE for purely commercial SLAs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FCC|OFCOM|BEREC|ITU|ETSI|NTIA|GSMA|NONE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ITU-T E.800; GSMA PRD

attributes.name: regulatory_instrument_reference
attributes.description: The specific regulatory rule, order, or directive citation that mandates this SLA (e.g., 'FCC 47 CFR Part 52 Section 52.35', 'Ofcom General Conditions C5.3', 'BEREC Guidelines on Switching 2020'). Enables precise regulatory compliance traceability.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines on Switching

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of telecommunications service to which this SLA applies: MOBILE, BROADBAND, FIBER_FTTH (Fiber to the Home), VOIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), IPTV (Internet Protocol Television), ENTERPRISE_MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching), SD_WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network), or FIXED_LINE. Determines applicable SLA regime and regulatory framework. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIBER_FTTH|VOIP|IPTV|ENTERPRISE_MPLS|SD_WAN|FIXED_LINE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; 3GPP TS 22.261; ITU-T G.984 (GPON/FTTH); FCC Broadband Data Collection

attributes.name: sla_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the SLA defining the business process it governs: PROVISIONING (new service activation), REPAIR (fault resolution), PORTABILITY (Mobile Number Portability / MNP), INSTALLATION (physical CPE or FTTH installation), ACTIVATION (service turn-up), or DISCONNECTION (service termination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PROVISIONING|REPAIR|PORTABILITY|INSTALLATION|ACTIVATION|DISCONNECTION — promote to reference product if additional categories are required]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; 3GPP TS 22.261; GSMA PRD IR.73 (MNP)

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current real-time status of the SLA commitment: ON_TRACK (within target), AT_RISK (warning threshold exceeded), BREACHED (breach threshold exceeded), COMPLETED (fulfilled within SLA), WAIVED (SLA obligation formally waived), or SUSPENDED (clock paused due to customer or third-party hold).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA commitment: REGULATORY (mandated by FCC, Ofcom, BEREC, or ITU), COMMERCIAL (contractually agreed with the customer), ENTERPRISE (premium business customer SLA), or INTERNAL (operational target not contractually binding).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 64; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this SLA record originated: ORACLE_OSM (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management), NETCRACKER (Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite), SERVICENOW (ServiceNow ITSM), AMDOCS (Amdocs Revenue Management), or MANUAL (manually entered).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Clock Suspension Reason
attributes.description: The reason the SLA measurement clock was most recently suspended. Used for regulatory exclusion reporting and dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_HOLD|THIRD_PARTY_DEPENDENCY|REGULATORY_EXCLUSION|FORCE_MAJEURE|AWAITING_PAYMENT|SITE_ACCESS_DENIED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC Order 22-58; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: target_completion_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Hours
attributes.description: The contracted or regulatory maximum number of hours within which the order must be fulfilled from the measurement start event. This is the primary SLA commitment value (e.g., 24.00 hours for MNP port-in per FCC rules, 48.00 hours for residential broadband activation).
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52 (MNP); Ofcom General Conditions C5; BEREC Guidelines on Switching; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: target_completion_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Timestamp
attributes.description: The calculated deadline timestamp by which the order must be fulfilled to meet the SLA commitment. Derived from measurement_start_timestamp plus target_completion_hours, adjusted for any calendar or business-hours rules. Stored for direct comparison in monitoring queries.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions C5

attributes.name: total_suspended_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Total Suspended Hours
attributes.description: Cumulative number of hours the SLA clock has been suspended for this record due to customer holds, third-party delays, or regulatory exclusions. Subtracted from gross elapsed time to compute net elapsed hours for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this SLA record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp for change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the SLA template or regulatory instrument applied to this record (e.g., 'v2.1', '2024-Q1'). Enables tracking of SLA policy changes over time and ensures correct terms are applied for historical reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the SLA obligation was formally waived (e.g., customer-requested delay, force majeure, regulatory exclusion). Populated only when sla_status is WAIVED. Required for audit and regulatory justification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: warning_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of elapsed hours from the measurement start event at which the SLA status transitions to AT_RISK, triggering proactive escalation workflows in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management and ServiceNow ITSM. Typically set as a percentage of target_completion_hours (e.g., 75%).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: warning_triggered_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Triggered Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the SLA status transitioned to AT_RISK (warning threshold exceeded). Used to measure the effectiveness of proactive escalation workflows and to audit response times.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

products.name: notification
products.description: Outbound notification record dispatched to customers or internal stakeholders at key order lifecycle milestones — order confirmation, appointment reminder, provisioning completion, port-in execution, and order cancellation. Captures notification type, delivery channel (SMS, email, push, IVR), recipient reference, dispatch timestamp, delivery status (SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED, BOUNCED), template version, and language code. Supports regulatory notification obligations for MNP and service disconnection.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.mnp_transaction. Linking notification to sla_breach_event provides the regulatory audit trail proving timely customer notification, supports brea

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.sla. Business justification: Notifications are dispatched when SLA breach thresholds are crossed (warning notifications, breach notifications, regulatory SLA alerts). The notification table has regulatory_notification_flag and so

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.svc_instance. Business justification: Customer notifications (activation confirmation, suspension notice, porting completion) are sent about specific service instances. Linking notification to svc_instance enables per-service communicatio

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.work_order. Business justification: Customer notifications (e.g., 'technician en route', 'installation complete') are directly triggered by work order status events. Telecom CX operations require linking notifications to the triggering

attributes.name: body_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the rendered notification body content at the time of dispatch. Provides tamper-evident audit evidence of the exact message content sent without storing the full message body (which may contain PII).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information integrity; GDPR Article 5(1)(f) integrity and confidentiality; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code for order cancellation included in ORDER_CANCELLATION notifications (e.g., CUSTOMER_REQUEST, CREDIT_FAIL, DUPLICATE_ORDER, FRAUD_DETECTED). Populated only when notification_type is ORDER_CANCELLATION.

attributes.description: Reference to the customer's communication consent record that authorises dispatch of this notification via the selected channel. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and TCPA compliance for SMS/IVR channels.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was first created in the order notification system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit logging; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.createdDate; GDPR Article 5(2) accountability

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when delivery confirmation was received from the messaging gateway or carrier, confirming the notification reached the recipient endpoint. Null if delivery has not yet been confirmed or failed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.receivedTime; GSMA PRD IR.73 delivery receipt timestamp

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to dispatch this notification to the recipient (e.g., SMS, EMAIL, PUSH notification, IVR automated call, WhatsApp, or POSTAL mail). Determines routing logic and delivery SLA expectations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ContactMedium.type; ETSI TS 102 690 M2M notification channels

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery outcome status of the notification as reported by the downstream messaging gateway or carrier. SENT = dispatched to gateway; DELIVERED = confirmed receipt by endpoint; FAILED = gateway rejection; BOUNCED = undeliverable address; PENDING = queued for dispatch.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.status; GSMA PRD IR.73 delivery reporting

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the notification was submitted to the messaging gateway or delivery platform. Principal business event timestamp for SLA measurement and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.sendTime; FCC MNP notification timing requirements

attributes.name: failed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a delivery failure or bounce was reported by the messaging gateway. Populated only when delivery_status is FAILED or BOUNCED. Used to trigger retry logic and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.failureTime; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: The error or failure reason code returned by the messaging gateway when delivery_status is FAILED or BOUNCED (e.g., INVALID_NUMBER, MAILBOX_FULL, UNSUBSCRIBED, NETWORK_ERROR). Used for root cause analysis and retry strategy.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.73 — Delivery failure codes; SMTP RFC 5321 bounce codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the delivery failure reason as returned by the messaging gateway. Complements failure_reason_code with additional context for operations and customer service teams.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.failureDescription; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: fallback_channel
attributes.description: The alternative delivery channel to be used if the primary delivery_channel fails after exhausting retry attempts (e.g., fall back to SMS if EMAIL bounces). Supports multi-channel notification resilience.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationPolicy.fallbackChannel; ETSI TS 102 690

attributes.name: fallback_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fallback delivery channel was activated for this notification because the primary channel failed. True = fallback was used; False = primary channel was used.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationPolicy.fallbackTriggered; Oracle OSM Notification Engine

attributes.name: gateway_message_reference
attributes.description: The unique message identifier assigned by the external messaging gateway or carrier (e.g., SMS aggregator message ID, email SMTP message ID, push notification token). Used for delivery receipt correlation and dispute resolution with gateway providers.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.73 — Message reference; SMTP RFC 5321 Message-ID

attributes.name: gateway_provider
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the external messaging gateway or aggregator used to deliver this notification (e.g., Twilio, Syniverse, AWS SNS). Supports vendor performance monitoring and SLA management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — MessageGateway entity; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 language tag identifying the language in which the notification was rendered (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, es-MX). Supports multilingual customer communication obligations and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tags; TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.language; FCC accessibility requirements

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of delivery retry attempts permitted for this notification before it is marked as permanently failed and escalated. Configured per notification_type and delivery_channel in the notification policy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationPolicy.maxRetries; Oracle OSM Notification Engine

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this notification record (e.g., NTF-0012345678). Used in customer-facing correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory evidence for MNP and disconnection notifications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.notificationId; FCC MNP notification requirements

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Classifies the business event that triggered this notification. Drives template selection, regulatory logging, and SLA measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_CONFIRMATION|APPOINTMENT_REMINDER|PROVISIONING_COMPLETE|PORT_IN_EXECUTION|ORDER_CANCELLATION|DISCONNECTION_NOTICE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework B2C Notification; FCC MNP Order 18-122; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recipient had opted out of this notification type or delivery channel at the time of dispatch. True = opt-out was recorded (notification may have been suppressed or sent as regulatory override). Used for GDPR/TCPA compliance audit.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 — Right to object; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: port_execution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Port Execution Date
attributes.description: The date on which the MNP port-in or port-out was executed, as communicated in PORT_IN_EXECUTION notifications. Required for regulatory audit under FCC MNP Order 18-122 and GSMA PRD IR.73.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order 18-122; GSMA PRD IR.73 — Port execution date; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The dispatch priority assigned to this notification, governing queue position and SLA targets in the messaging gateway. CRITICAL = regulatory/MNP notifications requiring immediate dispatch; HIGH = time-sensitive operational; NORMAL = standard; LOW = informational.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.priority; Oracle OSM Notification Engine priority levels

attributes.name: provisioning_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which service provisioning was completed, as communicated in PROVISIONING_COMPLETE notifications. Sourced from Oracle OSM service fulfillment completion event.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ServiceOrder.completionDate; Oracle OSM Service Fulfillment

attributes.name: recipient_address
attributes.description: The actual delivery endpoint used for this notification — phone number (E.164 format for SMS/IVR), email address, push device token, or postal address depending on delivery_channel. Stored as dispatched for audit and re-delivery purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation; CCPA Section 1798.140; TM Forum SID GB922 — ContactMedium.medium

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the notification was dispatched to an external customer, an internal business stakeholder, a customer service agent, or a field technician. Governs data handling and privacy obligations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party.partyType; GDPR Article 4 data subject classification

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this notification fulfils a mandatory regulatory obligation (e.g., MNP port-in confirmation, service disconnection advance notice). True = regulatory notification; False = operational/informational notification. Used for compliance reporting to FCC, Ofcom, BEREC.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order 18-122; Ofcom General Conditions of Entitlement; BEREC Guidelines; NTIA

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of delivery retry attempts made for this notification following an initial FAILED or BOUNCED status. Used to enforce maximum retry policies and trigger escalation to an alternative channel.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Notification Retry Management; Oracle OSM Notification Engine

attributes.name: scheduled_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time at which the notification was scheduled to be dispatched. Compared against dispatch_timestamp to measure scheduling accuracy and identify delayed notifications.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Order Notification Scheduling; Oracle OSM Notification Scheduler

attributes.name: source_event_reference
attributes.description: The unique event or transaction identifier from the originating source system (OSM, Salesforce, Amdocs) that triggered this notification. Enables end-to-end traceability from the source business event to the dispatched notification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Event.eventId; Oracle OSM Event correlation; ISO/IEC 27001 audit trail

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system that triggered this notification event (e.g., OSM = Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, SALESFORCE_CRM, AMDOCS, NETCRACKER, COMVERSE). Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — OSS/BSS Integration; Oracle OSM; Salesforce CRM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: The subject line or title of the notification as rendered and dispatched (e.g., email subject line, SMS header, push notification title). Captured for audit, content review, and regulatory evidence.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.subject; CAN-SPAM Act Section 5

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the notification template used at the time of dispatch (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables audit of which template content was sent, supporting regulatory compliance and A/B testing analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationTemplate.version; ISO/IEC 27001 change management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was last modified (e.g., delivery status updated from SENT to DELIVERED). Audit trail field for change tracking and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit logging; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.lastModifiedDate; GDPR Article 5(2) accountability

products.name: amendment
products.description: Record of every post-submission modification to a fulfillment order — customer-requested changes to appointment date, product selection, delivery address, or service configuration before order completion. Captures amendment type, amendment request timestamp, original value, new value, amendment status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPLIED), approving agent reference, and impact assessment (SLA reset flag, cost delta). Maintains a complete change history for dispute resolution and audit.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderAmendment / OSM Change Order

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order amendment record in the Telecommunication order management system. Primary key for the order_amendment data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Management

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Compliance audits frequently identify order amendments required (e.g., incorrect pricing, unauthorized changes). Linking amendment to the audit that triggered it supports corrective action tracking an

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise order amendments require corporate account-level tracking for account management reporting, amendment approval workflows, and contract compliance auditing. Enables amendment frequency analy

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who requested or is impacted by this order amendment. Supports customer-level audit trails and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Customer Domain; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: discount_scheme_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.discount_scheme. Business justification: Contract amendments frequently change the applicable enterprise discount scheme (tier upgrades, renegotiations). Direct link enables discount scheme change audit trail and revenue impact analysis of a

attributes.name: enterprise_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.enterprise_contract. Business justification: Order amendments for enterprise customers require contract linkage to validate change authorization per contract terms, assess pricing impacts, and trigger contract modification workflows for material

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item affected by this amendment, when the modification is scoped to a single line rather than the entire order header.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Line Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: managed_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Managed service configuration changes are executed via order amendments. Direct link enables managed service change history reporting, change window compliance tracking, and managed service lifecycle

attributes.name: parent_amendment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to a prior amendment that this record supersedes or is derived from. Supports amendment chains where a rejected amendment is resubmitted with corrections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment History

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: amendment.regulatory_hold_flag indicates amendments placed on hold due to regulatory obligations (e.g., MNP freeze periods, mandated service changes). Linking to the specific regulatory_obligation dri

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.subscriber. Business justification: Contract amendments (plan changes, ETF waivers, contract extensions) are executed at the subscriber level in telecom. amendment links to customer_account_id but not the specific subscriber, preventing

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_subscription. Business justification: Subscription amendments (addon changes, plan upgrades, auto-renewal modifications) are executed against a specific customer_subscription record. Linking amendment directly to customer_subscription ena

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.svc_instance. Business justification: An amendment modifies a specific service instance (plan upgrade, feature add/remove, contract extension). Linking amendment to svc_instance enables change management tracking per service, supports cus

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Amendments to fixed-line service orders (bandwidth upgrades, route changes, SLA tier changes) reference the specific transmission link being amended. Change management and order amendment processing f

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field work order created or modified as a result of this amendment, when requires_field_visit is True. Links to the workforce management dispatch record in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Work Order; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: amended_field_name
attributes.description: The logical name of the order attribute that was changed by this amendment (e.g., appointment_date, delivery_address_id, product_offering_code, service_configuration_value). Enables fine-grained change history and audit trail per field.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this amendment, used in customer communications, agent desktops, and dispute resolution workflows. Format: AMD- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment request: PENDING (submitted, awaiting review), APPROVED (authorised by agent or system), REJECTED (denied), APPLIED (successfully propagated to the fulfillment order), WITHDRAWN (retracted by the customer before decision).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment Lifecycle; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Categorises the nature of the post-submission modification: APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE (change of installation/delivery date), PRODUCT_CHANGE (swap of selected product or offering), ADDRESS_CHANGE (new delivery or service address), SERVICE_CONFIG_CHANGE (alteration to service parameters), CONTACT_UPDATE (change of contact details), CANCELLATION_REQUEST (request to cancel the order before completion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE|PRODUCT_CHANGE|ADDRESS_CHANGE|SERVICE_CONFIG_CHANGE|CONTACT_UPDATE|CANCELLATION_REQUEST — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment Type; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the approved amendment was successfully propagated and applied to the underlying fulfillment order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Null until status reaches APPLIED.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the amendment was approved by an authorised agent or automated workflow. Null if the amendment has not yet been approved or was rejected.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this amendment record to the immutable audit log entry in the compliance audit system (e.g., ServiceNow CMDB audit record or enterprise audit repository). Supports regulatory audit and dispute resolution evidence chains.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB921; FCC Record Retention Rules

attributes.name: billing_adjustment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment triggers a billing adjustment in Amdocs Revenue Management (e.g., pro-rated credit, revised charge). When True, the billing team must process a corresponding adjustment record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cost_delta
attributes.description: The incremental cost impact of this amendment on the order, expressed as a signed decimal. Positive values indicate an increase in order cost; negative values indicate a reduction. Used for revenue assurance and billing adjustment workflows in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Financial Impact; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cost_delta_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_delta amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures multi-currency support for international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB921

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this amendment record was first persisted in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from requested_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB921

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the customer was notified of the amendment outcome. Null if customer_notified_flag is False. Used for regulatory compliance reporting on customer communication timeliness.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Customer Notification; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: customer_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been formally notified of the amendment outcome (approval, rejection, or application). Supports compliance with customer communication obligations and SLA notification requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Customer Notification; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which a PENDING amendment must be approved or it will automatically expire and be treated as WITHDRAWN. Enforces amendment processing SLAs and prevents stale pending requests from blocking order fulfillment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: impact_assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the agent's or system's assessment of the downstream impact of this amendment on network provisioning, billing, scheduling, or third-party dependencies. Used during the approval workflow.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: is_customer_initiated
attributes.description: Distinguishes amendments initiated by the customer from those initiated internally by agents or automated systems (e.g., error corrections, product availability changes). Supports root-cause analysis of amendment volumes and customer experience reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; eTOM Customer Interaction Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent update to this amendment record in the Silver Layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change detection.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB921

attributes.name: mnp_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment affects a Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in or port-out request associated with the parent order. When True, the MNP coordinator must be notified to update the porting window with the donor or recipient operator.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — Mobile Number Portability; 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC MNP Rules

attributes.name: new_committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The revised committed delivery or installation date resulting from this amendment, applicable when the amendment type is APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE or when sla_reset_flag is True. Null if the amendment does not affect the delivery date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Fulfillment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The replacement value for the amended field as requested by the customer or agent. Stored as a string to accommodate heterogeneous field types. Becomes the effective value once the amendment status reaches APPLIED.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: original_committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The committed delivery or installation date that was in effect on the parent order before this amendment was applied. Preserved for SLA impact analysis and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Fulfillment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The value of the amended field as it existed on the order before this amendment was applied. Stored as a string to accommodate heterogeneous field types (dates, codes, identifiers, free text). Essential for dispute resolution and rollback.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this amendment for processing queue management: CRITICAL (immediate action required, e.g., regulatory or safety), HIGH (same-day processing), MEDIUM (standard SLA), LOW (best-effort). Drives agent workqueue ordering.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Priority; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised reason code explaining why the amendment was raised: CUSTOMER_REQUEST (voluntary change), AGENT_ERROR_CORRECTION (fix for data entry error), SYSTEM_ERROR (automated correction), PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE (original product no longer available), ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAIL (address rejected by validation), SCHEDULING_CONFLICT (appointment slot no longer available). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_REQUEST|AGENT_ERROR_CORRECTION|SYSTEM_ERROR|PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE|ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAIL|SCHEDULING_CONFLICT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the amendment reason beyond the structured reason code. Captured from agent notes or customer-provided comments during the amendment request.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment is subject to a regulatory hold (e.g., MNP porting window freeze, FCC-mandated processing pause, Ofcom dispute freeze). When True, the amendment cannot be processed until the hold is lifted.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Rules; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines on Number Portability

attributes.name: rejected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the amendment was rejected. Null if the amendment was not rejected.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code indicating why the amendment was rejected: ORDER_ALREADY_FULFILLED, AMENDMENT_WINDOW_EXPIRED, PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE, CREDIT_CHECK_FAILED, DUPLICATE_REQUEST, POLICY_VIOLATION. Null when amendment is not in REJECTED status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_ALREADY_FULFILLED|AMENDMENT_WINDOW_EXPIRED|PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE|CREDIT_CHECK_FAILED|DUPLICATE_REQUEST|POLICY_VIOLATION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the amendment was rejected, provided by the approving agent or automated decision system. Null when amendment is not in REJECTED status.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the customer or agent submitted the amendment request. This is the principal business event timestamp for the amendment lifecycle and is used for SLA measurement and audit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; ISO 8601

attributes.name: requesting_channel
attributes.description: The customer interaction channel through which the amendment request was submitted: IVR (Interactive Voice Response), AGENT_ASSISTED (call centre), SELF_SERVICE_WEB, SELF_SERVICE_APP, RETAIL_STORE, CHAT, EMAIL. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IVR|AGENT_ASSISTED|SELF_SERVICE_WEB|SELF_SERVICE_APP|RETAIL_STORE|CHAT|EMAIL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Channel; eTOM 1.4.1 Customer Interaction Management

attributes.name: requires_field_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment necessitates a new or rescheduled field technician visit (e.g., address change for FTTH installation). Triggers workforce management dispatch in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management when True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Work Order Management; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: servicenow_change_request_reference
attributes.description: The ServiceNow ITSM Change Request identifier raised to govern the technical configuration changes required to fulfil this amendment. Format: CHG followed by 7 digits. Null if no ITSM change request was required.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Change Management; ITIL v4 Change Enablement

attributes.name: sla_reset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether applying this amendment resets the SLA clock on the parent order. True when the amendment materially changes the fulfillment scope (e.g., address change, product swap) and the committed delivery date must be recalculated. Critical for SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — SLA Management; eTOM 1.4.6 Service Level Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that submitted this amendment: OMS (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management), CRM (Salesforce CRM), SELF_SERVICE (customer portal or app), IVR, RETAIL_POS, BATCH (automated batch correction). Used for lineage and root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — System of Record; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: source_system_amendment_ref
attributes.description: The native amendment or change-request identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Oracle OMS internal amendment ID, Salesforce case number). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — System Reference; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version counter for amendments on the same order, starting at 1. Enables ordering of the complete change history and identification of the latest amendment state for a given order.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment History; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.revenue_share_plan. Business justification: Order charges for dealer/partner-originated sales are subject to revenue share calculations. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.sla_breach_event. Business justification: SLA breach events in telecom trigger penalty credits recorded as order charges. attributes.name: deposit_date
