attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.work_order. Business justification: Field service activities (installations, repairs, upgrades) generate billing charges (truck roll fees, labor, materials). Linking billing_charge to work_order enables work-order cost recovery billing,

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for charges requiring authorization before posting, particularly manual adjustments and credits above threshold amounts. not_required for system-generated charges; pending_approval, approved, or rejected for manual charges requiring supervisor sign-off.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Approval Workflow; ISO/IEC 27001; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the charge was approved by an authorized agent or supervisor. Null for system-generated charges or those not requiring approval. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SOX Compliance; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: High-level business category grouping charges for revenue reporting and GL account mapping: service (subscription/plan fees), equipment (CPE/device), penalty (late fees, breach), tax (regulatory levies), discount (promotional credits), surcharge (regulatory recovery fees), interconnect (IOT/wholesale). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: service|equipment|penalty|tax|discount|surcharge|interconnect — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Category; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the charge as it appears on the customer's bill and in customer service interactions. Examples: 'Monthly Unlimited Plan Fee', 'iPhone 15 Equipment Charge', 'Late Payment Penalty'. Sourced from Amdocs charge specification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Specification; FCC Truth-in-Billing

attributes.name: charge_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the charge as displayed on customer bills and used in dispute resolution and customer service interactions within Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Charge Reference

attributes.name: charge_source
attributes.description: Originating system that generated or triggered this charge: amdocs (Amdocs Revenue Management automated billing), comverse (Comverse ONE prepaid/real-time charging), manual (agent-applied via CRM), order_management (Oracle OSM order fulfillment), product_catalog (Netcracker catalog-driven), crm (Salesforce CRM agent action).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Source System; eTOM

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the charge within the billing workflow: pending (created, not yet billed), active (approved for billing), invoiced (included on an invoice), disputed (under customer dispute), waived (forgiven without reversal), cancelled (voided before invoicing), reversed (credited back after invoicing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|active|invoiced|disputed|waived|cancelled|reversed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Lifecycle; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge by its billing nature: recurring (monthly service fee), one_time (single occurrence), activation (service provisioning fee), equipment (CPE/device charge), late_payment (penalty fee), adjustment (credit or debit correction), or manual (agent-applied charge). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recurring|one_time|activation|equipment|late_payment|adjustment|manual — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Specification; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code identifying the organizational unit responsible for this charge for internal financial allocation and OPEX reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; Internal Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this charge record was first created in the billing system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, Silver layer ingestion tracking, and compliance with ISO/IEC 27001 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the charge amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing for international and roaming scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of any promotional, loyalty, or contractual discount applied to reduce the gross charge amount. Negative value reduces the net charge. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management discount engine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Discount; eTOM Billing Management

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for unpaid charges, ranging from 0 (no dunning) to the maximum configured level (e.g., 4 = final notice before collections). Managed by the Amdocs Revenue Management dunning engine for collections workflow.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections

attributes.name: dunning_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent dunning action taken on this charge (e.g., reminder notice sent, suspension warning issued). Null if dunning_level is 0. Used to track collections escalation timeline.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the charge becomes effective and is recognized as a financial obligation on the billing account. Used for revenue recognition alignment per IFRS 15 and for billing cycle proration calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Date

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: External or cross-system reference identifier for this charge, such as a partner billing reference, wholesale interconnect settlement reference (TAP/IOT), or regulatory reporting reference number. Supports reconciliation with partner and regulatory systems.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which this charge is posted for financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and revenue recognition. Maps charge categories to the chart of accounts for CAPEX/OPEX classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Pre-tax, pre-discount gross monetary value of the charge in the billing currency. Represents the base charge amount before any tax calculation or promotional discount is applied. Used as the basis for revenue recognition and MRR reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Amount; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge has been prorated to reflect a partial billing period (e.g., mid-cycle activation or cancellation). True when the charge amount has been adjusted proportionally to the number of days in the service period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Proration; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: mrr_contribution
attributes.description: The portion of this charge that contributes to Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) calculations. For recurring charges, this equals the normalized monthly gross amount. Zero for one-time charges. Used in MRR/ARPU reporting and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Revenue Management; MRR Industry Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final billable amount after applying discounts and adding taxes: net_amount = gross_amount - discount_amount + tax_amount. This is the amount posted to the customer's billing account and reflected on the invoice line.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Net Amount; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment for this charge must be received to avoid late payment penalties and dunning escalation. Derived from the billing cycle due date and any applicable grace period configured in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Due Date; FCC Truth-in-Billing

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this charge. Together with charge_period_start, defines the service period for which the recurring or prorated charge applies. Null for one-time charges with no period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Period; IFRS 15

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this charge. Applicable for recurring charges (e.g., monthly plan fee covering 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-31). Used for proration and revenue period matching.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Period; IFRS 15

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor applied to the full-period charge to derive the prorated amount (e.g., 0.516129 for 16 days out of 31). Null when is_prorated is False. Used for revenue assurance validation of prorated charges.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Proration; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason or trigger for the charge (e.g., NEW_ACTIVATION, PLAN_UPGRADE, EQUIPMENT_PURCHASE, LATE_PAYMENT, MANUAL_CREDIT, PRORATION). Used for revenue assurance analysis and dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Reason; eTOM Billing Management

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which revenue from this charge is recognized in the financial statements per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation satisfaction criteria. May differ from effective_date for multi-period or bundled service charges.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_system_charge_code
attributes.description: The native charge identifier as recorded in the originating operational system (Amdocs Revenue Management or Comverse ONE). Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and support of revenue assurance processes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Source System Reference; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax levied on this charge, including VAT, GST, USF (Universal Service Fund), and other regulatory surcharges as determined by the tax class and jurisdiction. Calculated by the Amdocs tax engine per FCC and ITU regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Tax; FCC Universal Service Fund; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: tax_class
attributes.description: Tax classification of the charge that determines the applicable tax treatment and rate. Drives the Amdocs tax engine calculation: taxable (standard rate), exempt (no tax), zero_rated (0% VAT/GST), reduced_rate (preferential rate), regulatory_surcharge (FCC/NTIA mandated levies).
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Reporting; ITU-T; ETSI; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate percentage applied to this charge at the time of billing, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%). Captured for audit and revenue assurance purposes as rates may change over time.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Reporting; NTIA; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this charge record was last modified in the billing system. Tracks status changes, amount adjustments, and dispute updates. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this charge was waived (charge_status = 'waived'). Examples: 'Customer goodwill gesture', 'Service outage credit', 'Regulatory compliance'. Required for revenue assurance audit when charges are forgiven.

Covers goodwill credits, SLA breach compensation, dispute resolutions, overbilling corrections, returned equipment credits, and service outage compensation. When document type is credit note, serves as the formal financial document issued to the customer. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management adjustments module.

attributes.description: Reference to the active prepaid subscription or service plan associated with this balance record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Product Management

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this prepaid balance account was first activated. Marks the start of the subscriber's prepaid lifecycle. Used for tenure calculation, cohort analysis, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Account Management; FCC Prepaid Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: auto_recharge_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount to be automatically recharged when the auto-recharge trigger threshold is reached. Expressed in the account currency. Configured by the subscriber or defaulted by the plan.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: auto_recharge_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has configured automatic recharge (top-up) to trigger when the main balance falls below the auto_recharge_trigger_threshold. True = auto-recharge active; False = manual recharge only.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: auto_recharge_payment_token
attributes.description: Tokenized reference to the payment instrument (e.g., credit/debit card token, bank account token) used for automatic recharge transactions. The actual card/account details are stored in the payment vault; this token is the PCI-compliant reference. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management payment tokenization.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 - Requirement 3 (Protect Stored Account Data); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: auto_recharge_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Monetary balance level at which the auto-recharge process is automatically triggered. When main_balance_amount falls at or below this value and auto_recharge_enabled is True, a recharge of auto_recharge_amount is initiated. Expressed in the account currency.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: balance_freeze_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the balance is in 'frozen' status. Populated only when balance_status = 'frozen'. Supports compliance audit trails and operational workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fraud_investigation|regulatory_hold|subscriber_request|legal_order|sim_swap_pending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC Regulations; ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: balance_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number for this prepaid balance record, as assigned by Comverse ONE Balance Management. Used in customer-facing communications and balance inquiries.
attributes.references: Comverse ONE Balance Management; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: balance_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent balance snapshot captured from Comverse ONE Balance Management. Indicates the freshness of the balance data in the Silver Layer. Critical for real-time authorization latency monitoring and data quality SLA tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: balance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the prepaid balance account. 'active' indicates the balance is usable; 'expired' indicates the validity period has lapsed; 'frozen' indicates the balance is temporarily locked (e.g., fraud hold); 'migrated_to_postpaid' indicates the subscriber has converted to a postpaid plan; 'suspended' indicates service suspension due to non-recharge or regulatory action.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: balance_validity_days
attributes.description: Number of days the main balance remains valid from the last recharge date. Determines the main_balance_expiry_date. Defined by the subscriber's active prepaid plan or recharge denomination.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: bonus_balance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of promotional or bonus credits awarded to the subscriber (e.g., recharge bonuses, loyalty rewards, campaign credits). Typically consumed after the main balance is exhausted. Expressed in the account currency.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: content_credit_balance
attributes.description: Remaining balance in the subscriber's dedicated content credit bucket, used for OTT content, IPTV, or digital entertainment purchases. Expressed in the account currency. Sourced from Comverse ONE Balance Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: content_credit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the content credit bucket expires. Unused content credits are forfeited after this date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary balance amounts on this prepaid account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the denomination of main_balance_amount and all monetary bucket values.

attributes.name: data_bucket_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dedicated mobile data bucket expires. Remaining data allowance is forfeited after this date unless renewed via a recharge or data add-on purchase.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: data_bucket_mb
attributes.description: Remaining dedicated mobile data balance in the subscriber's data allowance bucket, expressed in megabytes (MB). Decremented in real-time during data sessions via Comverse ONE online charging and DPI-based usage reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; 3GPP TS 32.296 Online Charging

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this prepaid balance account was deactivated (e.g., after grace period expiry, subscriber-initiated cancellation, or regulatory action). Null if the account is still active. Used for churn analysis and MSISDN recycling workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Account Management; FCC Prepaid Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the main balance expiry date during which the subscriber may still receive incoming calls/SMS but cannot initiate outgoing services. After the grace period, the account may be deactivated. Defined by regulatory requirements and plan configuration.
attributes.references: FCC Prepaid Consumer Protection Rules; TM Forum SID GB922; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: grace_period_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the grace period ends. After this date, the prepaid account may be deactivated and the MSISDN released for recycling if no recharge is made. Calculated as main_balance_expiry_date + grace_period_days.
attributes.references: FCC Prepaid Consumer Protection Rules; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical SIM or eSIM card associated with this prepaid balance account. Used for SIM swap detection, fraud management, and device-balance association. Follows ITU-T E.118 format.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: Unique identifier stored on the SIM/eSIM that identifies the subscriber on the mobile network. Used by the HLR/HSS/UDM for authentication and real-time charging authorization. Classified as restricted PII as it uniquely identifies a subscriber on the network.

attributes.name: last_recharge_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the most recent recharge (top-up) applied to this prepaid account, expressed in the account currency. Used for ARPU calculation, recharge pattern analysis, and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: last_recharge_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the most recent recharge was applied. Supports channel performance analytics and customer journey analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ussd|ivr|mobile_app|web_portal|retail_store|agent|voucher|bank_transfer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM B2C Operations; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: last_recharge_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recent successful recharge (top-up) applied to this prepaid account. Used for churn analysis, recharge frequency reporting, and dormancy detection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: last_recharge_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone) of the most recent successful recharge event applied to this prepaid account. Provides sub-day precision for real-time authorization and fraud detection workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: low_balance_notification_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has opted in to receive low-balance notifications when the main balance falls below the low_balance_threshold. True = notifications enabled; False = notifications disabled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; GSMA Guidelines

attributes.name: low_balance_threshold
attributes.description: Monetary threshold below which a low-balance notification is triggered to the subscriber (e.g., via SMS, push notification, or USSD). Expressed in the account currency. Configurable per subscriber or plan.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: main_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current monetary balance available in the subscriber's primary prepaid wallet, expressed in the account currency. This is the principal cash-equivalent balance used for general service charges, roaming, and out-of-bundle usage. Sourced from Comverse ONE real-time balance management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: main_balance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the main monetary balance expires and becomes unavailable for use if not recharged. After this date, the balance_status transitions to 'expired'. Critical for low-balance notification and recharge prompting workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: recharge_count_current_month
attributes.description: Number of successful recharge transactions applied to this prepaid account in the current calendar month. Supports MRR calculation, monthly ARPU reporting, and recharge frequency analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: recharge_count_lifetime
attributes.description: Total number of successful recharge (top-up) transactions applied to this prepaid account since activation. Used for subscriber loyalty segmentation, ARPU analysis, and churn prediction models.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this prepaid balance record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this prepaid balance record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: reserved_balance_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the main balance currently reserved (locked) for active in-progress sessions (e.g., ongoing voice calls, active data sessions). Prevents double-spending during real-time authorization. Released upon session termination. Sourced from Comverse ONE online charging.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.296 Online Charging System (OCS); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: sms_bucket_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dedicated SMS units bucket expires. Remaining SMS units are forfeited after this date unless renewed via a recharge or bundle purchase.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: sms_bucket_units
attributes.description: Remaining dedicated SMS units in the subscriber's SMS allowance bucket. Each unit typically represents one standard SMS message. Decremented in real-time via Comverse ONE charging.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; 3GPP TS 32.296 Online Charging

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational system record in Comverse ONE Balance Management from which this prepaid balance record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: voice_bucket_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dedicated voice minutes bucket expires. Remaining voice minutes are forfeited after this date unless renewed via a recharge or bundle purchase.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: voice_bucket_minutes
attributes.description: Remaining dedicated voice minutes balance in the subscriber's voice allowance bucket. Decremented in real-time during voice calls via Comverse ONE real-time rating. Expressed in minutes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Balance Management; 3GPP TS 32.296 Online Charging

products.name: recharge
products.description: Transactional record of a prepaid top-up or recharge event applied to a subscriber's prepaid balance. Captures recharge date and time, recharge amount, recharge channel (voucher, online, agent, USSD, bank transfer), voucher serial number, promotion applied, bonus credited, balance before and after recharge, and transaction status. Sourced from Comverse ONE real-time rating and balance management.
products.reference: Comverse ONE Top-Up / 3GPP Gy Recharge Event

attributes.name: recharge_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each prepaid recharge/top-up transaction record in Comverse ONE. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party Interaction; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Prepaid recharges in telecom frequently activate specific add-ons (data boosters, roaming packs, SMS bundles). The recharge-to-addon link drives provisioning triggers, add-on activation reporting, and

attributes.name: balance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to usage.usage_balance. Business justification: Recharges can top up usage balances (data/voice bundles) in addition to monetary prepaid_balance. Link required for bundle top-up tracking, bonus allocation, and hybrid prepaid-postpaid scenarios.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prepaid billing account associated with the subscriber in Amdocs Revenue Management. A subscriber may have multiple accounts (e.g., main and data wallet).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingAccount; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.channel. Business justification: Prepaid recharges occur through specific sales channels (USSD, retail, online, dealer). Channel performance reporting for recharge revenue and commission calculation requires a proper FK. recharge.cha

attributes.name: fraud_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.fraud_case. Business justification: Fraudulent recharges (voucher fraud, SIM swap recharge fraud) are a major prepaid telco fraud type. Recharges flagged as fraudulent must reference the fraud_case for forensic analysis, financial recov

attributes.name: msisdn_range_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.msisdn_range. Business justification: Each recharge event is performed against a specific MSISDN belonging to an inventory range. The current msisdn plain attribute is denormalized. This FK enables range-level recharge analytics, prepaid

attributes.name: original_recharge_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original recharge transaction that this record reverses or adjusts. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Enables audit trail linking between original and reversal transactions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PaymentItem; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: A recharge event is funded by a payment transaction (credit card, bank transfer, voucher). Linking recharge to its funding payment enables end-to-end financial traceability from payment receipt throug

attributes.name: prepaid_balance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.prepaid_balance. Business justification: A recharge event is applied to a specific prepaid_balance, topping up the subscriber's balance. This is the core operational relationship for prepaid balance management — every recharge must reference

attributes.name: price_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_plan. Business justification: Recharges credit balances per price plan definitions (main balance, data buckets, voice minutes). Essential for applying correct allowances, bonus calculations, and validity extensions per product ter

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Reference to the promotional offer applied to this recharge event, if any. Links to the product/promotion catalog in Netcracker OSS/BSS. Null if no promotion was applied.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ProductOffering; Netcracker OSS/BSS Product Catalog

attributes.name: rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.rate_plan. Business justification: A recharge can activate or extend a specific rate plan for the prepaid subscriber (e.g., a data bundle recharge activates a specific data rate plan). Linking recharge to rate_plan enables bundle activ

attributes.name: sim_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: Recharge transactions must track which SIM card was recharged for fraud prevention, reconciliation, and SIM swap validation. Essential for prepaid recharge processing and revenue assurance.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prepaid subscriber whose balance was recharged. Links to the subscriber/customer master record in the CRM and Comverse ONE.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer; Comverse ONE Prepaid Charging

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.svc_instance. Business justification: Recharges apply to specific prepaid service instances, not just subscriber-level. Required for multi-SIM accounts, data-only devices (IoT, tablets), and family plan bucket allocation. Critical for pre

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the recharge applied to the subscriber's prepaid balance, in the transaction currency. This is the face value paid by the subscriber before any tax deductions or bonus credits.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Money; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; ISO 4217

attributes.name: balance_after
attributes.description: The subscriber's prepaid main balance immediately after this recharge was applied, as recorded by Comverse ONE. Equals balance_before plus net_credited_amount plus bonus_amount. Used for balance audit trails.
attributes.references: Comverse ONE Balance Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — FinancialAccount

attributes.name: balance_before
attributes.description: The subscriber's prepaid main balance immediately before this recharge was applied, as recorded by Comverse ONE real-time balance management. Used for balance reconciliation and fraud detection.
attributes.references: Comverse ONE Balance Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — FinancialAccount

attributes.name: balance_expiry_date
attributes.description: The new expiry date of the subscriber's prepaid balance after this recharge was applied. Recharges typically extend the validity period of the prepaid account. Used for balance lifecycle management and subscriber retention analytics.
attributes.references: GSMA Prepaid Guidelines; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Additional bonus credit amount awarded to the subscriber's balance as part of a promotional offer associated with this recharge. Separate from the net_credited_amount; tracked for promotional liability and revenue assurance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ProductOffering; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this recharge record was first created and persisted in the Databricks Silver layer. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED marker for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — EntitySpecification; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the recharge transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency operators and international roaming recharge scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; TM Forum SID GB922 — Money

attributes.name: data_bonus_mb
attributes.description: Additional data allowance in megabytes (MB) credited to the subscriber's data bucket as part of a promotional recharge offer. Null if no data bonus was awarded. Tracked separately from monetary bonus for usage analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ProductOffering; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized error or failure reason code returned by Comverse ONE or the payment gateway when a recharge transaction fails. Null for successful transactions. Used for failure analysis and NOC troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating; TM Forum SID GB922 — Error

attributes.name: home_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the subscriber's home network. Used for international roaming recharge scenarios and regulatory reporting to FCC/ITU/Ofcom.

attributes.name: net_credited_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary value actually credited to the subscriber's prepaid main balance after tax deductions. Equals recharge_amount minus tax_amount. Used for revenue recognition and balance reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Money; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO 4217

attributes.name: network_node_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the network node (e.g., HLR, HSS, or UDM) that processed the recharge authorization and balance update. Used for network-level troubleshooting and capacity planning in NOC operations.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.002; Ericsson Network Manager; Nokia NetAct

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to fund the recharge (e.g., credit card, mobile wallet, bank transfer). Distinct from recharge_channel (the interface). Used for payment mix analytics and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PaymentMean; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: processing_duration_ms
attributes.description: Time in milliseconds taken by Comverse ONE to process and complete the recharge transaction from request receipt to balance credit confirmation. Used for SLA monitoring and real-time rating performance analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA; Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating; ETSI

attributes.name: recharge_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the recharge was applied, derived from recharge_timestamp. Used for daily/monthly MRR reporting, ARPU calculations, and partitioning in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management MRR Reporting

attributes.name: recharge_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset) when the recharge event was processed and the subscriber's prepaid balance was credited. This is the principal business event timestamp, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod; Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating

attributes.name: recharge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recharge event by its business nature. Distinguishes standard top-ups from promotional, emergency credit, auto-recharge triggers, or gifted recharges from another subscriber.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ProductOffering; Comverse ONE Prepaid Charging

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recharge transaction has been reversed or cancelled after initial processing. True = reversed; False = not reversed. Used for revenue assurance and balance reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PaymentItem; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections

attributes.name: roaming_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber was roaming on a visited network at the time of the recharge event. True = subscriber was roaming; False = subscriber was on home network. Relevant for NRTRDE/TAP roaming reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA NRTRDE; TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); 3GPP TS 22.011

attributes.name: sms_bonus_count
attributes.description: Additional SMS messages credited to the subscriber's SMS bucket as part of a promotional recharge offer. Null if no SMS bonus was awarded.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ProductOffering; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system that originated this recharge record (e.g., Comverse ONE, Amdocs, external payment gateway). Used for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SystemResource; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component deducted from or applied to the recharge amount, such as VAT, GST, or excise duty on prepaid top-ups, as applicable per jurisdiction. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for revenue recognition.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory; ITU; ISO 4217; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.1500 for 15%) applied to this recharge transaction for VAT, GST, or excise duty calculation. Used for tax reporting and revenue recognition compliance.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory; NTIA; ISO 4217; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for the recharge transaction as generated by Comverse ONE or the recharge channel. Used for customer-facing receipts, dispute resolution, and reconciliation with payment gateways.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PaymentItem; Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recharge transaction as processed by Comverse ONE. 'success' indicates balance was credited; 'failed' indicates processing error; 'reversed' indicates a chargeback or correction; 'partial' indicates partial credit applied.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PaymentItem; Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this recharge record was last modified in the Databricks Silver layer (e.g., due to a status update, reversal, or correction). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED marker.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — EntitySpecification; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: ussd_session_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unstructured Supplementary Service Data (USSD) Session ID
attributes.description: The USSD session identifier from the IMS/HLR for recharges initiated via USSD short codes. Populated only when recharge_channel is 'ussd'. Supports USSD session tracing and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: validity_days
attributes.description: Number of days of service validity granted to the subscriber by this recharge event. Determines how long the subscriber can use the credited balance before it expires.
attributes.references: GSMA Prepaid Guidelines; Comverse ONE Balance Management; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: voice_bonus_minutes
attributes.description: Additional voice call minutes credited to the subscriber's voice bucket as part of a promotional recharge offer. Null if no voice bonus was awarded. Tracked for promotional liability and usage analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ProductOffering; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: voucher_serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number of the physical or electronic prepaid voucher used for this recharge. Populated only when recharge_channel is 'voucher'. Used for voucher fraud detection and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA Prepaid Voucher Guidelines; Comverse ONE Prepaid Charging

products.name: rate_plan
products.description: Master definition of a pricing rate plan used by the rating engine to price usage events and recurring charges. Captures rate plan code, name, applicable service type (voice, data, SMS, roaming, IoT), rate tiers and step thresholds, unit of measure, included allowances and fair-use caps, overage rates, time-of-day and day-of-week modifiers, effective date range, currency, and applicable market segment (consumer, SMB, enterprise, wholesale). Distinct from the commercial product catalog (product domain) — this is the financial pricing engine configuration that translates catalog offers into monetary amounts. Sourced from Amdocs Rating engine.
products.reference: Amdocs Rate Plan / TM Forum SID PricingRule

attributes.name: rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the rate plan record in the Amdocs Rating engine. Primary key for the rate_plan data product in the billing domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Pricing Logic Specification

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: A rate_plan is associated with a specific billing_cycle that defines the billing frequency and period for recurring charges under that plan. rate_plan has billing_period (string) which is a denormaliz

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.iot_tariff. Business justification: Roaming retail rate plans must be reconciled against wholesale IOT tariffs for margin analysis and regulatory compliance. Telecom operators directly map customer-facing rate plans to the IOT tariff th

attributes.name: price_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_plan. Business justification: Billing engine rate plans must reference product catalog price plans to ensure rating configuration matches commercial product definitions. Critical for billing accuracy, price plan migration, and cat

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.promotion. Business justification: Rate plans are frequently tied to promotional campaigns; promotion_id tracks which promotion drove rate plan selection for campaign ROI analysis, promotional effectiveness measurement, and marketing a

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Rate plans are directly governed by regulatory obligations — EU roaming price caps, wholesale rate obligations, universal service pricing, and price cap regulations. Compliance teams audit rate plans

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.segment. Business justification: Rate plans are designed for specific enterprise segments (SMB, large enterprise, government). rate_plan.market_segment is a denormalized plain-text attribute; replacing it with a proper FK to enterpri

attributes.name: activation_fee
attributes.description: One-time fee charged at the time of service activation for this rate plan. Denominated in currency_code. A value of 0 indicates no activation fee. Captured as a one-time charge in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — OneTimeCharge; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration

attributes.name: billing_period
attributes.description: The frequency at which the recurring charge is applied and the billing cycle is closed. Drives invoice generation scheduling in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingCycleSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration

attributes.name: charging_model
attributes.description: The pricing model applied by the rating engine to calculate charges. 'flat' = fixed charge regardless of usage; 'tiered' = stepped rates at volume thresholds; 'volume' = single rate applied to total volume; 'event_based' = per-event charge; 'time_based' = charge per unit of time.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Minimum contractual commitment period in months associated with this rate plan (e.g., 12, 24, 36 months). A value of 0 indicates a month-to-month or no-commitment plan. Drives early termination fee (ETF) calculations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ContractTerm; FCC Consumer Protection Rules 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was first created in the Amdocs Rating engine and ingested into the Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking per ISO/IEC 27001 information security requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — AuditTrail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this rate plan are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency billing environments and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FCC Tariff Filing Requirements

attributes.name: day_of_week_modifier_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan applies day-of-week pricing modifiers (e.g., weekend discount rates). When TRUE, the rating engine evaluates the CDR date against the configured weekend/weekday windows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — DayOfWeekPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: early_termination_fee
attributes.description: Fixed monetary penalty charged to a subscriber who cancels the service before the contract_term_months expires. Denominated in currency_code. A value of 0 indicates no early termination fee. Used in churn management and collections workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PenaltyCharge; FCC Consumer Protection Rules 47 CFR Part 64; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this rate plan is no longer valid for rating new events. Exclusive boundary. NULL indicates an open-ended plan with no scheduled termination. Used for plan deprecation and migration workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this rate plan becomes active and eligible for rating new subscriptions and usage events. Inclusive boundary. Used for temporal validity checks in the rating engine and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod; IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: fair_use_cap_mb
attributes.description: Maximum data volume in megabytes beyond which the fair-use policy is triggered, resulting in speed throttling or additional charges. Distinct from the included_data_volume_mb allowance — this is the absolute ceiling before network management actions are applied. NULL indicates no fair-use cap.
attributes.references: BEREC Net Neutrality Guidelines BoR(20)112; FCC Open Internet Order; TM Forum SID GB922 — PolicyCondition

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which revenue from this rate plan is posted. Enables financial reporting, EBITDA analysis, and MRR/ARPU reconciliation at the plan level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 — FinancialAccount

attributes.name: included_data_volume_mb
attributes.description: Data volume allowance included in the base recurring charge, expressed in megabytes (MB). A value of -1 or NULL indicates unlimited data. The rating engine deducts consumed data against this allowance before applying overage rates or fair-use policy throttling.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.251 — Packet Switched Charging; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolumeProduct

attributes.name: included_sms_count
attributes.description: Number of SMS messages included in the base recurring charge before overage rates apply. A value of -1 or NULL indicates unlimited SMS. Used by the rating engine for SMS CDR allowance tracking.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolumeProduct

attributes.name: included_voice_minutes
attributes.description: Number of voice call minutes included in the rate plan's base recurring charge before overage rates apply. A value of -1 or NULL indicates unlimited voice. Used by the rating engine to track allowance consumption against CDRs.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolumeProduct

attributes.name: is_promotional
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan is a promotional or limited-time offer. When TRUE, the plan may have an associated promotion expiry date and is tracked separately in ARPU and MRR reporting to distinguish promotional revenue from base revenue.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PromotionSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Promotion Configuration

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate plan record was last updated in the source system or Silver layer. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — AuditTrail

attributes.name: off_peak_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the base rate during off-peak hours when time_of_day_modifier_enabled is TRUE. A value of 0.5 means 50% discount during off-peak. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: overage_rate_per_unit
attributes.description: The per-unit charge applied to usage that exceeds the included allowance. The unit of measure is defined by overage_unit_of_measure. For data, this is typically per MB or per GB; for voice, per minute; for SMS, per message. Denominated in currency_code.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageChargeSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: overage_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure against which the overage_rate_per_unit is applied. Defines the granularity of overage billing (e.g., per MB for data, per minute for voice, per message for SMS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MB|GB|minute|second|message|event|kB — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — UnitOfMeasure; 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture

attributes.name: peak_end_time
attributes.description: The daily end time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) of the peak pricing window. Used by the rating engine to determine whether a CDR falls within peak or off-peak hours. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: peak_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the base rate during peak hours when time_of_day_modifier_enabled is TRUE. A value of 1.0 means no adjustment; 1.5 means 50% premium during peak. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: peak_start_time
attributes.description: The daily start time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) of the peak pricing window. Used by the rating engine to determine whether a CDR falls within peak or off-peak hours. NULL when time-of-day pricing is not enabled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate plan within the Amdocs Rating engine. Controls whether the plan is available for new subscriptions and active rating. 'draft' = under configuration; 'active' = live for rating; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'deprecated' = replaced by a newer plan; 'inactive' = decommissioned.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — LifecycleStatus; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Billing modality of the rate plan. 'postpaid' = charges billed after consumption cycle; 'prepaid' = charges deducted from pre-loaded balance via Comverse ONE real-time rating; 'hybrid' = mixed prepaid/postpaid; 'wholesale' = inter-operator or MVNO wholesale pricing; 'mvno' = Mobile Virtual Network Operator resale pricing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingArrangement; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: promotion_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the promotional pricing expires and the standard rate plan pricing takes effect. Applicable only when is_promotional is TRUE. NULL for non-promotional plans.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PromotionSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Promotion Configuration

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate partial-period charges when a subscription starts or ends mid-billing-cycle. 'daily' = charge proportional to days active; 'full_period' = charge full cycle regardless; 'none' = no proration applied.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingCycleSpecification; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration; IFRS 15

attributes.name: rate_plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the rate plan within the Amdocs Rating engine and is referenced by downstream billing, CDR processing, and invoice generation systems. Used as the business key for cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: rate_plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the rate plan's pricing logic, applicable services, and commercial intent. Used by product managers, billing analysts, and regulatory reporting teams to understand the plan's scope.

attributes.name: rate_plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the rate plan as displayed in the Amdocs Rating engine configuration and referenced in billing statements and internal reporting (e.g., 'Unlimited 5G Consumer Postpaid', 'SMB Data Tier 3').

attributes.name: rate_tier_count
attributes.description: Number of pricing tiers (step thresholds) defined for this rate plan. A value of 1 indicates flat-rate pricing; values greater than 1 indicate tiered/stepped pricing where different rates apply at different usage volumes. Drives the rating engine's tier evaluation logic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: rating_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether usage events (CDRs) under this rate plan are rated in real-time (online charging via Comverse ONE for prepaid) or in batch mode (offline charging via Amdocs for postpaid), or a hybrid of both.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — RatingFunction; Comverse ONE Real-Time Rating

attributes.name: recurring_charge_amount
attributes.description: The fixed periodic charge applied to a subscription on this rate plan per billing cycle (e.g., monthly base fee). Represents the Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) component at the plan level. Denominated in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — RecurringCharge; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Configuration

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_code
attributes.description: Code that maps this rate plan to the appropriate revenue recognition treatment in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Determines how recurring and one-time charges are recognized over the contract term per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation rules.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)

attributes.name: roaming_data_rate_per_mb
attributes.description: Per-megabyte charge applied to data usage while roaming internationally, denominated in currency_code. Applies when roaming_enabled is TRUE and the subscriber is on a visited network. Used for IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TAP3 — IOT; EU Roaming Regulation 2022/612; TM Forum SID GB922 — RoamingCharge

attributes.name: roaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether international roaming usage is permitted and rated under this rate plan. When FALSE, roaming CDRs are blocked or rated at a default barring rate. Relevant for NRTRDE/TAP roaming data exchange compliance.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21 — Roaming Database; GSMA TAP3 — Transferred Account Procedure; 3GPP TS 22.011

attributes.name: roaming_voice_rate_per_min
attributes.description: Per-minute charge applied to voice calls while roaming internationally, denominated in currency_code. Applies when roaming_enabled is TRUE. Used for IOT reconciliation and NRTRDE reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TAP3 — IOT; EU Roaming Regulation 2022/612; TM Forum SID GB922 — RoamingCharge

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The telecommunications service category to which this rate plan applies. Determines which usage event types (CDRs) are rated against this plan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|data|sms|roaming|iot|iptv|voip|mms — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240 — Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922 — ServiceSpecification

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this rate plan record was extracted (e.g., 'AMDOCS_RATING', 'COMVERSE_ONE'). Supports data lineage, multi-source reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — DataSource; ISO/IEC 27001 — Data Provenance

attributes.name: tax_class_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code assigned to this rate plan, used by the Amdocs tax engine to determine applicable tax rates (e.g., USF, VAT, GST, E911 surcharges). Maps to the tax jurisdiction configuration in the billing system.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund (USF) Rules 47 CFR Part 54; ITU-T D.150 — Taxation of Telecommunications; ISO 20022 — Tax Information

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: The radio access or fixed-line network technology to which this rate plan applies. Used by the rating engine to apply technology-specific pricing tiers (e.g., 5G NR premium data rates vs LTE standard rates). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 2G|3G|4G_LTE|5G_NR|FTTH|GPON|ADSL|VDSL|WIFI — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.261 — Service Requirements for 5G; ITU-T G.984 — GPON; ETSI TS 136 series — LTE

attributes.name: tier_rate_1
attributes.description: Per-unit charge applied to usage within the first pricing tier (from 0 to tier_threshold_1_mb). Denominated in currency_code per overage_unit_of_measure.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: tier_rate_2
attributes.description: Per-unit charge applied to usage within the second pricing tier (from tier_threshold_1_mb to tier_threshold_2_mb). Denominated in currency_code per overage_unit_of_measure. NULL if fewer than 2 tiers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: tier_rate_3
attributes.description: Per-unit charge applied to usage beyond tier_threshold_2_mb (third tier and above). Denominated in currency_code per overage_unit_of_measure. NULL if fewer than 3 tiers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: tier_threshold_1_mb
attributes.description: Usage volume threshold in MB at which the first pricing tier ends and the second tier begins. NULL if the plan has fewer than 2 tiers. Used by the Amdocs rating engine for stepped-rate calculation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: tier_threshold_2_mb
attributes.description: Usage volume threshold in MB at which the second pricing tier ends and the third tier begins. NULL if the plan has fewer than 3 tiers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PricingLogicAlgorithm; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: time_of_day_modifier_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate plan applies time-of-day pricing modifiers (e.g., peak/off-peak rates). When TRUE, the rating engine evaluates the CDR timestamp against the defined peak/off-peak windows to apply the appropriate rate multiplier.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TimeOfDayPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this rate plan record. Incremented each time the plan configuration is modified. Supports audit trail, change management, and point-in-time rating reconstruction for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — VersionNumber; Amdocs Revenue Management Configuration Audit

attributes.name: weekend_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the base rate on weekend days (Saturday and Sunday) when day_of_week_modifier_enabled is TRUE. A value of 0.0 means free weekend calls/data. NULL when day-of-week pricing is not enabled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — DayOfWeekPricingCondition; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Configuration

products.name: credit_note
products.description: Formal financial document issued to a customer to credit their account for overbilling, service outages, returned equipment, or dispute resolutions. Distinct from adjustment (internal) — credit note is a customer-facing financial document.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service (e.g., mobile line, broadband, IPTV, VoIP) for which the credit is being issued. Nullable — populated when the credit is attributable to a specific service instance rather than the entire account.
