attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total credit amount that has been applied against invoices or account balances to date. Enables tracking of partial credit consumption and remaining credit balance for aged credit analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: applied_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit note was fully or partially applied against an invoice or account balance. Nullable until the credit is consumed. Used for cash flow and revenue reconciliation reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of the credit note. 'pending' = awaiting manager/finance approval; 'approved' = authorized for issuance; 'rejected' = denied by approver; 'auto_approved' = system-approved within automated threshold limits in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; SOX Compliance; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The employee ID or username of the billing manager or finance officer who approved the credit note issuance. Nullable for auto-approved credits. Required for SOX compliance audit trails and segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the credit note was approved by the authorized approver. Nullable for auto-approved or pending credits. Used for approval SLA monitoring and SOX audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period to which this credit note relates. Together with billing_period_start, defines the revenue period impacted by this credit for financial reporting and revenue assurance.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period to which this credit note relates. Used to associate the credit with the correct revenue period for IFRS 15 revenue recognition reversal and MRR impact reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the business unit responsible for the credit note. Used for internal financial reporting, OPEX allocation, and departmental P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID GB922; Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the credit note record was first created in the billing system or data platform. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED marker for data lineage, audit trails, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The gross pre-tax credit amount to be applied to the customer's account, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the principal financial value of the credit note before tax reversal. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for revenue reversal reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Billing Transparency Rules

attributes.name: credit_category
attributes.description: The billing charge category being credited. Identifies whether the credit relates to recurring service charges, usage-based charges (CDR-level), equipment fees, tax adjustments, interconnect/wholesale charges, or roaming charges. Supports revenue assurance and MRR impact analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable unique identifier for the credit note as printed on the customer-facing financial document. Assigned by Amdocs Revenue Management upon issuance. Used for customer correspondence, dispute tracking, and audit trails.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: credit_note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit note. 'issued' = generated and sent to customer; 'applied' = fully offset against an invoice or balance; 'partially_applied' = partially consumed; 'expired' = validity period lapsed without full application; 'cancelled' = withdrawn before application; 'voided' = reversed post-issuance for error correction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issued|applied|partially_applied|expired|cancelled|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credit_note_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit note by its business nature. 'financial' = billing error correction; 'commercial' = commercial dispute resolution; 'regulatory' = mandated by FCC/Ofcom/BEREC regulatory ruling; 'goodwill' = customer retention gesture; 'equipment_return' = CPE/ONT/OLT equipment return credit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; FCC Regulations; Ofcom Regulations; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this credit note (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency billing environments and international roaming credit scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the credit note document was delivered to the customer. Supports omnichannel customer communication tracking and digital delivery compliance requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Interaction; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the credit note document was delivered to the customer via the specified delivery channel. Used for customer communication audit trails and regulatory compliance with billing notification requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Interaction; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Ofcom Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the credit note becomes effective for application against the customer's account balance or future invoices. May differ from issue_date when backdated credits are applied for service outage periods.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the credit note can no longer be applied to the customer's account. Nullable for credits with no expiry. Used for dunning management and aged credit reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which the credit note reversal is posted. Enables financial reconciliation between the billing system (Amdocs) and the ERP (SAP S/4HANA) for period-close and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15; SOX Section 302/404; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit note was issued as a result of a regulatory mandate from FCC, Ofcom, BEREC, or other governing body. True = regulatory-mandated credit; False = commercially or operationally initiated. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FCC Regulations; Ofcom Regulations; BEREC Guidelines; NTIA; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the credit note was formally issued to the customer. This is the principal business event date printed on the credit note document and used for revenue recognition reversal under IFRS 15.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the credit note record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED marker for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for issuing the credit note. Examples include: OVERBILLING, SVC_OUTAGE, EQUIP_RETURN, DISPUTE_RESOLUTION, GOODWILL, RATE_ERROR, PROMO_ADJUSTMENT. Drives revenue assurance analytics and root cause reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OVERBILLING|SVC_OUTAGE|EQUIP_RETURN|DISPUTE_RESOLUTION|GOODWILL|RATE_ERROR|PROMO_ADJUSTMENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Billing Transparency Rules

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the reason for issuing the credit note, providing additional context beyond the reason_code. Populated by billing agents or automated systems in Amdocs Revenue Management. Used for customer communication and audit documentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: remaining_credit_amount
attributes.description: The unapplied balance of the credit note (total_credit_amount minus applied_amount). Represents the credit still available for future application. Used for credit liability reporting and customer account balance management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) in which the revenue reversal from this credit note is recognized under IFRS 15 / ASC 606. Used by SAP S/4HANA Finance for general ledger posting and period-close reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: The native identifier of this credit note in the originating source system (e.g., Amdocs internal credit note ID, Comverse ONE transaction reference). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational BSS/CRM systems.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this credit note. 'amdocs' = Amdocs Revenue Management (postpaid billing); 'comverse_one' = Comverse ONE (prepaid balance management); 'salesforce' = Salesforce CRM (dispute-driven); 'servicenow' = ServiceNow ITSM (incident-driven); 'manual' = manually entered by billing agent.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE; Salesforce CRM; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or tax type code applied to the credit note for tax reversal calculation. Aligns with the tax code on the original invoice. Used for tax authority reporting and VAT/GST compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic tax jurisdiction (e.g., state, country, municipality) applicable to the tax reversal on this credit note. Required for multi-jurisdiction tax compliance reporting to federal, state, and local tax authorities.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; FCC Universal Service Fund; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: tax_reversal_amount
attributes.description: The tax component reversed as part of this credit note, corresponding to the tax originally charged on the credited amount. Enables accurate tax liability adjustments and compliance with tax authority reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total credit amount inclusive of tax reversal (credit_amount + tax_reversal_amount). This is the net financial value credited to the customer's account and the figure printed on the customer-facing credit note document.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Billing Transparency Rules

attributes.description: Unique sequence number assigned by the mediation system to this SMS CDR for traceability and reconciliation across billing and revenue assurance systems.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.298 - Charging Data Record (CDR) Parameter Description

attributes.name: charging_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SMS event is chargeable to the subscriber: chargeable (standard billing applies), non_chargeable (free service message), promotional (marketing campaign, no charge), zero_rated (included in bundle or plan).
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.298 - Charging Data Record (CDR) Parameter Description

attributes.name: content_class
attributes.description: Classification of the message content for regulatory reporting and rating: standard (regular P2P), premium (premium-rate services), promotional (marketing A2P), transactional (account notifications), otp (one-time password), alert (emergency or service alerts).
attributes.references: FCC TCPA - Telephone Consumer Protection Act; GSMA A2P SMS Best Practices

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the rated amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null if non-chargeable.

attributes.name: data_coding_scheme
attributes.description: Code indicating the character encoding and message class of the SMS (e.g., 7-bit GSM, 8-bit data, UCS-2 Unicode). Used for message rendering and international character support.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Final delivery outcome of the SMS message: delivered (successfully received by destination), failed (permanent delivery failure), pending (awaiting retry), expired (exceeded retry window), rejected (blocked by spam filter or policy), unknown (status not available).
attributes.references: GSMA SMS and MMS Interworking Guidelines

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the SMS message was successfully delivered to the terminating device, or when final delivery failure was confirmed. Null if delivery is still pending.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SMS event was flagged by fraud detection systems as potentially fraudulent (e.g., SMS spam, A2P abuse, SIM box fraud). True if flagged, false otherwise.
attributes.references: GSMA Fraud and Security Group (FASG) Guidelines

attributes.name: home_network_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Mobile Country Code and Mobile Network Code (MCC-MNC)
attributes.description: The MCC-MNC code of the subscribers home network. Used to identify the operator responsible for billing and to distinguish home vs. roaming traffic.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212 - Identification Plan for Land Mobile Stations; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: imei
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the mobile device used to send or receive this SMS. Used for device tracking, fraud detection, and stolen device blocking. Personally identifiable information subject to privacy regulations.

attributes.name: mediation_status
attributes.description: Processing status of the SMS CDR within the mediation and usage collection pipeline: raw (newly collected), mediated (normalized and enriched), validated (passed quality checks), rejected (failed validation), duplicate (identified as duplicate record).

attributes.name: mediation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SMS CDR was processed by the mediation system and loaded into the usage data repository.

attributes.name: message_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference identifier assigned by the originating application or SMSC for message tracking and delivery receipt correlation. Used for A2P campaign tracking and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: message_segment_count
attributes.description: Number of SMS segments required to transmit the message. Standard SMS is 160 characters (1 segment); longer messages are split into multiple concatenated segments, each rated separately.

attributes.name: message_size_bytes
attributes.description: Total size of the SMS or MMS message payload in bytes. Used for rating, especially for MMS and concatenated SMS messages that span multiple segments.

attributes.name: message_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the SMS message was originated or received by the network, captured in UTC. This is the principal business event timestamp for rating and billing purposes.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.298 - Charging Data Record (CDR) Parameter Description

attributes.name: message_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SMS message: MT (Mobile Terminated - incoming to subscriber), MO (Mobile Originated - outgoing from subscriber), P2P (Person-to-Person), A2P (Application-to-Person for commercial messaging), P2A (Person-to-Application), MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service).
attributes.references: GSMA SMS and MMS Interworking Guidelines

attributes.name: originating_msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Originating Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The phone number of the subscriber or application that originated the SMS message. Personally identifiable information subject to CPNI and privacy regulations.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 - International Public Telecommunication Numbering Plan

attributes.name: partition_date
attributes.description: The date used for physical partitioning of this SMS record in the lakehouse storage layer, typically derived from message_timestamp. Used for query optimization and data lifecycle management.

attributes.name: priority_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SMS was marked as high-priority for expedited delivery (e.g., emergency alerts, OTP messages). True if high-priority, false otherwise.

attributes.name: protocol_identifier
attributes.description: SMS protocol identifier code indicating the type of message protocol used (e.g., standard SMS, SIM data download, email gateway). Used for technical troubleshooting and protocol-specific routing.

attributes.name: rated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount charged for this SMS event after rating engine processing, in the billing currency. Null if non-chargeable or not yet rated.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SMS record was first created in the usage data repository. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SMS record was last modified in the usage data repository. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: reply_path_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a reply path was requested for this SMS, allowing the recipient to reply via the same SMSC route. True if reply path enabled, false otherwise.

attributes.name: roaming_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the originating or terminating subscriber was roaming on a visited network at the time of the SMS event. True if roaming, false if on home network.

attributes.name: service_code
attributes.description: Internal service code or product identifier used by the rating engine to determine the applicable tariff and billing treatment for this SMS event.

attributes.name: smsc_address
attributes.description: Network address of the SMSC node that processed and routed this SMS message. Used for network troubleshooting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the upstream system or mediation platform that provided this SMS CDR (e.g., SMSC vendor name, mediation system instance). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: spam_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00 to 100.00) assigned by spam detection algorithms indicating the likelihood that this SMS is unsolicited commercial messaging or spam. Higher scores indicate higher spam probability.
attributes.references: GSMA A2P SMS Best Practices; FCC TCPA

attributes.name: terminating_msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terminating Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The phone number of the subscriber or application that received the SMS message. Personally identifiable information subject to CPNI and privacy regulations.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 - International Public Telecommunication Numbering Plan

attributes.name: validity_period_minutes
attributes.description: The time period (in minutes) during which the SMSC will attempt to deliver the message before expiring it. Null if default validity period applies.

Primary source for data usage rating and fair-use policy enforcement.

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: The Access Point Name that defines the packet data network and services the subscriber is accessing (e.g., internet, MMS, IMS).

attributes.name: charging_characteristics
attributes.description: Hexadecimal string defining the charging behavior for this session (e.g., online/offline charging, prepaid/postpaid). Used by charging systems to determine rating rules.

attributes.name: charging_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the charging system to correlate this session with billing and rating records. Links usage to revenue assurance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this data session record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: downlink_bytes
attributes.description: Total number of bytes transmitted from the network to the subscriber device during this session. Used for usage-based billing and fair-use policy enforcement.

attributes.name: five_qi
attributes.description: 5G QoS Identifier for 5G NR sessions, defining the packet forwarding treatment and service characteristics. Replaces QCI in 5G networks.

attributes.name: home_plmn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Mobile Country Code (MCC) and Mobile Network Code (MNC) of the subscriber home network. Used for subscriber identification and roaming validation.

attributes.name: imei
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mobile device hardware used during this data session. Used for device tracking and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: location_area_code
attributes.description: Location Area Code identifying the geographic area where the session occurred. Used for location-based services and network planning.

attributes.name: mediation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this raw CDR was processed and validated by the mediation system. Used for data lineage and processing audit trails.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF635 Usage Management API

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The phone number of the subscriber associated with this data session. Unique mobile subscriber identifier used for routing and billing.

attributes.name: pdn_type
attributes.description: The IP address type assigned to the subscriber for this session (IPv4, IPv6, or dual-stack IPv4v6). Critical for IP address management and network planning.

attributes.name: peak_downlink_throughput_kbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Peak Downlink Throughput in Kilobits per Second (Kbps)
attributes.description: Maximum downlink data transfer rate achieved during the session, measured in kilobits per second. Used for Quality of Service (QoS) analysis and network performance monitoring.

attributes.name: peak_uplink_throughput_kbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Peak Uplink Throughput in Kilobits per Second (Kbps)
attributes.description: Maximum uplink data transfer rate achieved during the session, measured in kilobits per second. Used for Quality of Service (QoS) analysis and network performance monitoring.

attributes.name: pgw_address
attributes.description: IP address of the PGW node that served this session in LTE networks. Gateway between the mobile network and external packet data networks.

attributes.name: qci
attributes.description: QoS Class Identifier for LTE sessions, defining the packet forwarding treatment (e.g., priority, packet delay budget, packet error loss rate). Values range from 1 to 9 for standardized bearers.

attributes.name: rat_type
attributes.description: The radio access technology used during the data session (e.g., 2G, 3G, HSPA, LTE, 5G NR). Critical for network performance analysis and technology migration tracking.

attributes.name: rating_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the rating group applied to this session, determining the pricing rules and tariff plan. Used by real-time charging systems.

attributes.name: record_closing_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when this charging data record was closed and finalized by the network element. Marks the record as complete for billing processing.

attributes.name: record_opening_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when this charging data record was opened by the network element. Used for CDR lifecycle tracking and mediation processing.

attributes.name: record_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to this CDR by the generating network element. Used for duplicate detection and record ordering in mediation systems.

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Type classification of this CDR based on the generating network element and session characteristics (e.g., S-CDR for SGSN, PGW-CDR for LTE gateway). Used for CDR routing and processing rules.

attributes.name: roaming_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this session occurred while the subscriber was roaming on a partner network. Critical for roaming billing and Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) processing.

attributes.name: service_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service type consumed during this session (e.g., internet browsing, video streaming, VoIP). Used for service-based rating and analytics.

attributes.name: serving_node_type
attributes.description: Type of core network node that served this session (SGSN for 2G/3G, PGW/SGW for LTE, UPF for 5G). Used for network architecture analysis.

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the data session in seconds, calculated from start to end timestamp. Used for time-based rating and analytics.

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the packet data session was terminated. Used to calculate session duration and billing periods.

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the packet data session was initiated by the subscriber. Primary business event timestamp for session lifecycle.

attributes.name: session_termination_cause
attributes.description: The reason code or description for why the data session was terminated (e.g., normal release, user disconnect, network failure, timeout). Used for troubleshooting and quality analysis.

attributes.name: sgsn_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: Serving General Packet Radio Service (GPRS) Support Node (SGSN) Address
attributes.description: IP address of the SGSN node that served this session in 2G/3G networks. Used for network element tracking and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: sgw_address
attributes.description: IP address of the SGW node that served this session in LTE networks. Routes and forwards user data packets between the RAN and PGW.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the network element or system that generated this CDR (e.g., PGW node name, UPF instance). Used for data provenance and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: total_bytes
attributes.description: Combined total of uplink and downlink bytes transferred during the session. Primary metric for data usage rating and quota management.

attributes.name: tracking_area_code
attributes.description: Tracking Area Code for LTE/5G networks, identifying the registration area. Used for mobility management and location tracking.

attributes.name: ue_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address assigned to the subscriber device during this data session. Used for session correlation and security analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this data session record was last modified in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: upf_address
attributes.description: IP address of the UPF node that served this session in 5G networks. Handles user plane traffic routing and forwarding in 5G core.

attributes.name: uplink_bytes
attributes.description: Total number of bytes transmitted from the subscriber device to the network during this session. Used for usage-based billing and fair-use policy enforcement.

products.name: mediation_event
products.description: Mediation layer processing lifecycle record tracking each raw usage event from network collection through normalization, enrichment, duplicate detection, validation, rejection handling, and delivery to downstream rating engines. Captures source network element, collection timestamp, raw record reference, mediation node ID, processing status (collected, normalized, enriched, validated, rated, rejected, reprocessed), rejection reason code and category (duplicate, missing mandatory field, format error, out-of-sequence, future-dated, unknown subscriber, invalid IMSI), retry count, retry eligibility flag, manual review queue assignment, resolution outcome (auto-corrected, manually resolved, permanently rejected, written off), reprocessing history, and downstream system delivery confirmation with acknowledgement timestamp. This is the single authoritative record for ALL mediation outcomes including rejections — no separate rejection entity exists. Critical for revenue assurance gap detection, mediation SLA monitoring, and regulatory audit trails demonstrating usage processing completeness.
products.reference: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 / OSS Mediation

products.name: balance
products.description: Real-time subscriber usage balance and bundle consumption tracking record — the single authoritative source for current-state balance snapshots AND event-level consumption/deduction history across all bundle types. Captures balance at period start, consumed units per bundle instance, remaining units, overage flag/units, throttle threshold and status, bundle instance reference, bundle expiry date, last consumption event timestamp, per-event deduction history with full granularity, throttle trigger actions, and bundle lifecycle state. Consolidates both snapshot and transactional consumption views — no separate bundle consumption entity exists.

products.name: asset_lifecycle_event

Event types: procurement, deployment, swap, repair, decommission, write-off, physical-audit, cycle-count, and reconciliation. attributes.description: Date when the equipment was physically installed and commissioned at the site. Used for age tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: Primary management IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) assigned to the equipment for network management, monitoring, and configuration access.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance activity performed on the equipment. Used for maintenance scheduling and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this equipment record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: max_power_draw_watts
attributes.description: Maximum power consumption in watts under peak load conditions. Critical for power supply sizing and cooling requirements.

attributes.name: mtbf_hours
attributes.description: Manufacturer-rated Mean Time Between Failures in hours. Reliability metric used for spare parts planning and network resilience design.

attributes.name: mttr_hours
attributes.description: Average time in hours required to repair or replace the equipment when a failure occurs. Used for SLA planning and workforce scheduling.

attributes.name: network_function
attributes.description: Primary network function or service role performed by the equipment. Examples: PACKET_CORE, VOICE_SWITCHING, BROADBAND_AGGREGATION, RADIO_ACCESS, TRANSPORT_ROUTING, POLICY_CONTROL.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance activity based on vendor recommendations or organizational policy.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special configurations, known issues, or operational notes about the equipment.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum ambient temperature in Celsius at which the equipment can operate within specifications. Used for cooling system design.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum ambient temperature in Celsius at which the equipment can operate within specifications. Critical for outdoor and remote site deployments.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the equipment: IN_SERVICE (active and carrying traffic), STANDBY (ready but not active), MAINTENANCE (undergoing planned maintenance), FAULTY (failed or degraded), DECOMMISSIONED (retired from service), RESERVED (allocated but not yet deployed).

attributes.name: port_capacity_gbps
attributes.description: Aggregate throughput capacity across all ports in gigabits per second (Gbps). Used for capacity planning and traffic engineering.

attributes.name: port_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical or logical ports available on the equipment for connectivity (e.g., Ethernet ports, fiber ports, radio carriers).

attributes.name: power_draw_watts
attributes.description: Typical power consumption of the equipment in watts under normal operating conditions. Used for power capacity planning and OPEX calculation.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number under which the equipment was procured. Links to procurement and financial systems for cost tracking.

attributes.name: rack_location
attributes.description: Physical rack identifier within the site where the equipment is mounted. Format varies by site convention (e.g., R01, RACK-A-12).

attributes.name: rack_unit_height
attributes.description: Number of rack units (RU) occupied by the equipment. Standard values: 1U, 2U, 4U, etc.

attributes.name: rack_unit_position
attributes.description: Starting rack unit position (1U = 1.75 inches) from the bottom of the rack where the equipment is mounted. Used for physical space planning and cable management.

attributes.name: redundancy_role
attributes.description: Role of the equipment in redundancy configuration. PRIMARY (active), SECONDARY (standby backup), STANDALONE (no redundancy), N_PLUS_1 (shared backup for multiple primaries).

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Current firmware or software version running on the equipment. Format typically follows semantic versioning (e.g., 21.4.2, 5.1.0-R2A).

attributes.name: supported_standards
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of technology standards and protocols supported by the equipment. Examples: LTE, 5G_NR, GPON, XGS_PON, DOCSIS_3.1, MPLS, SD_WAN, VoLTE, IMS.

domains.name: interconnect
domains.description: SSOT for inter-operator settlement and wholesale traffic exchange — IOT tariff tables, TAP file processing, roaming agreements, transit traffic records, peering arrangements, NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data, and financial settlement with domestic and international carriers.
domains.references: GSMA NRTRDE / TAP3 / ITU-T E.164 / IOT Framework

products.name: carrier_agreement
products.description: Master record of bilateral or multilateral commercial agreements between Telecommunication and domestic/international operators covering roaming, wholesale, and MVNO relationships. Captures agreement type (IOT, CAMEL, LTE, 5G NR, MVNO hosting, national roaming, wholesale broadband, capacity resale), counterparty carrier reference, effective dates, covered services (voice, SMS, data, VoLTE, VoNR), discount structures, TAP file exchange obligations, NRTRDE requirements, minimum volume commitments and true-up terms, revenue share terms, SLA references, and agreement status. SSOT for all inter-operator commercial relationship governance.
products.reference: GSMA PRD AA.12 / TM Forum SID RoamingAgreement

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for carrier_agreement

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Wholesale and MVNO agreements are commercial contracts with enterprise customers. Business need: tracking which enterprise account holds the roaming/interconnect agreement for billing, SLA management,

attributes.name: counterparty_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the domestic or international operator that is the counterparty to this agreement. Links to the carrier/partner master record in the interconnect domain.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rate table applicable to this agreement. The IOT table defines per-unit wholesale rates for voice (per minute), SMS (per message), and data (per MB/GB) exchanged between operators.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: mvno_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.mvno_profile. Business justification: MVNO wholesale access is governed by a carrier agreement between the host MNO and the MVNO. Linking carrier_agreement to mvno_profile enables MVNO wholesale agreement tracking, capacity management, an

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Roaming agreements with MVNO/reseller partners (not traditional carriers) require partner_id link. Business process: MVNO roaming agreement lifecycle management, partner contract tracking, consolidate

attributes.name: qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.qos_profile. Business justification: Roaming and interconnect agreements specify QoS requirements (latency, jitter, packet loss) that must be enforced by network QoS profiles. Required for SLA compliance verification and service assuranc

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: International carrier interconnect and roaming agreements must be notified to or filed with national regulators in many jurisdictions. Compliance officers track the specific regulatory filing record a

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Roaming/interconnect agreements must comply with specific regulatory obligations (FCC Part 64, international settlement policies, GDPR). Tracks which obligation each agreement satisfies for audit trai

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.roaming_agreement. Business justification: A carrier_agreement of type roaming references a specific partner roaming_agreement for operational parameters (TAP exchange, NRTRDE, steering policy). Linking enables cross-domain agreement lifecycle

attributes.name: sla_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.sla_contract. Business justification: Carrier agreements have formal SLA performance obligations (TAP transmission windows, settlement cycles). Linking to assurance.sla_contract enables SLA breach monitoring and penalty enforcement agains

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Service Level Agreement (SLA) record governing quality of service commitments under this carrier agreement, including network availability, latency, and fault resolution targets.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ETSI TS 102 250; ITU-T G.1000

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive commercial name of the carrier agreement (e.g., 'Roaming IOT Agreement – Carrier X 2024'). Used for display in BSS portals and settlement reports.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the bilateral or multilateral carrier agreement. Used in correspondence, TAP file headers, and inter-operator settlement documents. Maps to the contract reference in Amdocs Revenue Management and Netcracker OSS/BSS.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the carrier agreement. DRAFT = under negotiation; ACTIVE = commercially live and binding; SUSPENDED = temporarily halted by mutual or unilateral action; TERMINATED = permanently ended; EXPIRED = reached end date without renewal; PENDING_APPROVAL = awaiting regulatory or internal sign-off.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier agreement by commercial relationship type. IOT = Inter-Operator Tariff roaming; CAMEL = Customised Applications for Mobile networks Enhanced Logic; MVNO_HOSTING = Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) hosting arrangement; NATIONAL_ROAMING = domestic network sharing; WHOLESALE_BROADBAND = wholesale broadband resale; CAPACITY_RESALE = bandwidth/capacity resale; TRANSIT = transit traffic routing; PEERING = direct traffic exchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IOT|CAMEL|MVNO_HOSTING|NATIONAL_ROAMING|WHOLESALE_BROADBAND|CAPACITY_RESALE|TRANSIT|PEERING — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13; 3GPP TS 22.101

attributes.name: agreement_version
attributes.description: Version number of the agreement document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented when amendments are executed. Enables tracking of agreement evolution and ensures the correct rate tables are applied for each version period.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments executed against this agreement since its original signing. Provides a quick indicator of agreement complexity and negotiation history.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement automatically renews upon reaching its effective_until_date without requiring a new signed instrument. True = auto-renews; False = requires explicit renewal action.

attributes.name: covered_services
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of telecommunication services covered under this agreement (e.g., VOICE, SMS, DATA, VOLTE, VONR, MMS, CAMEL_GPRS). Governs which service types are eligible for IOT settlement and TAP file exchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VOICE|SMS|DATA|VOLTE|VONR|MMS|CAMEL_GPRS|USSD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.101; GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier agreement record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: data_protection_addendum_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a data protection addendum (DPA) is attached to this agreement, governing the processing of subscriber personal data exchanged between operators in compliance with GDPR or equivalent regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; ISO/IEC 27001; BEREC Guidelines on Roaming

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to standard IOT rates when discount_type is PERCENTAGE or VOLUME_TIERED. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Null when discount_type is FLAT_RATE or NONE.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount structure applied to IOT rates under this agreement. FLAT_RATE = fixed per-unit reduction; VOLUME_TIERED = discount scales with traffic volume; PERCENTAGE = percentage reduction off standard IOT; NEGOTIATED_RATE = bespoke bilaterally agreed rate; NONE = standard IOT applies.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving financial or operational disputes arising under this agreement. GSMA_MEDIATION refers to the GSMA Billing and Accounting Dispute Resolution process.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the carrier agreement becomes commercially binding and operationally active. Governs the start of IOT tariff applicability, TAP file exchange obligations, and NRTRDE reporting requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the carrier agreement ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended agreements. When populated, triggers renewal workflow and settlement true-up processing in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: fraud_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement includes specific fraud prevention obligations such as NRTRDE, SIM box detection cooperation, or GSMA Fraud Information Gathering System (FIGS) participation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11; GSMA PRD IR.82; ITU-T E.408

attributes.name: governing_law_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern this agreement (e.g., GBR for English law, USA for US law). Relevant for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: interconnect_agreement_ref
attributes.description: External reference number or document identifier for the physical signed agreement document, as stored in the document management system or SAP S/4HANA contract repository. Enables traceability to the legal instrument.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agreement was last formally reviewed by the commercial team for rate competitiveness, volume performance, and compliance. Supports the agreement lifecycle management process.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: min_volume_commitment_units
attributes.description: Minimum traffic volume committed by one or both parties under this agreement, expressed in the unit defined by min_volume_unit (e.g., minutes, MB, messages). Triggers true-up billing if actual volume falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: min_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum volume commitment (min_volume_commitment_units). MINUTES = voice traffic; MEGABYTES/GIGABYTES = data traffic; MESSAGES = SMS/MMS; ERLANGS = traffic intensity for capacity agreements.

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: Radio access network generation(s) covered by this agreement. 2G = GSM/GPRS/EDGE; 3G = UMTS/HSPA; 4G_LTE = Long-Term Evolution (LTE); 5G_NR = 5G New Radio (NR); ALL = all generations. Determines applicable IOT tariff tables and NRTRDE reporting scope.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.101; GSMA PRD IR.21; ETSI TS 122 101

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this agreement. Triggers workflow notifications to the commercial owner and finance team in advance of the review.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement. Governs the termination workflow in contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: nrtrde_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement requires Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) reporting per GSMA PRD FS.11. NRTRDE enables fraud detection by providing near-real-time CDR visibility to the home operator.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: nrtrde_transmission_window_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Transmission Window (Hours)
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which NRTRDE files must be transmitted to the home operator after the roaming CDR is generated. Standard GSMA requirement is 4 hours; some bilateral agreements specify tighter windows.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of each automatic renewal cycle when auto_renewal_flag is True. Null when auto-renewal is not applicable.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue shared with the counterparty operator under MVNO hosting, content, or wholesale broadband agreements. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 20.00 = 20%). Null for pure IOT/TAP agreements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: roaming_direction
attributes.description: Direction of roaming traffic covered by this agreement. INBOUND = foreign subscribers roaming on Telecommunication's network; OUTBOUND = Telecommunication's subscribers roaming on the counterparty's network; BILATERAL = both directions.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial settlement under this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Governs currency conversion in Amdocs Revenue Management inter-operator billing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD AA.13; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: settlement_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial settlement is performed between the parties under this agreement. Governs the billing cycle in Amdocs Revenue Management inter-operator invoicing.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which all parties executed the agreement. May precede the effective_from_date during a transition or notice period. Used for legal and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this agreement record was sourced. AMDOCS = Amdocs Revenue Management; NETCRACKER = Netcracker OSS/BSS; SALESFORCE = Salesforce CRM; SAP = SAP S/4HANA; MANUAL = manually entered.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: tap_file_exchange_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) File Exchange Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement mandates Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) file exchange for roaming CDR settlement. True = TAP files must be exchanged per GSMA PRD TD.57 specifications.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: tap_version
attributes.description: Version of the GSMA Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) standard used for CDR file exchange under this agreement. Governs file format and field mapping in the TAP processing pipeline.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which the agreement was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from effective_until_date which is the planned end; this captures early or unilateral termination events.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: true_up_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which minimum volume commitment true-up calculations are performed. If actual traffic falls below min_volume_commitment_units within the period, a shortfall charge is raised in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier agreement record was last modified in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master registry of all domestic and international carriers, transit operators, MVNOs, and wholesale partners with whom Telecommunication has interconnect, roaming, or settlement relationships. Captures carrier code (TADIG, MCCMNC, carrier ID), carrier name, country, carrier type (MNO, MVNO, transit, IXC, LEC, ISP), regulatory identifiers, NOC contact details, clearinghouse affiliations, and operational status. Central reference entity for all interconnect domain relationships — every agreement, invoice, TAP file, and traffic record references this registry.
products.reference: GSMA TADIG / ITU-T E.212 MCCMNC

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each carrier record in the interconnect carrier master registry. Primary key for all interconnect domain relationships.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party entity

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Many interconnect carriers are also business partners (MVNOs, wholesale customers, resellers). Business process: Unified partner relationship management, consolidated billing across interconnect and p

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Full legal or trading name of the carrier, transit operator, MVNO, or wholesale partner as registered with the relevant regulatory authority. Used as the primary human-readable identifier across all interconnect domain products.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier relationship. Active indicates live traffic exchange; suspended indicates temporary halt pending dispute or non-payment; terminated indicates the relationship has ended; pending indicates onboarding in progress; inactive indicates dormant with no current traffic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 PartyRole lifecycle; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier by network ownership and service role: MNO (Mobile Network Operator), MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator), transit (transit/wholesale carrier), IXC (Interexchange Carrier), LEC (Local Exchange Carrier), ISP (Internet Service Provider). Drives applicable tariff tables, settlement rules, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 69; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: clearinghouse_carrier_code
attributes.description: Carrier identifier assigned by the clearinghouse (e.g., Syniverse or BICS carrier code) used for TAP file routing, NRTRDE submission, and financial settlement matching within the clearinghouse platform.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: clearinghouse_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial and data clearinghouse through which TAP file exchange and inter-operator financial settlement is processed for this carrier (e.g., HSCSD, Syniverse, BICS). Required for TAP file routing and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: commercial_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the carrier's commercial or wholesale account management team. Used for agreement negotiations, invoice disputes, and settlement correspondence.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the carrier's primary country of registration and network operation. Used for geographic segmentation, IOT tariff lookup, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD SE.13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier record was first created in the interconnect carrier master registry. Audit trail field conforming to ISO 8601 extended format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding settlement balance (in settlement currency) permitted for this carrier before traffic suspension or escalation is triggered. Used for wholesale credit risk management and revenue assurance controls.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA PRD BA.12; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: data_roaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether GPRS/LTE/5G NR data roaming is active with this carrier. When true, data CDRs from this carrier's subscribers are processed through the TAP/NRTRDE pipeline and rated against the applicable IOT data tariff.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; 3GPP TS 23.060; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: fcc_registration_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit FCC Registration Number (FRN) assigned to US-based carriers by the Federal Communications Commission. Required for FCC regulatory filings, Form 499 reporting, and USAC fund contributions tracking.

attributes.name: five_g_roaming_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: 5G New Radio (5G NR) Roaming Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether 5G NR (New Radio) roaming is active with this carrier. Requires 5G roaming agreement, SEPP (Security Edge Protection Proxy) interconnect, and N32 interface configuration per 3GPP TS 33.501.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 33.501; GSMA PRD NG.113; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: fraud_risk_level
attributes.description: Fraud risk classification for this carrier based on historical NRTRDE anomalies, grey route incidents, and GSMA FASG (Fraud and Security Group) advisories. Drives real-time fraud monitoring thresholds and NRTRDE file frequency.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 (FASG); GSMA PRD TD.32; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: interconnect_agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of interconnect arrangement with this carrier: direct (direct circuit interconnect), transit (traffic routed via a third-party transit carrier), peering (IP or voice peering arrangement), wholesale (wholesale traffic purchase/sale), none (no active interconnect).
attributes.references: FCC Part 69; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: iot_tariff_group
attributes.description: IOT tariff group classification assigned to this carrier, used to look up applicable Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rates for roaming settlement. Aligns with GSMA IOT rate tables and bilateral agreement terms. Drives rating of inbound and outbound roaming CDRs.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 (IOT); GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: ir21_last_updated_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: GSMA IR.21 Profile Last Updated Date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's GSMA IR.21 roaming information profile was last updated in the GSMA RAEX (Roaming Agreement Exchange) system. Stale IR.21 data can cause roaming activation failures.

attributes.name: ir21_profile_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: GSMA IR.21 Roaming Information Profile Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the carrier's GSMA IR.21 roaming information document on file. IR.21 contains network configuration data required for roaming service activation including IMSI ranges, supported services, and signalling parameters.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this carrier record in the interconnect carrier master registry. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_tap_file_received_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently received TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file from this carrier. Used to monitor TAP file exchange health and detect stale or missing files that may indicate a processing issue or carrier-side problem.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: last_tap_file_sent_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently sent TAP file to this carrier. Used to monitor outbound TAP file exchange health and ensure timely delivery within GSMA-mandated submission windows.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: lte_roaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether LTE (4G) data roaming is active with this carrier. Distinct from VoLTE; covers data-only LTE roaming sessions rated and settled via TAP3 or DIAMETER-based online charging.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.88; 3GPP TS 23.401; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Three-digit ITU-assigned Mobile Country Code (MCC) identifying the country of the carrier's home network. Combined with MNC to form the full PLMN identifier used in roaming and signalling.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD SE.13

attributes.name: mnc
attributes.description: Two- or three-digit ITU-assigned Mobile Network Code (MNC) identifying the carrier's specific network within its country. Combined with MCC to form the PLMN identifier used in HLR/HSS, roaming agreements, and CDR processing.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD SE.13

attributes.name: noc_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the carrier's Network Operations Center (NOC) used for fault escalation, outage notifications, and interconnect incident management. Operational contact for network-layer issues.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; ISO/IEC 27001; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: noc_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 phone number for the carrier's Network Operations Center (NOC) in E.164 international format. Used for real-time fault escalation, SLA breach notification, and interconnect outage coordination.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: nrtrde_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier participates in NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) for near-real-time roaming fraud detection and usage monitoring. When true, NRTRDE files must be exchanged within the GSMA-mandated 4-hour window.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 (NRTRDE); GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier was formally onboarded into Telecommunication's interconnect systems including OSS/BSS provisioning, TAP file pipeline configuration, and clearinghouse registration. Distinct from relationship_start_date which may precede system activation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; Oracle Communications OSM; Netcracker OSS/BSS

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be received from or made to this carrier. Standard values are 30, 45, or 60 days. Used by Amdocs Revenue Management for collections and dunning scheduling.

attributes.name: preferred_interconnect_route
attributes.description: Preferred routing method for interconnect traffic to/from this carrier: direct (direct circuit), via_transit (through a transit carrier), via_iplc (International Private Leased Circuit), via_mpls (MPLS backbone), via_sdwan (SD-WAN overlay). Used by NOC for traffic engineering.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; ITU-T G.805; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region grouping for the carrier (e.g., APAC, EMEA, AMER, LATAM). Used for regional traffic analysis, IOT tariff banding, and wholesale reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: APAC|EMEA|AMER|LATAM|MEA|CEUR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial and operational relationship with this carrier was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for active ongoing relationships. Used for agreement expiry tracking and traffic wind-down planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial and operational relationship with this carrier was formally established. Marks the beginning of the carrier's lifecycle in the interconnect registry and the effective date of the first agreement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of roaming agreement in place with this carrier: bilateral (direct two-way roaming), multilateral (via GSMA or regional body), MVNO_host (carrier hosts an MVNO), transit_only (transit traffic only, no retail roaming), none (no roaming, interconnect only).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial settlement with this carrier (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency in which TAP invoices, IOT charges, and interconnect invoices are denominated and paid.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD BA.12; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: settlement_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency of financial settlement with this carrier for interconnect and roaming charges. Determines the billing and reconciliation schedule in Amdocs Revenue Management and the clearinghouse.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used trading name of the carrier, used in operational reports, dashboards, and TAP file processing where space is constrained.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier assigned to this carrier relationship, determining priority of fault resolution, MTTR targets, and escalation paths. Platinum and gold tiers receive 24/7 NOC support with sub-4-hour MTTR commitments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: sms_interconnect_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SMS (Short Message Service) interconnect is active with this carrier. Drives SMS CDR routing, A2P/P2P SMS settlement, and grey route detection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; 3GPP TS 23.040; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this carrier record was sourced: NETCRACKER (Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite), AMDOCS (Amdocs Revenue Management), ORACLE_OSM (Oracle Communications OSM), MANUAL (manually entered). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: spid
attributes.description: Four-digit Service Provider Identifier (SPID) assigned by the North American Numbering Plan Administrator (NANPA) or local number portability administrator. Used for MNP (Mobile Number Portability) routing and LNP database queries.

attributes.name: tadig_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: Five-character GSMA-assigned TADIG code uniquely identifying the carrier for TAP file exchange and inter-operator roaming settlement. Mandatory for all MNO and MVNO roaming partners. Used as the primary key in TAP file headers and NRTRDE records.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: tap_version
attributes.description: TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file format version supported by this carrier for roaming CDR exchange. Determines the file structure and encoding used when generating or receiving TAP files. Critical for TAP file processing pipeline configuration.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 (TAP3); GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: voice_interconnect_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether voice traffic (PSTN/VoIP/VoLTE) interconnect is active with this carrier. Drives CDR routing, rating, and settlement processing for voice traffic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.228

attributes.name: volte_roaming_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Voice over LTE (VoLTE) Roaming Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether VoLTE (Voice over LTE) roaming via IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) is active with this carrier. Requires bilateral IMS interconnect configuration and specific IR.92/IR.94 profile exchange.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.92; GSMA PRD IR.94; 3GPP TS 24.229

products.name: iot_tariff
products.description: Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rate table defining the wholesale rates charged between operators for roaming voice, SMS, and data services. Captures tariff version, effective period, service type, destination zone, IOT rate, currency, TAP decimal places, and GSMA rate group. Used for TAP file rating and settlement invoice generation. SSOT for IOT pricing.
products.reference: GSMA PRD TD.13 IOT / TM Forum SID InterOperatorTariff

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the IOT tariff record in the interconnect domain. Serves as the SSOT identifier for wholesale rate lookup during TAP file rating and settlement invoice generation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.roaming_agreement. Business justification: IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) rates are negotiated and published as part of roaming agreements. Linking iot_tariff to roaming_agreement enables tariff publication tracking per agreement and GSMA complia

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business authority (person, team, or system) that approved this IOT tariff record for production use. Required for internal governance and audit compliance in the interconnect settlement process.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this IOT tariff record was formally approved for production use. Part of the tariff lifecycle audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: charging_interval_seconds
attributes.description: The billing increment in seconds used for voice service IOT charge calculation. For example, a value of 60 means charges are calculated per full minute; a value of 1 means per-second billing. Applicable only for voice service types.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this IOT tariff record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the IOT rate is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, SDR). GSMA IOT rates are typically denominated in EUR or IMF Special Drawing Rights (SDR). Used for settlement invoice currency conversion and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: destination_zone_code
attributes.description: The GSMA-defined or operator-defined destination zone code to which this IOT rate applies. Zones group countries or network destinations for wholesale tariff banding. Used in TAP file rating to match usage records to the correct IOT rate.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: destination_zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the destination zone (e.g., 'Zone 1 - EU', 'Zone 2 - Rest of World'). Used in settlement reports, finance dashboards, and operator billing correspondence.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated discount percentage applied to the standard IOT rate under a bilateral roaming agreement. Expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.1500 = 15% discount). Null if no discount applies. Used in settlement invoice calculation to derive the effective net rate.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this IOT tariff version becomes binding and applicable for wholesale roaming charge rating. Aligns with the GSMA IOT effective date published in the inter-operator tariff notification.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: effective_rate
attributes.description: The net IOT rate after applying any negotiated discount_percentage to the standard iot_rate. Stored as a pre-computed field to support high-volume TAP file rating performance. Expressed in the tariff currency per rate_unit.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this IOT tariff version ceases to be applicable. Null indicates an open-ended tariff with no defined expiry. Used to enforce correct rate selection during TAP file rating for a given usage date.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the IOT rate from currency_code to settlement_currency_code for settlement invoice generation. Sourced from the agreed exchange rate mechanism defined in the bilateral roaming agreement (e.g., ECB rate, fixed contractual rate).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.12; ISO 4217; ECB Exchange Rate Reference

attributes.name: gsma_rate_group
attributes.description: The GSMA-defined rate group classification for this IOT tariff entry. Rate groups are published in the GSMA IOT rate tables and used to categorise wholesale rates for settlement and benchmarking purposes. Examples: RG1, RG2, RG3 for voice; DG1, DG2 for data.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: home_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The GSMA-assigned PLMN code (MCC+MNC) of the home operator network for which this IOT tariff is applicable. Enables multi-PLMN operators to maintain separate IOT rate tables per home network entity.
attributes.references: GSMA PLMN List; ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003

attributes.name: initial_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The initial billing period in seconds for voice calls, which may be charged at a different rate or as a flat fee before the standard per-interval rate applies. Common in IOT tariffs where the first 30 or 60 seconds are charged as a connection fee.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: initial_rate
attributes.description: The IOT rate applied during the initial_duration_seconds period of a voice call, if different from the standard iot_rate. Null if no differentiated initial rate applies. Expressed in the tariff currency.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: inter_operator_tariff_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IOT tariff by commercial arrangement type. 'standard' for GSMA-published rates, 'preferential' for bilaterally negotiated lower rates, 'reciprocal' for symmetric bilateral agreements, 'benchmark' for reference rates used in dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD AA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: iot_publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which this IOT tariff was officially published by the GSMA or notified by the visited operator. Used for audit trail and to verify compliance with GSMA notification lead-time requirements prior to the effective_from_date.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: iot_rate
attributes.description: The wholesale IOT rate charged by the visited operator to the home operator for the specified service type and destination zone. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. For voice: rate per minute; for SMS: rate per message; for data: rate per kilobyte or megabyte as defined by rate_unit. This is the principal quantitative fact of the IOT tariff record.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: The minimum wholesale charge applicable per usage event under this IOT tariff, expressed in the tariff currency. Ensures a floor charge is applied even for very short calls or minimal data usage. Used in TAP file rating to enforce minimum billing thresholds.
