attributes.description: The date and time at which this settlement invoice record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.creationDate; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this invoice are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determined by the bilateral roaming or interconnect agreement. Critical for multi-currency settlement reconciliation and FX conversion.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GSMA PRD BA.08 — Settlement Currency; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason for disputing this invoice. Common reasons include tariff misapplication, CDR count discrepancy, TAP file rejection, duplicate billing, or IOT rate disagreement. Populated when dispute_reference is set.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Dispute Reason Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 — Dispute.reason

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: The formal dispute case reference number raised against this invoice, if applicable. Populated when invoice_status is 'disputed'. Links to the dispute management workflow in ServiceNow ITSM or the carrier dispute management system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Dispute.disputeNumber; GSMA PRD BA.08 Dispute Resolution; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross amount that is currently under formal dispute by either party. Populated when invoice_status is 'disputed'. Net payable is calculated excluding this amount until dispute resolution. Tracked for financial reporting and carrier dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.disputedAmount; GSMA PRD BA.08 Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which payment must be received or remitted. Calculated from invoice_date plus the payment terms defined in the roaming or interconnect agreement. Used for overdue tracking and dunning escalation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Settlement Payment Terms; TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paymentDueDate

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to Telecommunication's functional/reporting currency (e.g., USD to local currency) at the time of invoice generation or settlement. Required for multi-currency financial reporting and revenue assurance reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD BA.08 — FX Conversion; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Currency Translation

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net_payable_amount converted to Telecommunication's functional currency using the exchange_rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and revenue assurance analytics.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Currency Translation; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for Telecommunication's functional/reporting currency into which the invoice amounts are converted using exchange_rate. Enables consolidated financial reporting across multi-currency carrier settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of all charges included in this settlement invoice before any disputes, credits, or adjustments are applied. Expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the sum of all traffic charges, IOT-rated usage, and applicable surcharges.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.amount; GSMA PRD BA.08 IOT Settlement; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the settlement invoice was formally issued and transmitted to the counterparty carrier. This is the principal business event date for the invoice lifecycle and triggers the payment due date calculation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.invoiceDate; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable invoice reference number assigned by Amdocs Revenue Management at invoice generation. Used in all carrier-to-carrier correspondence, dispute resolution, and financial reconciliation. Conforms to the operator's invoice numbering scheme.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.invoiceNumber; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoice Module

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement invoice within the inter-carrier settlement workflow. Transitions from 'draft' through 'issued', 'acknowledged', optionally 'disputed', to 'settled' or 'cancelled'. 'overdue' is set when payment due date has passed without settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|acknowledged|disputed|settled|cancelled|overdue — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.status; GSMA PRD BA.08 Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classifies the direction and nature of the settlement invoice. 'payable' indicates Telecommunication owes the carrier; 'receivable' indicates the carrier owes Telecommunication; 'credit_note' and 'debit_note' represent adjustments to prior invoices; 'adjustment' covers miscellaneous corrections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.invoiceType; GSMA TAP3 IOT Settlement

attributes.name: iot_tariff_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) table applied when rating the traffic charges on this invoice. Ensures auditability of the tariff applied and supports dispute resolution when tariff versions change mid-period.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 IOT; ITU-T D.150 — Accounting Rate; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net amount due for payment after subtracting disputed_amount and applying any approved credits or adjustments from the gross_amount plus tax_amount. This is the actionable settlement figure used for payment processing and financial ledger posting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.netAmount; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: netting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is subject to bilateral netting against a corresponding payable or receivable invoice with the same carrier for the same billing period. When True, the net_payable_amount reflects the netted position. Supports cash flow optimization in carrier settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Bilateral Netting; TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: netting_invoice_reference
attributes.description: The invoice_number of the offsetting invoice used in bilateral netting. Populated only when netting_flag is True. Enables traceability of the netting pair for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Bilateral Netting; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Netting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, comments, or annotations related to this settlement invoice. Used by the interconnect settlement team to record special handling instructions, dispute context, or carrier communication summaries.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Note; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: nrtrde_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the NRTRDE data exchange associated with this invoice. NRTRDE provides near-real-time roaming CDR data used for fraud detection and early settlement validation prior to TAP file processing. Null for non-roaming invoices.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 NRTRDE; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: The total amount actually received or remitted against this settlement invoice to date. Used to calculate outstanding balance and confirm full or partial settlement. Updated upon payment confirmation from the treasury or accounts payable/receivable system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paidAmount; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections; SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which full or final payment was received or remitted for this settlement invoice. Null until payment is confirmed. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation and settlement cycle analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paymentDate; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Accounts Payable/Receivable

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used to settle this invoice. 'wire_transfer' and 'swift' are standard for international carrier settlements; 'netting' applies when bilateral payable and receivable invoices are offset; 'cheque' and 'direct_debit' for domestic arrangements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Settlement Payment Method; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SWIFT gpi Standards

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the settlement invoice. 'unpaid' indicates no payment received; 'partial' indicates partial payment; 'paid' indicates full settlement; 'overpaid' indicates excess payment requiring refund; 'written_off' indicates the amount has been written off after failed collection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paymentStatus; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections; SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this settlement invoice record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking. Primary source is Amdocs Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA for financial postings.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — DataSource; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applicable to this settlement invoice, including withholding tax, VAT, or other applicable levies as per the bilateral agreement and jurisdictional requirements. May be zero for tax-exempt inter-operator settlements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.taxAmount; ITU-T D.150; OECD BEPS Framework

attributes.name: total_cdr_count
attributes.description: The total number of Call Detail Records (CDRs) included in this settlement invoice. Used for volume reconciliation against TAP files and NRTRDE data. Discrepancies between CDR counts and billed amounts are a primary trigger for disputes.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — RecordCount; GSMA PRD TD.32 NRTRDE; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: total_data_volume_mb
attributes.description: Total data volume in megabytes (MB) covered by this settlement invoice. Used for data roaming and interconnect data charge reconciliation. Applicable to roaming TAP, interconnect_data, and wholesale invoice types.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — DataVolume; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolume

attributes.name: total_sms_count
attributes.description: Total number of SMS messages included in this settlement invoice. Used for SMS interconnect charge reconciliation and IOT tariff validation. Applicable to roaming TAP and SMS termination/origination invoice types.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — SMS Records; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: total_usage_minutes
attributes.description: Aggregate voice usage duration in minutes covered by this settlement invoice. Used for traffic volume analysis, IOT tariff validation, and inter-carrier settlement reconciliation. Applicable primarily to voice termination, origination, and roaming invoices.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — Duration; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolume

attributes.name: traffic_type
attributes.description: Categorises the type of inter-carrier traffic covered by this invoice. 'roaming_tap' covers outbound/inbound roaming settled via Transferred Account Procedure (TAP); 'transit' covers traffic transiting through Telecommunication's network; 'termination' and 'origination' cover voice/SMS termination and origination charges; 'interconnect_data' covers data interconnect; 'wholesale' covers wholesale capacity arrangements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3; ITU-T Q.1741; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageType

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this settlement invoice record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.lastUpdate; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

products.name: settlement_invoice_line
products.description: Line-item detail of a settlement invoice, breaking down charges by service type, traffic category, or TAP file reference. Captures line sequence, service category (voice termination, SMS, data roaming, transit), traffic volume, unit rate, gross charge, discount applied, tax amount, and net charge. Enables granular reconciliation of inter-carrier settlement invoices.
products.reference: TM Forum SID SettlementInvoiceLine

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each settlement invoice line item within the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Invoice Line

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral or multilateral roaming agreement under which this settlement line item is charged. Links to the governing inter-operator agreement.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922 — Agreement

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rate table entry applied to this settlement line item for pricing voice, SMS, or data roaming traffic.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.rate. Business justification: settlement_invoice_line has unit_rate as an inline decimal but no FK to the rate table. Each invoice line represents charges calculated at a specific rate schedule. Adding rate_id links the line item

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.roaming_agreement. Business justification: Settlement invoice lines for roaming traffic must be validated against the specific roaming agreement rates (voice_mou_rate, data_mb_rate, sms_rate). Linking enables line-level rate validation and dis

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent settlement invoice header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header/detail relationship for inter-carrier settlement invoices.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Invoice; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TAP file from which this settlement line item was derived. Enables traceability from invoice line back to the originating TAP3 data exchange file.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary adjustment applied to this settlement line item following dispute resolution or TAP file error correction. Positive values increase the charge; negative values reduce it.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Adjustment Amount; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for any adjustment applied to this settlement line item (e.g., TAP file error correction, rate dispute resolution, volume reconciliation difference). Populated when line_status is 'adjusted'.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — Error Code; TM Forum SID GB922 — Adjustment

attributes.name: call_event_count
attributes.description: Number of individual Call Detail Records (CDRs) or usage events aggregated into this settlement line item. Used for reconciliation against TAP file record counts.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — CDR Count; 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code to which this settlement line item is allocated for internal financial reporting and OPEX tracking of interconnect and wholesale costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Cost Center Accounting; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement invoice line record was first created in the system (Amdocs Revenue Management). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Audit Trail; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for this settlement line item. Used for transit traffic routing analysis and regulatory reporting to FCC/Ofcom/BEREC.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; ITU-T E.164; FCC International Settlement Rules

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary discount applied to this settlement line item per the terms of the roaming or wholesale agreement (e.g., volume discount, bilateral discount, promotional rate reduction).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Discount; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate of the discount applied to the gross charge for this settlement line item, as stipulated in the inter-operator agreement or IOT tariff schedule.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Discount; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any active or resolved dispute raised against this settlement line item. Populated when line_status is 'disputed' or 'adjusted'. Links to the dispute management process.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Dispute; GSMA PRD BA.12 — Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the rate_currency_code to the settlement_currency_code for this line item. Sourced from the agreed exchange rate mechanism in the roaming agreement.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff; ISO 4217; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: gross_charge_amount
attributes.description: The total gross charge for this settlement line item before any discounts, adjustments, or taxes are applied. Calculated as traffic_volume multiplied by unit_rate.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line Amount; GSMA PRD BA.12; IFRS 15

attributes.name: home_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The PLMN code (MCC+MNC) of the home network operator for roaming traffic on this settlement line. Used to identify the subscriber's home network in TAP3 and NRTRDE processing.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212 — PLMN Identification; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this settlement invoice line record. Tracks adjustments, dispute resolutions, and status changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Audit Trail; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of this settlement invoice line item, providing additional context about the service, traffic type, or special billing arrangement for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line Description

attributes.name: line_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference code for this settlement invoice line, used in dispute correspondence and reconciliation with the counterpart carrier.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD BA.12 — Settlement

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this line item within the parent settlement invoice. Used for display ordering and reconciliation referencing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this settlement invoice line item. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, acceptance, dispute resolution, adjustment, and final settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|accepted|disputed|adjusted|settled|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line State; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: net_charge_amount
attributes.description: The final net charge for this settlement line item after applying discounts and taxes. Represents the actual amount payable/receivable for this line in the inter-carrier settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line Net Amount; GSMA PRD BA.12; IFRS 15

attributes.name: nrtrde_file_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) File Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the NRTRDE file associated with this settlement line, enabling near-real-time roaming fraud detection cross-referencing and reconciliation against TAP-settled charges.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 — NRTRDE; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: originating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the originating country for this settlement line item. Used for inbound roaming analysis and bilateral traffic balance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: partner_operator_code
attributes.description: GSMA TADIG (Transferred Account Data Interchange Group) code identifying the partner/counterpart operator for this settlement line. Used for carrier identification in TAP file processing and IOT settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: partner_operator_name
attributes.description: Full legal or trading name of the partner operator (carrier, MVNO, or transit provider) associated with this settlement line item.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; TM Forum SID GB922 — Party

attributes.name: rap_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Return Account Procedure (RAP) file if this settlement line was returned or rejected during TAP processing. Enables tracking of rejected CDRs and their financial impact.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — RAP; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit_rate. May differ from the settlement_currency_code when rate tables are maintained in SDR (Special Drawing Rights) or a reference currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff

attributes.name: revenue_assurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement line item has been flagged by the revenue assurance process for further investigation (e.g., volume anomaly, rate mismatch, missing TAP records).
attributes.references: TM Forum GB941 — Revenue Assurance; TM Forum eTOM — Revenue Assurance Management

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the telecommunications service type for this settlement line item. Drives IOT tariff selection and financial reporting by service type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice_termination|sms|data_roaming|transit|mms|supplementary_service|iptv|voip|content — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — Service Category; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: service_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period or traffic window covered by this settlement invoice line item. Together with service_period_start, defines the chargeable period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: service_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period or traffic window covered by this settlement invoice line item. Defines the temporal scope for traffic volume and charge calculation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the settlement amounts (gross, discount, tax, net) are expressed for this line item. Typically agreed in the bilateral roaming agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GSMA PRD BA.12; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: tap_sequence_number
attributes.description: The TAP file sequence number assigned by the sending operator, used to uniquely identify the TAP batch within the GSMA data exchange framework and to detect missing or duplicate TAP files.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — File Sequence Number; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this settlement line item, including withholding tax, VAT, or other applicable levies as required by the jurisdictions of the settling parties.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Tax; IFRS 15; ITU-T D.150 — Accounting Rates

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code identifying the type of tax applied (e.g., VAT, withholding tax, GST) as configured in the billing system (Amdocs Revenue Management) for inter-carrier settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Tax; SAP S/4HANA Tax Code; IFRS 15

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate (as a percentage) used to calculate the tax_amount for this settlement line item. Determined by the tax jurisdiction and service type.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Tax Rate; IFRS 15; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: traffic_category
attributes.description: Classification of the traffic flow direction and type for this settlement line. Distinguishes inbound roaming (MVNO/visited network charges), outbound roaming, transit traffic, and wholesale termination for revenue assurance and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum eTOM — Interconnect Management; FCC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: traffic_volume
attributes.description: Total quantity of traffic units (calls, messages, data bytes, or events) included in this settlement line item. The unit of measure is defined by traffic_volume_unit.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — Call Event Detail; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: traffic_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the traffic_volume field. Varies by service category: seconds/minutes for voice, messages for SMS/MMS, kilobytes/megabytes/gigabytes for data roaming. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seconds|minutes|messages|kilobytes|megabytes|gigabytes|events — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The IOT or wholesale rate applied per unit of traffic volume for this settlement line item. Expressed in the settlement currency. Commercially sensitive inter-carrier pricing.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff; TM Forum SID GB922 — Price

attributes.name: visited_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Visited Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The PLMN code (MCC+MNC) of the visited network where the roaming service was consumed. Used in TAP3 reconciliation and IOT tariff application for inbound/outbound roaming settlement.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212 — PLMN Identification; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

products.name: settlement_dispute
products.description: Record of a formal dispute raised against a settlement invoice or TAP file charge between Telecommunication and a carrier. Captures dispute reference, disputed invoice or TAP file, dispute type (rate error, volume discrepancy, duplicate record, missing record), disputed amount, supporting evidence reference, dispute status (open, under review, resolved, escalated), resolution amount, and resolution date.
products.reference: GSMA PRD BA.08 Dispute Management / TM Forum SID Dispute

attributes.name: settlement_dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the settlement dispute record in the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral roaming or interconnect agreement under which the disputed settlement invoice or TAP file was generated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the domestic or international carrier (counterparty) against whom the dispute is raised. Aligns with the PARTY_REFERENCE canonical category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP/NRTRDE

attributes.name: fraud_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.fraud_case. Business justification: Settlement disputes frequently arise from fraud-related billing discrepancies (IRSF, SIM box). Linking settlement_dispute to the underlying fraud_case enables fraud-driven dispute resolution tracking

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IOT tariff table entry that Telecommunication believes should have been applied to the disputed charges. Central to rate_error and iot_mismatch dispute types.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Interconnect settlement disputes may involve partners (MVNOs, wholesale customers) not just carriers. Business process: Partner dispute resolution workflow, escalation management, consolidated partner

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.rate. Business justification: settlement_dispute already has iot_tariff_id for tariff-level disputes but no FK to the specific rate schedule being disputed. Interconnect disputes frequently involve disagreement over the applicable

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Interconnect settlement disputes escalated to regulators (e.g., GSMA, national telecom authority) require a formal regulatory filing. Compliance teams track which filing covers each escalated dispute.

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.roaming_agreement. Business justification: Roaming settlement disputes arise from discrepancies in charges governed by specific roaming agreements. Linking enables dispute resolution tracking against roaming agreement terms (dispute_resolution

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inter-operator settlement invoice that is the subject of this dispute. Null when the dispute is raised directly against a TAP file rather than a consolidated invoice.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.settlement_invoice_line. Business justification: settlement_dispute currently links to settlement_invoice at the header level but has no FK to settlement_invoice_line for line-item disputes. Disputes in interconnect settlement are frequently raised

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific TAP file whose charges are disputed. Null when the dispute is raised at the consolidated invoice level rather than at the individual TAP file level.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: accepted_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the original invoice or TAP file charge that Telecommunication accepts as valid and agrees to pay. The difference between the invoiced amount and the disputed amount. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category (adjustment component).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: carrier_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the counterparty carrier formally responded to the dispute notification. Used to measure SLA compliance and track negotiation progress.

attributes.name: carrier_response_notes
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the carrier's formal response to the dispute, including their position, counter-evidence references, and proposed resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit note issued by the carrier as part of the dispute resolution. Populated when resolution_type is credit_note or partial_credit.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: dispute_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the dispute: financial (monetary discrepancy), technical (CDR or TAP file format/content issue), or contractual (disagreement on agreement terms or IOT applicability).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature of the dispute, the specific charges contested, and the business justification for the claim. Authored by the settlement analyst at the time of dispute creation.

attributes.name: dispute_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether Telecommunication is the disputing party (outbound — Telecommunication raises dispute against carrier) or the receiving party (inbound — carrier raises dispute against Telecommunication).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this dispute at the time of creation. Used in all carrier-to-carrier correspondence and regulatory filings. Format: DSP-YYYY-NNNNNN. Aligns with BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER canonical category.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement dispute. Drives workflow routing in the BSS settlement module. Aligns with LIFECYCLE_STATUS canonical category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_review|escalated|resolved|withdrawn|closed — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause of the dispute. Rate error indicates an incorrect Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) was applied; volume_discrepancy indicates a mismatch in CDR counts; duplicate_record indicates a charge appears more than once in the TAP file; missing_record indicates expected CDRs are absent; currency_conversion indicates an FX rate dispute; iot_mismatch indicates the applied IOT does not match the agreed tariff table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_error|volume_discrepancy|duplicate_record|missing_record|currency_conversion|iot_mismatch — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount being disputed by Telecommunication, expressed in the settlement currency. Represents the full value of the contested charges before any agreed adjustments. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: disputed_amount_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the disputed amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency inter-operator settlement environments. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.

attributes.name: disputed_cdr_count
attributes.description: Number of individual Call Detail Records (CDRs) included in the dispute. Relevant for volume_discrepancy, duplicate_record, and missing_record dispute types.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispute was escalated to senior management or a formal inter-carrier arbitration body. Null if the dispute has not been escalated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for escalation, such as failure to respond within SLA, disagreement on IOT applicability, or significant financial exposure.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Document management or object storage reference (e.g., S3 path, ServiceNow attachment ID) pointing to supporting evidence submitted with the dispute, such as CDR extracts, TAP file dumps, or IOT tariff documentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: interconnect_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interconnect arrangement under which the disputed charges arose: bilateral roaming, transit traffic, peering, wholesale voice, or wholesale data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bilateral_roaming|transit|peering|wholesale_voice|wholesale_data — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Total amount as stated on the original settlement invoice or TAP file that is the subject of this dispute. Provides the baseline for calculating the disputed and accepted portions.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: is_sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has failed to respond or resolve the dispute within the contractually agreed SLA timeframe. True when current date exceeds sla_resolution_due_date and dispute_status is not resolved or closed.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the dispute record, including status transitions, amount updates, or evidence additions. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category.

attributes.name: nrtrde_file_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) File Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the NRTRDE file associated with the disputed roaming charges. Enables near-real-time reconciliation of roaming CDRs against TAP file charges as per GSMA NRTRDE specification.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the dispute based on financial exposure and SLA urgency. Drives workflow queue ordering in the BSS settlement module.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: raised_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formal dispute was raised by Telecommunication against the carrier. Aligns with BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP canonical category (date-precision sufficient for settlement SLA tracking).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: raised_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the dispute record was first created in the BSS settlement system. Provides sub-day precision for SLA measurement and audit trail. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category.

attributes.name: resolution_amount
attributes.description: Final agreed monetary amount to be credited, refunded, or adjusted as the outcome of the dispute resolution. Populated only when dispute_status is resolved or closed. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category (net total).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dispute was formally resolved and agreed between Telecommunication and the carrier. Null while dispute_status is open, under_review, or escalated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the agreed resolution outcome, including the rationale for the resolution amount and any corrective actions agreed between the carriers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the dispute was resolved: credit_note (carrier issues a credit), partial_credit (partial adjustment agreed), full_acceptance (Telecommunication accepts the original charge), withdrawal (dispute withdrawn by Telecommunication), arbitration_award (resolved via formal arbitration).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: settlement_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing or settlement period covered by the disputed invoice or TAP file.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: settlement_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing or settlement period covered by the disputed invoice or TAP file. Used to correlate disputes with specific traffic periods and IOT tariff versions.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: sla_resolution_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Due Date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the dispute must be fully resolved as defined in the inter-operator agreement SLA terms. Used for SLA breach monitoring and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: sla_response_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Due Date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the carrier must respond to the dispute as defined in the roaming or interconnect agreement SLA terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this dispute record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: source_system_dispute_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this dispute record in the originating operational system (e.g., Amdocs case number, Netcracker dispute ID). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.

attributes.name: tap_sequence_number
attributes.description: TAP file sequence number as defined in the GSMA TAP3 specification, identifying the specific TAP batch within the carrier exchange. Used to trace disputed charges back to the originating TAP file.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: traffic_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications traffic associated with the disputed charges. Determines which IOT tariff schedule and settlement rules apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|data|sms|mms|roaming|transit|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; 3GPP TS 32.297; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: rate
products.description: Wholesale interconnect termination and origination rate schedule defining per-minute or per-event charges for domestic and international voice, SMS, and data traffic exchanged at interconnect points. Captures rate type (termination, origination, transit), destination prefix/number range, peak/off-peak/weekend rate tiers, effective/expiry dates, currency, regulatory reference (FCC access charges, Ofcom FAMR, EU Roam-Like-At-Home caps), and rate status. Distinct from IOT tariffs which cover roaming wholesale rates — this product covers domestic interconnect and international termination rates governed by regulatory frameworks.
products.reference: FCC Access Charge / Ofcom MTAS / ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each interconnect rate record in the wholesale rate schedule. Primary key for the interconnect_rate data product.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral carrier agreement or roaming agreement under which this rate applies. Links the rate to its governing commercial contract.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.iot_tariff. Business justification: rate is the internal wholesale interconnect rate schedule while iot_tariff is the published inter-operator tariff. Internal rates are typically derived from or aligned with IOT tariffs. Adding iot_tar

attributes.name: qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.qos_profile. Business justification: Interconnect rates often vary by QoS class (e.g., premium voice vs. best-effort data). Tariff design requires linking rate structures to network QoS profiles for accurate billing and service different

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Regulated interconnect termination rates (e.g., MTR, FTR under regulatory cap) must be filed with or approved by national regulators. The plain attribute `regulatory_reference` on rate denormalizes th

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.roaming_agreement. Business justification: Interconnect rates for roaming traffic are negotiated and published under specific roaming agreements. Linking enables rate validation against roaming agreement terms and ensures rate changes are trac

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer rate record that replaced this one when rate_status is 'superseded'. Enables forward navigation of the rate version chain for audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial or regulatory manager who approved this rate for activation. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance in wholesale rate management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this rate was formally approved for activation. Part of the rate lifecycle audit trail required for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Structural basis on which the rate is calculated: flat (single rate regardless of volume), tiered (rate changes at volume thresholds), volume_discount (discounted rate applied retroactively above threshold), or distance_based (rate varies by geographic distance between interconnect points). Determines the rating algorithm applied.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this rate record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the interconnect rates are denominated and settlement is conducted (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Must align with the settlement currency defined in the governing carrier agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA TAP3 Specification; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code identifying the destination country for international termination or transit rates (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for international settlement and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; FCC International Settlement Policy

attributes.name: destination_prefix
attributes.description: E.164 dialled number prefix or number range (e.g., '+1202', '+44207') to which this rate applies. Enables prefix-based rate lookup during CDR rating and settlement. May represent a country code, area code, or specific number block.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this interconnect rate becomes effective and applicable for CDR rating and settlement calculations. Inclusive start boundary of the rate validity period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this interconnect rate ceases to be effective (exclusive end boundary). Null indicates an open-ended rate with no scheduled expiry. Used to enforce rate versioning and prevent application of expired rates.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021

attributes.name: interconnect_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific Point of Presence (POP) or interconnect gateway at which traffic is exchanged under this rate. Rates may vary by interconnect point due to transport cost differences. Aligns with network inventory records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory; ITU-T Q.700

attributes.name: iot_tariff_class
attributes.description: IOT tariff classification code as defined by GSMA inter-operator tariff tables, applicable when this rate is used for roaming wholesale settlement. Maps to the GSMA IOT rate category (e.g., IOT-A, IOT-B, IOT-C) for NRTRDE and TAP file processing.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA NRTRDE Specification

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this rate record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: ITU-assigned three-digit Mobile Country Code (MCC) identifying the country of the counterparty mobile network. Used in roaming rate lookup and NRTRDE/TAP file processing to match rates to visited network operator records.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: minimum_call_duration_sec
attributes.description: Minimum billable call duration in seconds applied during rating. Calls shorter than this threshold are billed at this minimum (e.g., 30-second minimum billing). Common in wholesale voice interconnect agreements to prevent micro-call gaming.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: mnc
attributes.description: Two or three-digit Mobile Network Code (MNC) identifying the specific mobile network operator within the MCC country. Combined with MCC forms the PLMN identifier used in roaming rate resolution and TAP file matching.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: Mobile or fixed network generation standard to which this rate applies (e.g., 2G, 3G, 4G LTE, 5G NR, VoLTE, VoIP). Rates may differ by network generation due to technology-specific interconnect costs and regulatory frameworks.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for commercial or operational annotations related to this rate (e.g., special negotiation conditions, dispute history notes, regulatory waiver references). Not used in automated rating; for human reference only.

attributes.name: nrtrde_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is subject to NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) reporting obligations. When true, CDRs rated under this rate must be transmitted to the counterparty within the NRTRDE transmission window for fraud prevention purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA NRTRDE Specification (PRD IR.21); GSMA PRD FS.11

attributes.name: off_peak_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit wholesale charge applied during off-peak hours (typically evenings and nights on weekdays). Lower than peak rate to reflect reduced network demand. Expressed in settlement currency per billing unit.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: originating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the traffic originates. Required for international transit and termination rates to distinguish bilateral from multilateral routing scenarios and apply correct regulatory frameworks.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; FCC International Settlement Policy

attributes.name: peak_end_time
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) at which the peak rate period ends each weekday. Defines the upper boundary of the peak window for CDR rating tier selection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine Configuration

attributes.name: peak_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit wholesale charge applied during peak hours (typically business hours on weekdays). Expressed in the settlement currency per billing unit (e.g., per minute for voice, per event for SMS, per MB for data). This is the principal quantitative rate value for the resource.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; EU Regulation 531/2012 (Roam-Like-At-Home); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: peak_start_time
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) at which the peak rate period begins each weekday. Used by the rating engine to determine which rate tier applies to a given CDR based on call start time.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine Configuration

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this rate entry within the wholesale rate schedule. Used in TAP file references and inter-operator billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the rate entry (e.g., 'US Domestic Voice Termination Peak', 'EU Roam-Like-At-Home SMS'). Used in rate schedule documentation and commercial negotiations.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate record: active (currently in force for rating), pending (approved but not yet effective), superseded (replaced by a newer rate version), expired (past effective period), or withdrawn (cancelled before activation). Controls whether the rate is used in CDR rating and settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rate Table Lifecycle

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate by traffic direction and role: termination (delivering traffic to destination network), origination (collecting traffic from originating network), transit (passing traffic through an intermediate network), transit_international (cross-border transit), or access (local loop access charge). Governs regulatory framework applicability.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51 Access Charge Rules; Ofcom FAMR; BEREC Guidelines on Interconnection

attributes.name: regulatory_cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum rate permitted by the applicable regulatory framework for this service type and destination (e.g., EU RLAH wholesale voice cap of €0.032/min, Ofcom FAMR charge control ceiling). The actual rate must not exceed this cap. Used for compliance validation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 531/2012 (RLAH); Ofcom FAMR 2021; FCC Part 51; BEREC BoR (22) 137

attributes.name: rounding_increment_sec
attributes.description: Duration increment in seconds to which call durations are rounded up for billing purposes (e.g., 6-second or 60-second rounding). Directly impacts settlement amounts and must align with the counterparty carrier agreement terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 51

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications service to which this rate applies: voice (per-minute voice call termination/origination), sms (short message service per-event), data (per-kilobyte or per-megabyte data transit), mms (multimedia messaging), or premium_sms (premium-rate short message service). Determines the billing unit and regulatory regime.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this rate was ingested (e.g., 'Amdocs Revenue Management', 'Netcracker OSS/BSS', 'Manual Upload'). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between source systems and the lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tap_rate_category
attributes.description: TAP file rate category code as defined in the GSMA Transferred Account Procedure (TAP3) specification. Maps this rate to the correct TAP record type for inter-operator roaming settlement file generation and validation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') used to interpret peak/off-peak/weekend time boundaries for this rate. Ensures correct tier selection across geographic regions and daylight saving transitions.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to inbound traffic (received from the counterparty carrier), outbound traffic (sent to the counterparty carrier), or bilateral (symmetric rate applicable in both directions). Critical for settlement calculation and IOT tariff alignment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure against which the rate is applied for billing purposes: per_minute or per_second for voice, per_event for SMS/MMS, per_mb/per_kb/per_gb for data. Determines how CDR volumes are multiplied by the rate to produce settlement charges.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240; GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this rate record, incremented each time the rate is amended. Enables rate history tracking and ensures the correct version is applied to CDRs within a given effective period. Version 1 is the initial rate.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rate Versioning

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum traffic volume (in the rate_unit) at which a tiered or volume-discount rate becomes applicable. Null for flat-rate structures. Used by the rating engine to select the correct rate tier based on cumulative monthly traffic volumes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: weekend_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit wholesale charge applied during weekend periods (Saturday and Sunday). May differ from both peak and off-peak weekday rates. Expressed in settlement currency per billing unit.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: mnp_transaction
products.description: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) transaction record capturing each port-in or port-out event for a subscriber number between Telecommunication and another operator. Captures MSISDN, donor network TADIG/carrier reference, recipient network reference, port type (port-in/port-out), request timestamp, porting window, completion timestamp, MNP status (pending, validated, completed, rejected, cancelled), rejection reason, regulatory reference number, and routing number update status. SSOT for inter-operator number portability execution within the interconnect domain.
products.reference: GSMA PRD SE.13 MNP / FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: mnp_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Mobile Number Portability (MNP) transaction record in the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inter-operator carrier agreement governing the MNP transaction between Telecommunication and the counterparty operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.channel. Business justification: The sales channel (retail store, online, telesales) that originated a port-in must be tracked on the MNP transaction for channel performance reporting, commission attribution, and port-in volume analy

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise customers porting number blocks during office relocations or provider changes. Business need: tracking which enterprise account initiated bulk porting requests for service continuity, billi

attributes.name: donor_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: MNP transaction donor carrier is heavily denormalized with donor_tadig_code, donor_carrier_name, donor_mcc, donor_mnc. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier eliminates all redundancy and provides author

attributes.name: enterprise_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.enterprise_contract. Business justification: Enterprise customers porting large corporate number blocks (bulk MNP) do so under enterprise contracts that specify porting SLAs, settlement amounts, and regulatory deadlines. Enterprise contract mana

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.fulfillment_order. Business justification: MNP order fulfillment tracking: every MNP port-in/port-out is triggered by a fulfillment_order. Linking mnp_transaction to fulfillment_order enables end-to-end MNP order lifecycle reporting and regula

attributes.name: hlr_inventory_network_equipment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hlr Inventory Network Equipment Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.network_equipment. Business justification: MNP transactions require HLR/HSS updates on specific physical network equipment. Troubleshooting failed ports and SLA breach analysis require knowing which inventory.network_equipment (HLR/HSS node) p

attributes.name: hlr_network_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.element. Business justification: Mobile number portability requires HLR/HSS updates to redirect routing. Operations must track which HLR/HSS network element processed each port for audit, troubleshooting, and regulatory compliance. R

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.line. Business justification: MNP porting is per-MSISDN/line. Linking mnp_transaction to the specific order line enables per-line MNP status tracking, settlement reconciliation, and regulatory per-number porting audit — a standard

attributes.name: mnp_compliance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.mnp_compliance. Business justification: Each porting transaction generates a compliance record tracking SLA adherence, authorization verification, regulatory notification. Essential for porting compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting, a

attributes.name: msisdn_range_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.msisdn_range. Business justification: MNP porting transactions must identify which MSISDN range the ported number belongs to for routing updates, regulatory compliance reporting, and range utilization tracking. Number portability operatio

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Port-in MNP transactions are the operational fulfillment of a won sales opportunity (competitor win). Telecom sales operations track port-in completions against opportunities for win-rate reporting, s

attributes.name: partner_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.agreement. Business justification: MNP inter-operator charges and settlement terms are governed by partner agreements. Linking enables MNP settlement reconciliation against partner agreement payment terms and regulatory deadline tracki

attributes.name: poi_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.poi. Business justification: MNP transactions involve physical or logical interconnect handoff points for number porting. The POI (Point of Interconnect) is the physical/logical boundary where the porting transaction is executed

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.rate. Business justification: mnp_transaction has inter_operator_charge_applicable (boolean) and settlement_amount (decimal) indicating that inter-operator charges apply for MNP events. Adding rate_id links the MNP transaction to

attributes.name: recipient_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Number portability transactions often involve partner networks (MVNOs) as recipient operators. Business process: MNP coordination with partner operators, regulatory compliance reporting, partner opera

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.subscriber. Business justification: Mobile Number Portability transactions are directly tied to a specific subscriber's MSISDN. Linking mnp_transaction to subscriber is essential for porting lifecycle management, regulatory SLA complian

attributes.name: authorisation_code
attributes.description: The Port Authorisation Code (PAC) or equivalent subscriber-provided authorisation token used to validate the subscriber's consent for the port-out. Mandatory in many regulatory frameworks (e.g., Ofcom PAC regime, FCC subscriber verification). Null for port-in transactions where PAC is consumed by the gaining operator.
attributes.references: Ofcom General Conditions C8; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: batch_file_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the batch file or TAP/NRTRDE file submission in which this MNP transaction was included for inter-operator exchange or regulatory reporting. Supports reconciliation with interconnect file processing workflows.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 (TAP3); GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the MNP request was cancelled. Populated only when port_status = 'cancelled'. Common reasons include subscriber withdrawal, duplicate request cancellation, or operator-initiated cancellation.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the number portability transfer was successfully completed and the MSISDN became active on the recipient network. Null if the port has not yet completed.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the MNP transaction is executed. Determines the applicable regulatory framework (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC NRA, etc.) and porting timeline obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ITU-T E.164; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MNP transaction record was first created in the system of record (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management / Netcracker OSS). Audit trail field for data lineage.

attributes.name: fraud_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the fraud prevention check performed on the MNP request. 'not_checked' — fraud screening not yet performed; 'passed' — no fraud indicators detected; 'flagged' — suspicious activity detected, under review; 'blocked' — request blocked due to confirmed fraud. Supports GSMA fraud prevention guidelines.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11; GSMA PRD IR.85; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: hlr_hss_update_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Location Register / Home Subscriber Server (HLR/HSS) Update Status
attributes.description: Status of the HLR (2G/3G) or HSS/UDM (4G/5G) subscriber profile update triggered by the MNP transaction. 'pending' — update not yet sent; 'completed' — subscriber profile successfully updated; 'failed' — update failed, requiring manual intervention.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; 3GPP TS 29.272; Ericsson Network Manager; Nokia NetAct

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier of the SIM card associated with the MSISDN at the time of the porting request. Captured to support SIM swap validation and fraud prevention during the MNP process.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.118; 3GPP TS 22.042; GSMA SGP.02; ISO/IEC 7812

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity associated with the subscriber's SIM at the time of the porting request. Used for HLR/HSS deprovisioning on port-out and provisioning on port-in. Constitutes PII as it uniquely identifies a subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.21; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: inter_operator_charge_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether an inter-operator charge (IOT) is applicable for this MNP transaction under the governing carrier agreement. True = charge applies and will be raised in settlement; False = no charge applicable (e.g., regulatory zero-rating or waiver).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D-Series Recommendations

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The full E.164-formatted mobile phone number being ported. This is the subscriber's publicly dialable number and constitutes PII as it directly identifies an individual subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.003; GDPR Article 4; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: The radio access network generation (2G/3G/4G/5G) on which the subscriber's service is provisioned at the time of the MNP transaction. Relevant for HLR vs HSS/UDM routing update determination and network-specific porting procedures.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.011; 3GPP TS 23.116; ETSI; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: npac_order_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) Order ID
attributes.description: The order identifier assigned by the Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) or equivalent national clearinghouse system (e.g., Syniverse, CODA) for this porting transaction. Used for cross-system reconciliation and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85; NTIA

attributes.name: number_range_owner
attributes.description: The operator or entity that holds the ITU/national regulatory authority allocation of the number range (NXX or equivalent) containing the ported MSISDN. May differ from the donor operator in MVNO or wholesale scenarios.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom National Telephone Numbering Plan; NTIA

attributes.name: port_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this MNP porting request by the Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) or equivalent national clearinghouse. Used for cross-operator tracking and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: port_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MNP transaction. 'pending' — request received and awaiting validation; 'validated' — subscriber eligibility confirmed; 'completed' — number successfully ported; 'rejected' — request denied (see rejection_reason); 'cancelled' — request withdrawn before completion.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: port_type
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the number portability event from Telecommunication's perspective. 'port_in' means the subscriber is moving their number to Telecommunication from another operator (donor). 'port_out' means the subscriber is leaving Telecommunication to another operator (recipient).
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: porting_duration_hours
attributes.description: The elapsed time in hours between request_timestamp and completion_timestamp. Used for SLA compliance monitoring against regulatory maximum porting time mandates (e.g., FCC 1-business-day rule, Ofcom 1-working-day rule). Null if port not yet completed.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_window_end
attributes.description: The scheduled end date and time of the porting window. If the port is not completed within this window, the transaction may expire or require rescheduling per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; 3GPP TS 23.116

attributes.name: porting_window_start
attributes.description: The scheduled start date and time of the porting window during which the number transfer is authorised to execute. Regulatory frameworks (e.g., FCC, Ofcom) mandate specific porting windows.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; 3GPP TS 23.116

attributes.name: recipient_carrier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the recipient (gaining) operator. Complements recipient_tadig_code for reporting and business user readability.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: recipient_tadig_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recipient Network Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: The GSMA TADIG code identifying the recipient (gaining) operator network to which the MSISDN is being ported. Complements donor_tadig_code to fully describe the inter-operator porting pair.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TADIG Code Registry; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline
attributes.description: The latest permissible timestamp by which the MNP transaction must be completed under applicable regulatory rules (e.g., FCC 1-business-day, Ofcom 1-working-day). Used for SLA breach detection and regulatory compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; NTIA

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code indicating why the MNP request was rejected. Common codes include: MSISDN_NOT_FOUND, OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, ACTIVE_CONTRACT, INVALID_ACCOUNT_HOLDER, DUPLICATE_REQUEST, REGULATORY_HOLD. Populated only when port_status = 'rejected'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSISDN_NOT_FOUND|OUTSTANDING_BALANCE|ACTIVE_CONTRACT|INVALID_ACCOUNT_HOLDER|DUPLICATE_REQUEST|REGULATORY_HOLD|FRAUD_SUSPECTED|TECHNICAL_ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the rejection reason, providing additional context beyond the rejection_reason_code. Populated only when port_status = 'rejected'. Used for dispute resolution and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the MNP porting request was formally submitted by the subscriber or the gaining operator. This is the principal business event timestamp marking the start of the porting lifecycle.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of times this MNP transaction has been retried following a failure or rejection. Used for operational monitoring, SLA tracking, and identifying systemic porting issues with specific operators.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The routing number (RN) assigned to the ported MSISDN in the Number Portability database, used by all operators to correctly route calls and SMS to the ported number on the recipient network. Aligned with ITU-T E.164 routing principles.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.116; GSMA PRD IR.85; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: routing_number_update_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the routing number in the Number Portability database and HLR/HSS/UDM has been successfully updated following port completion. 'pending' — update queued; 'updated' — successfully propagated; 'failed' — update error requiring intervention; 'not_required' — no routing change needed.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; 3GPP TS 23.003; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscriber service type associated with the porting MSISDN. Determines applicable porting rules, timelines, and regulatory obligations. 'mvno' indicates the subscriber is on a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) arrangement.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.011; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount charged or credited between Telecommunication and the counterparty operator for this MNP transaction under the applicable inter-operator tariff (IOT). Expressed in the settlement currency defined in the carrier agreement. Null if inter_operator_charge_applicable = False.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D-Series Recommendations

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
