attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which the inter-operator settlement amount for this MNP transaction is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Must align with the settlement currency in the governing carrier agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MNP transaction exceeded the regulatory or contractual maximum porting time SLA. True = SLA breached; False = within SLA. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and inter-operator dispute management.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this MNP transaction record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across BSS/OSS platforms.

attributes.name: subscriber_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber's explicit consent for the number port has been verified and recorded, as required by regulatory frameworks. True = consent confirmed; False = consent not yet verified or verification failed. Critical for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions C8; GDPR Article 7; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MNP transaction record was most recently modified in the system of record. Used for change tracking, SLA monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing.

products.name: poi
products.description: Point of Interconnect (POI) master record defining the physical or logical handoff points between Telecommunication's network and a carrier's network. Captures POI ID, POI name, location (city, exchange, data center), interconnect type (TDM, IP/SIP, MPLS), connected carrier reference, trunk group reference, regulatory designation, capacity, and operational status. SSOT for interconnect topology.
products.reference: ITU-T Q.50 / TM Forum SID NetworkInterconnectPoint

attributes.name: poi_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Point of Interconnect (POI) master record. Primary key for the interconnect_poi entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier interconnect or roaming agreement governing the commercial and technical terms for this POI. Links to the interconnect.carrier_agreement SSOT.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or operator whose network connects at this POI. Links to the carrier/partner master record for the interconnecting operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) table applicable for traffic exchanged at this POI. IOT rates govern the financial settlement between operators for roaming and interconnect traffic.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 (IOT); TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating

attributes.name: maintenance_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.depot. Business justification: Telecom operations assign each Point of Interconnect to a responsible depot for maintenance dispatch. The depot-to-POI geographic assignment drives which technician crews are dispatched for POI mainte

attributes.name: nms_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding network element in the Network Management System (NMS) — Nokia NetAct or Ericsson Network Manager — that monitors this POI. Enables correlation between the business POI record and real-time network telemetry.
attributes.references: Nokia NetAct Configuration Management; Ericsson Network Manager; TM Forum eTOM GB921

attributes.name: peering_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.peering_arrangement. Business justification: Point of Interconnect (POI) represents physical/logical handoff points that may be associated with specific peering arrangements. Adding FK to peering_arrangement links infrastructure to commercial ag

attributes.name: redundant_poi_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the backup or redundant POI that provides failover capacity for this POI. Null if no redundant POI is designated. Used in network resilience and failover planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.841; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Points of Interconnect with regulatory designation (e.g., designated reference interconnect offers) require regulatory filings establishing or modifying that designation. The plain attribute `regulato

attributes.name: responsible_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: Telecommunications POIs require assigned technicians for maintenance, fault resolution, capacity upgrades, and emergency response. Business process: POI maintenance scheduling, SLA compliance tracking

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: Physical interconnection points located at enterprise customer sites (on-net buildings, colocation facilities). Business need: tracking which enterprise site hosts interconnect infrastructure for capa

attributes.name: sla_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining performance commitments (availability, latency, packet loss) for this POI. Used for SLA monitoring and breach reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Y.1541; ETSI EN 302 217

attributes.name: topology_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.topology. Business justification: A Point of Interconnect is served by a specific topology path. Network operations teams must correlate POI operational status against topology link state for fault management and capacity reporting —

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Interconnect points of interconnection physically terminate on transmission links. Operations teams need to track which transmission infrastructure serves each POI for capacity planning, fault isolati

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this POI was first activated and began carrying live traffic. Used for asset age tracking, depreciation scheduling, and regulatory reporting of interconnect history.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: bandwidth_mbps
attributes.description: Total provisioned bandwidth capacity at this POI in megabits per second (Mbps). Applicable primarily for IP/SIP, MPLS, and Ethernet interconnect types. Used for traffic engineering and QoS planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.826; ETSI EN 302 217; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: clli_code
attributes.description: Telcordia/iconectiv Common Language Location Identifier (CLLI) code for the network element or building where this POI is located. Industry-standard 11-character code used in OSS provisioning and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Telcordia GR-485-CORE (CLLI); FCC 47 CFR Part 51; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: cmdb_ci_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Configuration Management Database (CMDB) Configuration Item (CI) ID
attributes.description: ServiceNow CMDB Configuration Item (CI) identifier for this POI. Enables linking the POI business record to ITSM incident, change, and problem management workflows.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM CMDB; ISO/IEC 20000-1; TM Forum eTOM GB921

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where the POI is physically located (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable regulatory framework and IOT tariff jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POI record was first created in the system of record (Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory). Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: data_center_name
attributes.description: Name of the data center or colocation facility hosting the POI for IP-based or MPLS interconnects (e.g., 'Equinix NY5', 'CyrusOne Dallas'). Applicable for IP/SIP and MPLS interconnect types.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which this POI was or is scheduled to be permanently decommissioned and removed from service. Null if the POI is still active. Used for lifecycle management and capacity reclamation planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Asset Management

attributes.name: exchange_name
attributes.description: Name of the telephone exchange, central office, or network exchange facility where the POI is physically housed (e.g., 'Manhattan Central Office', 'Chicago Exchange 5'). Used in OSS topology mapping.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Nokia NetAct Configuration Management

attributes.name: interconnect_type
attributes.description: Technology type of the interconnect at this POI. TDM = Time Division Multiplexing (legacy PSTN); IP_SIP = IP-based Session Initiation Protocol; MPLS = Multiprotocol Label Switching; ETHERNET = Layer 2 Ethernet handoff; FIBER = direct fiber interconnect.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.805; ETSI EN 300 175; 3GPP TS 23.002; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Traffic jurisdiction classification for this POI. INTERSTATE = traffic crossing state lines (FCC jurisdiction); INTRASTATE = within-state traffic (state PUC jurisdiction); INTERNATIONAL = cross-border traffic; LOCAL = local exchange traffic. Determines applicable tariff and regulatory regime.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 51 and Part 69; ITU-T D.150; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: maintenance_window
attributes.description: Scheduled maintenance window for this POI expressed as a cron-style or free-text schedule (e.g., 'SUN 02:00-04:00 UTC'). Used by NOC for planned outage coordination and change management.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM GB921; ServiceNow ITSM Change Management; Nokia NetAct

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: Mobile or fixed network generation supported at this POI. Determines applicable technical standards, QoS parameters, and IOT tariff applicability. 5G NR = 5G New Radio; LTE = Long-Term Evolution.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.002; ITU-T IMT-2020; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: noc_contact
attributes.description: Contact details (name, phone, or email) for the Network Operations Center (NOC) team responsible for monitoring and managing this POI. Used for fault escalation and incident coordination.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM GB921; Nokia NetAct Fault Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about this POI, including special configuration details, known limitations, or historical context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the POI. ACTIVE = in-service and carrying traffic; PROVISIONING = being set up; SUSPENDED = temporarily halted; DECOMMISSIONED = permanently retired from service.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM GB921; Nokia NetAct Configuration Management; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: peering_type
attributes.description: Classification of the peering arrangement at this POI. PUBLIC = via internet exchange point (IXP); PRIVATE = direct bilateral peering; BILATERAL = two-party agreement; MULTILATERAL = multi-party peering fabric. Applicable for IP peering POIs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34; IETF RFC 7948

attributes.name: poi_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the POI by traffic scope. DOMESTIC = national carrier interconnect; INTERNATIONAL = cross-border carrier handoff; TRANSIT = pass-through traffic routing; PEERING = bilateral traffic exchange; WHOLESALE = MVNO or reseller interconnect.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC 47 CFR Part 51; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: poi_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the POI, used in regulatory filings, carrier agreements, and OSS/BSS systems. Unique across all interconnect points. Sourced from Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Interconnection Rules 47 CFR Part 51

attributes.name: poi_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the POI, typically referencing the exchange location or data center (e.g., 'NYC-Manhattan-Equinix-POI-01'). Used in operational dashboards and carrier communications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: pop_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Point of Presence (POP) network node associated with this POI. A POP is the physical network access location; multiple POIs may share a POP. Used in network topology and routing tables.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: protocol_standard
attributes.description: Signaling or routing protocol standard used at this POI. SIP = Session Initiation Protocol; H.323 = ITU multimedia protocol; SS7 = Signaling System 7 (PSTN); ISUP = ISDN User Part; SIGTRAN = SS7 over IP; BGP = Border Gateway Protocol; LDP = Label Distribution Protocol (MPLS).
attributes.references: ITU-T Q.761; IETF RFC 3261 (SIP); ETSI EN 300 356; 3GPP TS 29.165

attributes.name: redundancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this POI has a redundant or backup interconnect path configured (True = redundant path exists; False = single path, no redundancy). Critical for SLA risk assessment and network resilience planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.841; TM Forum SID GB922; ETSI EN 302 217

attributes.name: regulatory_designation
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the POI as determined by applicable telecommunications authority (e.g., FCC, Ofcom, BEREC). Determines whether interconnect rates are tariff-regulated or commercially negotiated. Critical for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 51; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: total_capacity_circuits
attributes.description: Total provisioned circuit capacity at this POI expressed as number of circuits (DS0 equivalents for TDM, or logical channels for IP). Principal quantitative measure of the POI resource. Used for capacity planning and SLA enforcement.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.703; TM Forum SID GB922; Ericsson Network Manager Transport Management

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Permitted traffic flow direction at this POI. INBOUND = traffic received from the connected carrier; OUTBOUND = traffic sent to the connected carrier; BIDIRECTIONAL = traffic flows in both directions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: trunk_group_code
attributes.description: Reference to the trunk group associated with this POI. A trunk group is a logical bundle of circuits or channels provisioned at this interconnect point for traffic routing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ericsson Network Manager Transport Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this POI record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: used_capacity_circuits
attributes.description: Number of circuits currently in active use at this POI. Used to calculate utilization percentage for capacity management, congestion alerting, and expansion planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Nokia NetAct Performance Management

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: SSOT for field and technical workforce operations — technician scheduling, dispatch, route optimization, work order execution, skill/certification tracking, and mobile workforce coordination for network installation, maintenance, and repair. Managed via Granite Telecommunications WFM.
domains.references: TM Forum eTOM Workforce Management, TM Forum SID Resource

products.name: technician
products.description: Master record for field and technical workforce personnel with periodic performance evaluation history. Identity and employment: technician ID, name, employment status, home depot/zone assignment, employment type (full-time, contractor, MVNO partner), contact details, hire/termination dates, workforce classification (RAN, FTTH, GPON, CPE, splicing). Performance history: quarterly/annual review records with KPIs (first-time fix rate, MTTR, work orders/day, SLA compliance, CSAT, safety compliance, attendance), review period, reviewer (supervisor), overall rating, individual KPI scores, development goals, acknowledgement status, and improvement plan references. SSOT for individual workforce identity and performance within the workforce domain. Sourced from Granite Telecommunications WFM and SAP S/4HANA HCM.
products.reference: TM Forum SID — Party/Individual; eTOM 1.4 Workforce Management

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the field or technical workforce personnel. Primary key for the technician master record.

attributes.name: home_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.depot. Business justification: Technician has a home_depot_code (STRING) that denotes their base depot for dispatch and staging. Normalizing this to a FK home_depot_id -> workforce.depot.depot_id eliminates the string code and esta

attributes.name: subcontracting_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Telecom field workforces routinely include subcontracted technicians from partner companies. Linking technician to the supplying partner is essential for subcontractor billing reconciliation, complian

attributes.name: supervisor_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the direct supervisor or field manager responsible for this technician's performance management and work assignment.

attributes.name: attendance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of scheduled work days attended. Used for reliability assessment and workforce planning.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent background check or security clearance verification. Required for access to customer premises and sensitive network infrastructure.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Aggregate status of required industry certifications (e.g., fiber optic, electrical safety, tower climbing). Drives dispatch eligibility and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the technician master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: current_performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent overall performance evaluation rating from the latest review cycle. Used for promotion decisions and workforce optimization.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Average customer satisfaction rating (0-100 scale) from post-service surveys. Key indicator of service quality and technician soft skills.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Customer Experience Management

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that provided this technician data: Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management (WFM), SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management (HCM), manual entry, or integration feed.

attributes.name: drug_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent drug screening test. Required for safety-sensitive positions and compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations for commercial drivers.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated emergency contact person for field safety incidents and urgent notifications.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the designated emergency contact for field safety incidents and urgent notifications.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment lifecycle status indicating availability for work assignment and dispatch.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment relationship: full-time employee, part-time employee, contractor, Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) partner technician, or temporary worker.

attributes.name: first_time_fix_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of work orders resolved on the first visit without requiring return trips. Key performance indicator (KPI) for technician efficiency and customer satisfaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Service Fulfillment KPI

attributes.name: improvement_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician is currently on a formal performance improvement plan. Used for HR compliance and management escalation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in the technician master record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review. Used to schedule upcoming reviews and ensure compliance with review frequency policies.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair
attributes.description: Average time in minutes to complete repair work orders. Critical KPI for workforce productivity and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Service Assurance KPI

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal performance review. Drives manager notifications and review preparation workflows.

attributes.name: safety_compliance_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0-100) representing adherence to safety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) usage, and incident-free work history. Critical for field workforce risk management.

attributes.name: service_zone
attributes.description: Geographic service zone or territory assignment for dispatch optimization and workload balancing.

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: Overall technical proficiency level used for work order assignment complexity matching and career progression tracking.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of work orders completed within committed SLA timeframes. Critical for customer satisfaction and penalty avoidance.

attributes.name: tools_kit_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the standard tools and equipment kit assigned to the technician. Used for inventory tracking and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: training_hours_ytd
attributes.description: Total training and professional development hours completed in the current calendar year. Used for compliance reporting and skill development tracking.

attributes.name: union_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician is a member of a labor union. Affects scheduling rules, overtime policies, and grievance procedures.

attributes.name: vehicle_assigned
attributes.description: Identifier of the company vehicle or fleet unit assigned to this technician for field operations and equipment transport.

attributes.name: work_orders_per_day
attributes.description: Average number of work orders completed per working day. Productivity metric used for capacity planning and workload balancing.

attributes.name: workforce_classification
attributes.description: Technical specialization area: Radio Access Network (RAN), Fiber to the Home (FTTH), Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON), Customer Premises Equipment (CPE), fiber splicing, transport network, core network, or hybrid multi-skill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ran|ftth|gpon|cpe|splicing|transport|core|hybrid — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: skill
products.description: SSOT for the technical skill taxonomy and individual technician skill proficiency holdings. Catalog section: skill code, name, category (RAN, transport, access, CPE, safety), proficiency level definitions (trainee/competent/expert), prerequisite skills, and validity period — e.g., fiber splicing, 5G NR RAN commissioning, GPON/OLT configuration, VoLTE IMS troubleshooting. Technician-skill section: which skills each technician holds, current proficiency level, assessment date, assessor, expiry date, recertification requirements, and active status. Enables skill-based dispatch matching in Granite WFM — ensures only appropriately skilled technicians are assigned to specialized work orders (e.g., only fiber-splicing-expert for trunk splice jobs). Sourced from Granite WFM skills module.
products.reference: TM Forum SID — ResourceSpecification/Skill; GSMA workforce competency framework

attributes.name: skill_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the technical skill in the workforce skill taxonomy. Primary key.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the external certification authority or vendor (e.g., Ericsson, Nokia, Fiber Optic Association, OSHA) if certification_required_flag is true.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Official name of the required certification (e.g., Ericsson Certified RAN Expert, Nokia NetAct Administrator, FOA CFOT).

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal external certification is required to hold this skill (e.g., vendor certification for Ericsson RAN, Nokia NetAct, safety certifications).
attributes.references: TM Forum Workforce Management Best Practices

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the workforce administrator who created this skill record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this skill record was first created in the Granite WFM skills module.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: dispatch_priority_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight used in Granite WFM dispatch algorithm to prioritize technicians with this skill for matching work orders (higher weight = higher priority).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this skill was deprecated or made obsolete. Null if skill is still active.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

products.name: technician_schedule
products.description: SSOT for all technician time allocation, availability, and shift management. Encompasses: (1) Shift templates — standard shift patterns (day/evening/on-call/weekend rotation) with start/end times, duration, break rules, overtime eligibility, and applicable days. (2) Individual shift assignments — generated from templates, capturing shift type, assigned territory, depot, status (draft/published/confirmed/cancelled), and schedule change audit trail. (3) Overtime records — planned overtime (pre-approved for outage response, rollout surge) and emergency overtime (unplanned NOC callout), with hours, reason code, approving manager, pay classification (straight-time/time-and-a-half/double-time), and payroll period. (4) Leave/absence blocks — annual leave, sick leave, FMLA, training leave, emergency absence, with request/approval workflow, coverage plan (replacement technician), and impact on scheduled work orders. Includes planned vs. actual hours and payroll period references. Feeds dispatch optimization (Granite WFM) and SAP S/4HANA payroll.

products.name: route_plan
products.description: Transactional record of optimized daily route plans generated for technicians by Granite WFM route optimization engine, including ordered stop-level detail. Captures plan date, technician, depot start/end, and for each stop: sequence number, work order reference, site address, GPS coordinates, estimated/actual arrival and departure times, stop status (pending/arrived/completed/skipped), and inter-stop travel time. At plan level captures total estimated travel time, total distance (km/miles), optimization algorithm used (time-window, priority-weighted, fuel-optimized), plan status (draft/active/completed), and actual vs. planned deviation metrics. Supports OPEX reduction through fuel and time efficiency, real-time route tracking, and customer ETA updates.

domains.name: assurance
domains.description: SSOT for network fault management, performance monitoring, revenue assurance, and service quality operations — alarm events, trouble tickets, SLA breach tracking, MTTR/MTBF KPIs, NOC/SOC incident records, fraud detection, leakage detection, and reconciliation. Integrates Nokia NetAct, Ericsson NM, and ServiceNow ITSM.
domains.references: TM Forum eTOM Assurance Process Area, TM Forum Revenue Assurance, ITU-T M.3400 TMN

products.name: alarm_event
products.description: SSOT for network alarm events ingested from Nokia NetAct and Ericsson Network Manager. Captures real-time fault signals raised by network elements including RAN, transport, core, and GPON/FTTH nodes. Stores alarm severity, alarm type, affected network element, alarm state (raised/cleared/acknowledged), first occurrence timestamp, last occurrence timestamp, probable cause, specific problem code, managed object class, managed object instance, OSS source system, and correlation identifier. Feeds trouble ticket creation workflows in ServiceNow ITSM.

products.name: trouble_ticket
products.description: SSOT for fault management trouble tickets sourced from ServiceNow ITSM. Represents a formal record of a network or service fault requiring investigation and resolution. Captures ticket number, category (network/service/customer), priority, severity, affected service, affected network element, assigned NOC/SOC group, assignee, open timestamp, acknowledged timestamp, resolved timestamp, closed timestamp, root cause category, resolution description, MTTR (minutes), escalation flag, escalation tier, SLA breach flag, and source alarm correlation IDs. Aligns with eTOM process 1.1.1 Fault Management.

products.name: noc_incident
products.description: NOC/SOC operational incident record representing a declared network or security incident managed by the Network Operations Center or Security Operations Center. Distinct from a trouble ticket in that it represents a broader operational event (e.g., major outage, DDoS attack, fiber cut) that may span multiple trouble tickets and alarms. Captures incident ID, incident type (network/security/power/environmental), severity level, declared timestamp, resolved timestamp, impacted geography, impacted customer count estimate, impacted services list, incident commander, war-room bridge details, post-incident review flag, and RCA document reference.

products.name: performance_measurement
products.description: SSOT for time-series performance measurement records collected at the network-element layer from Nokia NetAct and Ericsson Network Manager across RAN, transport, and core domains. Captures infrastructure-level KPIs: RSRP, SINR, cell throughput, packet loss, latency, link utilization, node availability, and capacity metrics. Each record captures measurement object (cell/link/node/shelf/port), KPI name, measurement interval (15-min/1-hour/24-hour), raw value, threshold value, threshold breach flag, measurement source (OSS/EMS/NMS), collection timestamp, and source system. Serves as the unified network-element measurement store for availability computation, capacity planning, and threshold breach detection. Service-layer and bearer-level QoS measurements are owned by qos_measurement. Aligns with eTOM process 1.1.2 Performance Management.

products.name: kpi_threshold
products.description: Unified reference master and single source of truth for ALL detection rules, correlation logic, suppression rules, and threshold configurations used across the assurance domain. Encompasses: (1) KPI breach thresholds for performance monitoring (threshold value, direction, measurement window, severity); (2) Alarm correlation and suppression rules from Nokia NetAct/Ericsson NM (trigger alarm type, correlated alarm types, correlation window, root cause determination logic, suppression duration); (3) Fraud detection rules (fraud type targeted, detection method — velocity/threshold/pattern/blacklist/ML-signal, trigger threshold, applicable service type, false positive rate). products.name: campaign_channel_execution
products.description: This association product represents the Execution relationship between campaign and channel. It captures the operational assignment of a marketing campaign to a specific sales channel, including channel-specific budget allocation, activation dates, and per-channel performance metrics. Each record links one campaign to one channel and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific channel's execution of that campaign — data that belongs to neither the campaign master nor the channel master alone.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications marketing operations, campaigns are explicitly deployed across multiple sales channels (retail, telesales, digital, dealer/agent, enterprise direct), and each channel simultaneously carries multiple campaigns. Marketing operations teams actively manage which channels execute which campaigns, with separate budget allocations, response rate tracking, and cost-per-acquisition metrics per channel-campaign combination. This is a recognized operational business process — not an analytical correlation — where humans create, update, and deactivate channel-campaign execution records as part of campaign lifecycle management.

attributes.description: The total number of data delivery events (transmissions, handoffs, or media shipments) that have occurred for this lawful intercept order. Each delivery is typically logged as a separate line item in a related delivery record table.

products.name: topology_site_membership
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based enrollment of an enterprise_site within an sdwan_topology. It captures the operational membership record that governs how a specific site participates in a specific SD-WAN topology — including the site's role (hub, spoke, edge), its activation within that topology, its allocated bandwidth slice, and any site-level QoS overrides. Each record links one sdwan_topology to one enterprise_site with attributes that exist only in the context of this site-topology relationship, enabling multi-topology deployments, DR topologies, and phased migrations to be modeled accurately.. Existence Justification: In SD-WAN managed services, a topology is explicitly a multi-site construct — a single topology governs traffic engineering across many enterprise sites simultaneously. Critically, the reverse is also operationally real: an enterprise site can participate in multiple topologies concurrently (e.g., a primary production topology and a DR/failover topology, or during phased migrations where a site is enrolled in both the legacy and new topology). The business actively manages 'site membership' in a topology as an operational concept — provisioning, activating, and deactivating individual site enrollments with site-specific roles and configurations.

attributes.description: Number of hub sites in hub-and-spoke or hybrid topologies. Hub sites typically host centralized services (data centers, cloud on-ramps, security stacks) and aggregate traffic from spoke sites. [Moved from sdwan_topology: This is a derived aggregate count of hub-role memberships in this topology. It should be computed from topology_site_membership records where site_role = HUB, not stored as a denormalized count on the topology. Storing it on sdwan_topology creates a data integrity risk when memberships change.]

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this site's enrollment in the topology. Tracks whether the site is actively participating, pending provisioning, suspended, or being migrated to a new topology. Enables phased migration tracking where a site transitions between topologies.

attributes.name: qos_profile_override
attributes.description: Site-specific QoS profile that overrides the topology-level QoS configuration for this site. Allows individual sites to have differentiated traffic prioritization within the same topology. Belongs to the membership record because it is specific to this site's participation in this topology, not to the site or topology independently.

attributes.name: site_role
attributes.description: The functional role this site plays within the SD-WAN topology. Hub sites aggregate traffic from spoke sites; spoke sites are branch endpoints; edge sites have direct internet breakout. This role belongs to the membership, not the site or topology alone — the same site can be a hub in one topology and a spoke in another.

      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(paid_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(net_payable_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)

      expr: SUM(CAST(total_usage_minutes AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total voice usage minutes covered by invoices"
    - name: "total_data_volume_mb"

      comment: "Total data volume in megabytes covered by invoices"
    - name: "total_sms_count"

      comment: "Total SMS message count covered by invoices"
    - name: "total_cdr_count"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_cdr_count AS BIGINT))
      comment: "Total call detail record count processed across all invoices"
    - name: "avg_revenue_per_minute"

      comment: "Average revenue per voice minute, key pricing effectiveness metric"
    - name: "avg_revenue_per_mb"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(net_payable_amount AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_data_volume_mb AS DOUBLE)), 0), 4)
      comment: "Average revenue per megabyte of data, key data pricing metric"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `telecommunication_ecm`.`_metrics`.`interconnect_tap_file`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "TAP file processing and quality KPIs, tracking file exchange performance, validation success, and reconciliation status for roaming data interchange"
  source: "`telecommunication_ecm`.`interconnect`.`tap_file`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "file_status"
      expr: file_status
      comment: "Current processing status of the TAP file"
    - name: "file_type"
      expr: file_type
      comment: "Type of TAP file (e.g., TAP3, RAP)"
    - name: "roaming_direction"
      expr: roaming_direction
      comment: "Direction of roaming traffic (inbound or outbound)"
    - name: "processing_outcome"
      expr: processing_outcome
      comment: "Outcome of file processing (e.g., success, failed, partial)"
    - name: "reconciliation_status"
      expr: reconciliation_status
      comment: "Reconciliation status with settlement invoices"
    - name: "network_type"
      expr: network_type
      comment: "Network technology type (e.g., 4G, 5G)"
    - name: "tap_version"
      expr: tap_version
      comment: "TAP specification version used"
    - name: "is_test_file"
      expr: is_test_file
      comment: "Indicates whether this is a test file"
    - name: "file_creation_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', file_creation_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the TAP file was created"
    - name: "receipt_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', receipt_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the TAP file was received"
  measures:
    - name: "total_tap_files"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of TAP files processed"
    - name: "total_file_size_gb"
      expr: ROUND(SUM(CAST(file_size_bytes AS DOUBLE)) / 1073741824.0, 2)
      comment: "Total size of all TAP files in gigabytes"
    - name: "total_charge_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_charge_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total charge amount across all TAP files"
    - name: "total_tax_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(tax_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total tax amount across all TAP files"
    - name: "avg_file_size_mb"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(file_size_bytes AS DOUBLE)) / 1048576.0, 2)
      comment: "Average TAP file size in megabytes"
    - name: "avg_charge_per_file"
      expr: AVG(CAST(total_charge_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average charge amount per TAP file"
    - name: "file_success_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN processing_outcome = 'success' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of TAP files successfully processed, key quality metric"
    - name: "reconciliation_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN reconciliation_status = 'reconciled' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of TAP files successfully reconciled with invoices"
    - name: "avg_processing_time_hours"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(acknowledgement_timestamp) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(receipt_timestamp)) AS DOUBLE)) / 3600.0, 2)
      comment: "Average time in hours from receipt to acknowledgement, measuring processing efficiency"
    - name: "distinct_sender_carriers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT sender_carrier_id)
      comment: "Number of unique carrier partners sending TAP files"
$$
metric_views.description: TAP file processing and quality KPIs, tracking file exchange performance, validation success, and reconciliation status for roaming data interchange

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `telecommunication_ecm`.`_metrics`.`order_service_qualification`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Service availability and qualification metrics tracking coverage, eligibility, and infrastructure readiness for sales and network planning"
  source: "`telecommunication_ecm`.`order`.`service_qualification`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "qualification_status"
      expr: qualification_status
      comment: "Current status of the qualification (e.g., pending, qualified, not-qualified, expired)"
    - name: "qualification_outcome"
      expr: qualification_outcome
      comment: "Outcome of the qualification (e.g., serviceable, not-serviceable, conditional)"
    - name: "requested_service_type"
      expr: requested_service_type
      comment: "Service type requested for qualification"
    - name: "infrastructure_readiness"
      expr: infrastructure_readiness
      comment: "Infrastructure readiness status (e.g., ready, build-required, planned)"
    - name: "qualification_channel"
      expr: qualification_channel
      comment: "Channel through which qualification was requested"
    - name: "country_code"
      expr: country_code
      comment: "Country code of the service address"
    - name: "state_province"
      expr: state_province
      comment: "State or province of the service address"
    - name: "regulatory_zone_code"
      expr: regulatory_zone_code
      comment: "Regulatory zone code"
    - name: "field_survey_required"
      expr: field_survey_required
      comment: "Whether field survey is required (True/False)"
    - name: "cpe_required"
      expr: cpe_required
      comment: "Whether customer premises equipment is required (True/False)"
    - name: "mnp_applicable"
      expr: mnp_applicable
      comment: "Whether mobile number portability is applicable (True/False)"
    - name: "broadband_subsidy_eligible"
      expr: broadband_subsidy_eligible
      comment: "Whether address is eligible for broadband subsidy (True/False)"
    - name: "requalification_required"
      expr: requalification_required
      comment: "Whether requalification is required (True/False)"
  measures:
    - name: "total_qualifications"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of service qualification requests"
    - name: "unique_addresses"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT address_id)
      comment: "Number of unique addresses qualified"
    - name: "unique_customers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT customer_account_id)
      comment: "Number of unique customers requesting qualification"
    - name: "qualified_addresses"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qualification_outcome = 'serviceable' THEN service_qualification_id END)
      comment: "Count of addresses that qualified as serviceable"
    - name: "not_qualified_addresses"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qualification_outcome = 'not-serviceable' THEN service_qualification_id END)
      comment: "Count of addresses that did not qualify"
    - name: "field_survey_required_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN field_survey_required = true THEN service_qualification_id END)
      comment: "Count of qualifications requiring field survey"
    - name: "broadband_subsidy_eligible_count"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN broadband_subsidy_eligible = true THEN service_qualification_id END)
      comment: "Count of addresses eligible for broadband subsidy"
    - name: "avg_max_download_speed_mbps"
      expr: AVG(CAST(max_download_speed_mbps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average maximum download speed in Mbps across qualified addresses"
    - name: "avg_max_upload_speed_mbps"
      expr: AVG(CAST(max_upload_speed_mbps AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average maximum upload speed in Mbps across qualified addresses"
    - name: "avg_estimated_installation_lead_time_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_installation_lead_time_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated installation lead time in days"
    - name: "avg_signal_strength_dbm"
      expr: AVG(CAST(signal_strength_dbm AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average signal strength in dBm for wireless qualifications"
$$
metric_views.description: Service availability and qualification metrics tracking coverage, eligibility, and infrastructure readiness for sales and network planning

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `telecommunication_ecm`.`_metrics`.`order_sla`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "SLA performance and compliance metrics tracking target achievement, breach rates, and penalty exposure"
  source: "`telecommunication_ecm`.`order`.`sla`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "sla_status"
      expr: sla_status
      comment: "Current SLA status (e.g., on-track, at-risk, breached, completed)"
    - name: "sla_type"
      expr: sla_type
      comment: "Type of SLA (e.g., order-fulfillment, provisioning, repair, installation)"
    - name: "sla_category"
      expr: sla_category
      comment: "Category of SLA (e.g., operational, regulatory, contractual)"
    - name: "service_type"
      expr: service_type
      comment: "Service type covered by the SLA"
    - name: "customer_segment"
      expr: customer_segment
      comment: "Customer segment (e.g., consumer, SMB, enterprise)"
    - name: "priority_level"
      expr: priority_level
      comment: "Priority level of the SLA (e.g., standard, high, critical)"
    - name: "calendar_type"
      expr: calendar_type
      comment: "Calendar type for SLA measurement (e.g., business-days, calendar-days, 24x7)"
    - name: "penalty_applicable"
      expr: penalty_applicable
      comment: "Whether financial penalty applies for breach (True/False)"
    - name: "breach_notification_sent"
      expr: breach_notification_sent
      comment: "Whether breach notification was sent (True/False)"
    - name: "clock_suspended"
      expr: clock_suspended
      comment: "Whether SLA clock is currently suspended (True/False)"
    - name: "regulatory_body"
      expr: regulatory_body
      comment: "Regulatory body governing the SLA (if applicable)"
    - name: "effective_year_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_from_date)
      comment: "Year-month when the SLA became effective"
  measures:
    - name: "total_slas"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of SLA records"
    - name: "unique_fulfillment_orders"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT fulfillment_order_id)
      comment: "Number of unique fulfillment orders with SLA tracking"
    - name: "breached_slas"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN breach_timestamp IS NOT NULL THEN sla_id END)
      comment: "Count of SLAs that have been breached"
    - name: "completed_slas"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actual_completion_timestamp IS NOT NULL THEN sla_id END)
      comment: "Count of SLAs that have been completed"
    - name: "slas_with_penalty"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN penalty_applicable = true THEN sla_id END)
      comment: "Count of SLAs where penalty is applicable"
    - name: "total_penalty_credit_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(penalty_credit_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total penalty credit amount across all SLAs"
    - name: "avg_target_completion_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(target_completion_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average target completion hours across SLAs"
    - name: "avg_elapsed_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(elapsed_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average elapsed hours across SLAs"
    - name: "total_suspended_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_suspended_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total hours SLA clocks were suspended"
    - name: "avg_breach_threshold_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(breach_threshold_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average breach threshold hours across SLAs"
    - name: "breach_notifications_sent"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN breach_notification_sent = true THEN sla_id END)
      comment: "Count of SLAs where breach notification was sent"
$$
metric_views.description: SLA performance and compliance metrics tracking target achievement, breach rates, and penalty exposure

      comment: "Total suspension fees charged - revenue impact"
    - name: "total_reinstatement_fees"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinstatement_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinstatement fees collected - recovery revenue"
    - name: "total_prorated_charges"

    - name: "avg_suspension_fee"

      comment: "Average suspension fee per suspension event"
    - name: "avg_reinstatement_fee"
      expr: AVG(CAST(reinstatement_fee_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average reinstatement fee per reinstatement"

    - name: "regulatory_compliant_suspensions"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_compliance_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)

metric_views.description: Service suspension and reinstatement metrics tracking churn risk, revenue recovery, regulatory compliance, and customer retention effectiveness
